  Future<String> uploadAvatar(Uint8List bytes, String userId) async {
    // Use a unique filename every upload to bust CDN + Flutter image cache
    final timestamp = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    final path = '$userId/$timestamp.jpg';

    await supabase.Supabase.instance.client.storage.from('avatar').uploadBinary(
          path,
          bytes,
          fileOptions: const supabase.FileOptions(
            contentType: 'image/jpeg',
            upsert: true,
          ),
        );

    final publicUrl = supabase.Supabase.instance.client.storage
        .from('avatar')
        .getPublicUrl(path);

    return publicUrl;
  }

  Future<void> _setProfileJoinedOrg(String orgId, {String? profileId}) async {
    final student = currentStudent;
    final id = profileId ?? student?.id;
    if (id == null || id.isEmpty) return;

    final currentIds = <String>{...(student?.joinedOrgIds ?? const <String>[])};
    currentIds.add(orgId);
    final nextIds = currentIds.toList();

    if (student != null && student.id == id) {
      currentStudent = student.copyWith(joinedOrgIds: nextIds);
      await _saveStudentProfileLocalOnly();
    }

    try {
      await supabase.Supabase.instance.client
          .from('profiles')
          .update({'joined_org_ids': nextIds}).eq('id', id);
    } catch (e) {
      try {
        await supabase.Supabase.instance.client
            .from('profiles')
            .update({'joined_org_ids': jsonEncode(nextIds)}).eq('id', id);
      } catch (inner) {
        debugPrint('Error syncing joined_org_ids: $inner');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveStudentProfileLocalOnly() async {
    _prefs ??= await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (currentStudent == null) return;
    await _prefs!.setString(
      'student_profile',
      jsonEncode({
        'id': currentStudent!.id,
        'name': currentStudent!.name,
        'email': currentStudent!.email,
        'studentId': currentStudent!.studentId,
        'contact': currentStudent!.contact,
        'facebook': currentStudent!.facebook,
        'avatarUrl': currentStudent!.avatarUrl,
        'joinedOrgIds': currentStudent!.joinedOrgIds,
      }),
    );
  }

  Future<void> loadStudentProfile() async {
    _prefs ??= await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

    // 1. Load from SharedPreferences first (fast, offline fallback)
    final profileJson = _prefs!.getString('student_profile');
    if (profileJson != null) {
      try {
        final data = jsonDecode(profileJson) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        currentStudent = StudentProfile(
          id: data['id'] ?? '',
          name: data['name'] ?? '',
          email: data['email'] ?? '',
          studentId: data['studentId'] ?? '',
          contact: data['contact'] ?? '',
          facebook: data['facebook'] ?? '',
          avatarUrl: data['avatarUrl'] ?? '',
          joinedOrgIds: List<String>.from(data['joinedOrgIds'] ?? []),
        );
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 2. Always fetch fresh data from Supabase (gets latest avatar_url)
    try {
      final userId = supabase.Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
      if (userId != null) {
        final response = await supabase.Supabase.instance.client
            .from('profiles')
            .select()
            .eq('id', userId)
            .maybeSingle();

        if (response != null) {
          currentStudent = StudentProfile(
            id: response['id'] ?? '',
            name: response['name'] ?? '',
            email: response['email'] ?? '',
            studentId: response['student_id'] ?? '',
            contact: response['contact'] ?? '',
            facebook: response['facebook'] ?? '',
            avatarUrl: response['avatar_url'] ?? '',
            joinedOrgIds: _parseJoinedOrgIds(response['joined_org_ids']),
          );

          // Update SharedPreferences with the latest data
          await _prefs!.setString(
              'student_profile',
              jsonEncode({
                'id': currentStudent!.id,
                'name': currentStudent!.name,
                'email': currentStudent!.email,
                'studentId': currentStudent!.studentId,
                'contact': currentStudent!.contact,
                'facebook': currentStudent!.facebook,
                'avatarUrl': currentStudent!.avatarUrl,
                'joinedOrgIds': currentStudent!.joinedOrgIds,
              }));

          // Applications can finish loading before the profile request.
          // Refresh them now that the real student id is known so legacy
          // applications (including older rows without user_id) are visible.
          await fetchApplications();
          notifyListeners();
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error fetching profile from Supabase: $e');
    }
  }

  List<String> _parseJoinedOrgIds(dynamic raw) {
    try {
      if (raw is List) {
        return raw.map((e) => e.toString()).where((e) => e.isNotEmpty).toList();
      }
      if (raw is String && raw.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
        if (decoded is List) {
          return decoded
              .map((e) => e.toString())
              .where((e) => e.isNotEmpty)
              .toList();
        }
        // PostgreSQL text[] can sometimes arrive in {id,id} form.
        final trimmed = raw.trim();
        if (trimmed.startsWith('{') && trimmed.endsWith('}')) {
          return trimmed
              .substring(1, trimmed.length - 1)
              .split(',')
              .map((e) => e.trim().replaceAll('"', ''))
              .where((e) => e.isNotEmpty)
              .toList();
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return [];
  }

  Future<void> syncCurrentStudentMemberships() =>
      _syncCurrentStudentMemberships();

  Future<void> _syncCurrentStudentMemberships() async {
    final student = currentStudent;
    final client = supabase.Supabase.instance.client;
    final authUserId = client.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (student == null || student.id.isEmpty) return;

    final joinedIds = <String>{};

    // Existing membership records.
    try {
      final rows = await client
          .from('members')
          .select('org_id,org_name,profile_id')
          .eq('profile_id', student.id);
      for (final row in (rows as List)) {
        final id = row['org_id']?.toString().trim();
        if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty) joinedIds.add(id);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error loading member rows: $e');
    }

    // Approved applications are a second source of truth. This is important
    // for older approved applications whose members/profile cache was never
    // updated.
    Future<void> collectApproved(String column, String value) async {
      try {
        final rows =
            await client.from('applications').select('*').eq(column, value);
        for (final row in (rows as List)) {
          final status = row['status']?.toString().trim().toLowerCase();
          if (status != 'approved' && status != 'accepted') continue;

          final orgId = row['org_id']?.toString().trim();
          final orgName = row['org_name']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
          if (orgId != null && orgId.isNotEmpty) {
            joinedIds.add(orgId);
          } else if (orgName.isNotEmpty) {
            final org = _findOrgByName(orgName);
            if (org != null) joinedIds.add(org.id);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Error loading approved applications by $column: $e');
      }
    }

    if (authUserId != null && authUserId.isNotEmpty) {
      await collectApproved('user_id', authUserId);
    }
    final studentId = student.studentId.trim();
    if (studentId.isNotEmpty) {
      await collectApproved('student_id', studentId);
    }

    // Save the cache to the local profile and Supabase. The UI does not rely
    // solely on this cache, but keeping it updated makes the dashboard count
    // and Joined Orgs entry point reflect membership immediately.
    final nextIds = joinedIds.toList()..sort();
    final existing = [...student.joinedOrgIds]..sort();
    final changed = nextIds.length != existing.length ||
        nextIds.asMap().entries.any((e) => e.value != existing[e.key]);

    if (!changed) return; // nothing to write -> no realtime echo

    currentStudent = student.copyWith(joinedOrgIds: nextIds);
    await _saveStudentProfileLocalOnly();

    try {
      await client
          .from('profiles')
          .update({'joined_org_ids': nextIds}).eq('id', student.id);
    } catch (e) {
      try {
        await client.from('profiles').update(
            {'joined_org_ids': jsonEncode(nextIds)}).eq('id', student.id);
      } catch (inner) {
        debugPrint('Error saving joined_org_ids: $inner');
      }
    }

    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _saveStudentProfile() async {
    _prefs ??= await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (currentStudent != null) {
      final data = {
        'id': currentStudent!.id,
        'name': currentStudent!.name,
        'email': currentStudent!.email,
        'studentId': currentStudent!.studentId,
        'contact': currentStudent!.contact,
        'facebook': currentStudent!.facebook,
        'avatarUrl': currentStudent!.avatarUrl,
        'joinedOrgIds': currentStudent!.joinedOrgIds,
      };

      await _prefs!.setString('student_profile', jsonEncode(data));

      try {
        final profileData = {
          'id': currentStudent!.id,
          'name': currentStudent!.name,
          'email': currentStudent!.email,
          'student_id': currentStudent!.studentId,
          'contact': currentStudent!.contact,
          'facebook': currentStudent!.facebook,
          'avatar_url': currentStudent!.avatarUrl,
          'joined_org_ids': currentStudent!.joinedOrgIds,
        };

        await supabase.Supabase.instance.client
            .from('profiles')
            .upsert(profileData)
            .select();
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Error saving profile to Supabase: $e');
      }
    } else {
      await _prefs!.remove('student_profile');
    }
  }

  Future<String?> uploadEventImage(Uint8List bytes, String eventId) async {
    try {
      final timestamp = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
      final path = '$eventId/$timestamp.jpg';

      await supabase.Supabase.instance.client.storage
          .from('event_images')
          .uploadBinary(
            path,
            bytes,
            fileOptions: const supabase.FileOptions(
              contentType: 'image/jpeg',
              upsert: true,
            ),
          );

      return supabase.Supabase.instance.client.storage
          .from('event_images')
          .getPublicUrl(path);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error uploading event image: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }
}

/// Admin-only screen that creates a row in `organizations`, optionally uploads a
/// logo to the `org-assets` bucket, and optionally assigns an officer by
/// updating `profiles.role` and `profiles.assigned_org_id`.
///
/// Pops with `true` when the organization was created.

  String _contentType(String ext) {
    switch (ext) {
      case 'png':
        return 'image/png';
      case 'webp':
        return 'image/webp';
      default:
        return 'image/jpeg';
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickLogo() async {
    try {
      final file = await _picker.pickImage(source: ImageSource.gallery);
      if (file == null) return;
      final name = file.name.toLowerCase();
      final ext = name.contains('.') ? name.split('.').last : '';
      if (!_allowedExt.contains(ext)) {
        _snack('Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.');
        return;
      }
      final bytes = await file.readAsBytes();
      if (bytes.lengthInBytes > _maxLogoBytes) {
        _snack('Logo is too large. Please use an image under 5 MB.');
        return;
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _logoBytes = bytes;
        _logoExt = ext;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      _snack('Could not open the image: $error');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickOfficer() async {
    final picked = await showModalBottomSheet<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => const _OfficerPickerSheet(),
    );
    if (picked != null && mounted) setState(() => _officer = picked);
  }

  /// organizations.id is TEXT with no default; the app uses zero-padded
  /// numbers ('001', '002', ...) and next = max + 1.
  String _nextId(List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows) {
    var max = 0;
    for (final row in rows) {
      final n = int.tryParse(row['id']?.toString() ?? '');
      if (n != null && n > max) max = n;
    }
    return (max + 1).toString().padLeft(3, '0');
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (_saving) return;
    if (!(_formKey.currentState?.validate() ?? false)) return;

    final me = db.auth.currentUser;
    if (me == null) {
      _snack('You are signed out. Please log in again.');
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _saving = true);
    String? uploadedPath;
    try {
      // UI-level guard. (Today the database itself does not enforce this.)
      final myProfile = await db
          .from('profiles')
          .select('role')
          .eq('id', me.id)
          .maybeSingle();
      if (myProfile?['role']?.toString() != 'admin') {
        _snack('Only admins can create organizations.');
        return;
      }

      final name = _name.text.trim();
      final existing = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
        await db.from('organizations').select('id,name') as List,
      );
      final duplicate = existing.any(
        (row) =>
            (row['name']?.toString() ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() ==
            name.toLowerCase(),
      );
      if (duplicate) {
        _snack('An organization named "$name" already exists.');
        return;
      }

      var id = _nextId(existing);

      // Logo is optional. Column default is '' so we only set it when present.
      var logoUrl = '';
      final bytes = _logoBytes;
      if (bytes != null) {
        final path =
            'org_logos/${id}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.$_logoExt';
        await db.storage.from(_bucket).uploadBinary(
              path,
              bytes,
              fileOptions: FileOptions(
                contentType: _contentType(_logoExt),
                upsert: false,
              ),
            );
        uploadedPath = path;
        logoUrl = db.storage.from(_bucket).getPublicUrl(path);
      }

      // Insert, retrying with a fresh id if two admins pick the same number.
      for (var attempt = 0;; attempt++) {
        try {
          await db.from('organizations').insert({
            'id': id,
            'name': name,
            'logo_asset': logoUrl,
            'acronym': _acronym.text.trim(),
            'category': _category.text.trim(),
            'short_desc': _shortDesc.text.trim(),
          });
          break;
        } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
          if (e.code == '23505' && attempt < 2) {
            final fresh = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
              await db.from('organizations').select('id') as List,
            );
            id = _nextId(fresh);
            continue;
          }
          rethrow;
        }
      }
      uploadedPath = null; // org exists now, keep the logo file

      // Optional officer assignment.
      String? officerWarning;
      final officer = _officer;
      if (officer != null) {
        try {
          final updated = await db
              .from('profiles')
              .update({
                'role': 'officer',
                'assigned_org_id': id,
                'updated_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
              })
              .eq('id', officer['id'].toString())
              .select('id');
          if ((updated as List).isEmpty) {
            officerWarning =
                'The organization was created, but the officer could not be assigned (no row updated).';
          }
        } catch (error) {
          officerWarning =
              'The organization was created, but assigning the officer failed: $error';
        }
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      if (officerWarning != null) {
        _snack(officerWarning);
      } else {
        _snack('"$name" was created.', ok: true);
      }
      Navigator.of(context).pop(true);
    } catch (error) {
      // Insert failed after a logo upload: don't leave an orphan file behind.
      if (uploadedPath != null) {
        try {
          await db.storage.from(_bucket).remove([uploadedPath]);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      _snack('Could not create organization: $error');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _saving = false);
    }
  }

  InputDecoration _dec(String label, {String? hint}) => InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        hintText: hint,
        filled: true,

        ),
      );

  Widget _card(String title, String subtitle, Widget child) => Container(

/// Bottom sheet that lists accounts that can be made an officer:
/// students, and officers who are not assigned to any organization yet.
/// Admins and advisers are never listed, so they can't be demoted by mistake.
class _OfficerPickerSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const _OfficerPickerSheet();

  @override
  State<_OfficerPickerSheet> createState() => _OfficerPickerSheetState();
}

class _OfficerPickerSheetState extends State<_OfficerPickerSheet> {
  static const green = Color(0xFF128058);
  static const dark = Color(0xFF073B2A);
  static const muted = Color(0xFF4D6F62);
  static const line = Color(0xFFB9E4CF);

  final db = Supabase.instance.client;
  final _search = TextEditingController();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _all = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;
  String _query = '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _search.addListener(
        () => setState(() => _query = _search.text.trim().toLowerCase()));
    _load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    try {
      final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(await db
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id,name,email,role,assigned_org_id,active')
          .inFilter('role', ['student', 'officer']).order('name') as List);
      final eligible = rows.where((p) {
        if (p['active'] == false) return false;
        final role = p['role']?.toString();
        final assigned = p['assigned_org_id']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
        return role == 'student' || (role == 'officer' && assigned.isEmpty);
      }).toList();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _all = eligible;
        _loading = false;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = '$error';
        _loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get _filtered {
    if (_query.isEmpty) return _all;
    return _all.where((p) {
      final name = p['name']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
      final email = p['email']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
      return name.contains(_query) || email.contains(_query);
    }).toList();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final height = MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.75;
    final bottomInset = MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom;
    final rows = _filtered;
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: bottomInset),
      child: Container(
        height: height,
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          color: Color(0xFFF5FFF9),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26)),
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Container(
              width: 42,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: line,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
              ),
            ),
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 14, 18, 4),
              child: Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                child: Text('Choose an officer',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 18,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        color: dark)),
              ),
            ),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 8),
              child: TextField(
                controller: _search,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'Search by name or email',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded, color: green),
                  filled: true,
                  fillColor: Colors.white,
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    borderSide: const BorderSide(color: line),
                  ),
                  enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    borderSide: const BorderSide(color: line),
                  ),
                  focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    borderSide: const BorderSide(color: green, width: 1.6),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: _loading
                  ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: green))
                  : _error != null
                      ? Center(
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                            child: Text('Could not load accounts: $_error',
                                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                style: const TextStyle(color: muted)),
                          ),
                        )
                      : rows.isEmpty
                          ? const Center(
                              child: Text('No matching accounts.',
                                  style: TextStyle(color: muted)))
                          : ListView.separated(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 20),
                              itemCount: rows.length,
                              separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                                  const Divider(height: 1, color: line),
                              itemBuilder: (_, i) {
                                final p = rows[i];
                                final name =
                                    (p['name']?.toString().trim() ?? '')
                                            .isNotEmpty
                                        ? p['name'].toString().trim()
                                        : 'Unnamed user';
                                return ListTile(
                                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                                  leading: const CircleAvatar(
                                    backgroundColor: Color(0xFFDDF4E8),
                                    child: Icon(Icons.person_rounded,
                                        color: green),
                                  ),
                                  title: Text(name,
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                          color: dark)),
                                  subtitle: Text(
                                    '${p['email'] ?? ''} â€¢ ${p['role']}',
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 11, color: muted),
                                  ),
                                  onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context, p),
                                );
                              },
                            ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import 'admin_manage_accounts.dart';
import 'admin_organization_detail_screen.dart';
import 'admin_profile_screen.dart';

import '../../widgets/app_header.dart';
import 'admin_create_organization_screen.dart';

class AdminDashboard extends StatefulWidget {
  const AdminDashboard({super.key});

  @override
  State<AdminDashboard> createState() => _AdminDashboardState();
}

class _AdminDashboardState extends State<AdminDashboard> {
  static const green = Color(0xFF128058);
  static const dark = Color(0xFF073B2A);
  static const muted = Color(0xFF4D6F62);
  static const bg = Color(0xFFE6F7EE);
  static const line = Color(0xFFB9E4CF);

  final db = Supabase.instance.client;
  int tab = 0;
  bool loading = true;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> orgs = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> proposals = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> homeEvents = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  int members = 0;
  int events = 0;
  int users = 0;
  Map<String, double> scores = <String, double>{};
  Map<String, int> orgMembers = <String, int>{};
  Map<String, int> orgEvents = <String, int>{};
  Map<String, int> orgProposals = <String, int>{};
  Map<String, int> orgComments = <String, int>{};
  Map<String, String> proposalSubmitters = <String, String>{};
  String _avatarUrl = '';
  String _userName = '';
  RealtimeChannel? _realtimeChannel;

  Timer? _reloadTimer;
  bool _isLoadingNow = false;
  bool _reloadQueued = false;

  void _scheduleReload() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    _reloadTimer?.cancel();
    _reloadTimer =
        Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 600), () => _load(silent: true));
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
    _realtimeChannel = db
        .channel('admin-dashboard-realtime')
        .onPostgresChanges(
            event: PostgresChangeEvent.all,
            schema: 'public',
            table: 'organizations',
            callback: (_) => _scheduleReload())
        .onPostgresChanges(
            event: PostgresChangeEvent.all,
            schema: 'public',
            table: 'members',
            callback: (_) => _scheduleReload())
        .onPostgresChanges(
            event: PostgresChangeEvent.all,
            schema: 'public',
            table: 'events',
            callback: (_) => _scheduleReload())
        .onPostgresChanges(
            event: PostgresChangeEvent.all,
            schema: 'public',
            table: 'profiles',
            callback: (_) => _scheduleReload())
        .onPostgresChanges(
            event: PostgresChangeEvent.all,
            schema: 'public',
            table: 'event_requests',
            callback: (_) => _scheduleReload())
        .onPostgresChanges(
            event: PostgresChangeEvent.all,
            schema: 'public',
            table: 'event_comments',
            callback: (_) => _scheduleReload())
        .subscribe();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _reloadTimer?.cancel();
    final channel = _realtimeChannel;
    if (channel != null) db.removeChannel(channel);
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load({bool silent = false}) async {
    if (_isLoadingNow) {
      _reloadQueued = true;
      return;
    }
    _isLoadingNow = true;
    if (!silent && mounted) setState(() => loading = true);
    try {
      final results = await Future.wait<dynamic>([
        db.from('organizations').select('*').order('name'),
        db.from('members').select('id,org_id,org_name'),
        db.from('events').select('*').order('date', ascending: true),
        db.from('profiles').select('id,role'),
        db
            .from('profiles')
            .select('name,avatar_url')
            .eq('id', db.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '')
            .maybeSingle(),
        db
            .from('event_requests')
            .select('*')
            .order('created_at', ascending: false),
      ]);

      final organizationRows =
          List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[0] as List);
      final memberRows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[1] as List);
      final eventRows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[2] as List);
      final profileRows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[3] as List);
      final proposalRows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[5] as List);

      final requesterIds = proposalRows
          .map((x) => x['requested_by']?.toString() ?? '')
          .where((x) => x.isNotEmpty)
          .toSet()
          .toList();
      Map<String, String> submitterNames = <String, String>{};
      if (requesterIds.isNotEmpty) {
        try {
          final requesters = await db
              .from('profiles')
              .select('id,name,email')
              .inFilter('id', requesterIds);
          for (final row in requesters as List) {
            final id = row['id']?.toString() ?? '';
            final name = row['name']?.toString().trim();
            final email = row['email']?.toString().trim();
            if (id.isNotEmpty) {
              submitterNames[id] = (name?.isNotEmpty ?? false)
                  ? name!
                  : (email?.isNotEmpty ?? false)
                      ? email!
                      : 'Unknown user';
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {
          // Some deployments may restrict profile lookup for requester names.
        }
      }

      List<dynamic> comments = <dynamic>[];
      try {
        comments = await db.from('event_comments').select('event_id');
      } catch (_) {
        // Comments are optional analytics data.
      }

      final nextOrgMembers = <String, int>{};
      final nextOrgEvents = <String, int>{};
      final nextOrgProposals = <String, int>{};
      final nextOrgComments = <String, int>{};

      for (final row in memberRows) {
        final id = row['org_id']?.toString() ?? '';
        if (id.isNotEmpty) nextOrgMembers[id] = (nextOrgMembers[id] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
      for (final row in eventRows) {
        final id = row['org_id']?.toString() ?? '';
        if (id.isNotEmpty) nextOrgEvents[id] = (nextOrgEvents[id] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
      for (final row in proposalRows) {
        final id = row['org_id']?.toString() ?? '';
        if (id.isNotEmpty) {
          nextOrgProposals[id] = (nextOrgProposals[id] ?? 0) + 1;
        }
      }
      for (final row in comments) {
        final eventId = row['event_id']?.toString();
        final matches =
            eventRows.where((event) => event['id']?.toString() == eventId);
        if (matches.isNotEmpty) {
          final id = matches.first['org_id']?.toString() ?? '';
          if (id.isNotEmpty) {
            nextOrgComments[id] = (nextOrgComments[id] ?? 0) + 1;
          }
        }
      }

      final nextScores = <String, double>{};
      for (final row in organizationRows) {
        final id = row['id']?.toString() ?? '';
        nextScores[id] = ((nextOrgMembers[id] ?? 0) +
                (nextOrgEvents[id] ?? 0) * 3 +
                (nextOrgProposals[id] ?? 0) * 2 +
                (nextOrgComments[id] ?? 0))
            .toDouble();
      }

      final filteredProposals = proposalRows
          .where((x) => x['status']?.toString() == 'forwarded_to_admin')
          .toList();
      final profile = results[4] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
      final futureEvents = eventRows
          .where((x) {
            final date = DateTime.tryParse(x['date']?.toString() ?? '');
            return date == null ||
                !DateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day).isBefore(today);
          })
          .take(6)
          .toList();

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        orgs = organizationRows;
        members = memberRows.length;
        events = eventRows.length;
        users = profileRows.length;
        orgMembers = nextOrgMembers;
        orgEvents = nextOrgEvents;
        orgProposals = nextOrgProposals;
        orgComments = nextOrgComments;
        scores = nextScores;
        proposals = filteredProposals;
        proposalSubmitters = submitterNames;
        _avatarUrl = profile?['avatar_url']?.toString() ?? '';
        _userName = profile?['name']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
        homeEvents = futureEvents;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => loading = false);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not load admin data: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      _isLoadingNow = false;
      if (_reloadQueued) {
        _reloadQueued = false;
        _scheduleReload();
      }
    }
  }

      backgroundColor: bg,
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,

  String _headerName(String fullName, String fallback) {
    final parts = fullName
        .trim()
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    return parts.isEmpty ? fallback : parts.take(2).join(' ');
  }

  Widget _eventCard(Map<String, dynamic> e) {
    final imgs =
        (e['image_urls'] is List ? e['image_urls'] as List : const <dynamic>[])
            .whereType<String>()
            .toList();
    final single = e['image_url']?.toString();
    if (single != null && single.isNotEmpty && !imgs.contains(single)) {
      imgs.insert(0, single);
    }
    final date = DateTime.tryParse(e['date']?.toString() ?? '');
    final dateText = date == null
        ? 'Date to be announced'
        : '${date.month}/${date.day}/${date.year}';

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFFE9FFF2), Color(0xFFBDF3D0)]),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
        border: Border.all(color: line),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
              color: green.withValues(alpha: .08),
              blurRadius: 16,
              offset: const Offset(0, 6))
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        if (imgs.isNotEmpty)
          SizedBox(
              height: 220,
              width: double.infinity,
              child: Image.network(imgs.first,
                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _eventPlaceholder()))
        else
          _eventPlaceholder(),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 16),
          child:
              Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
            Text(e['title']?.toString() ?? 'Untitled event',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: dark)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Row(children: [
              const Icon(Icons.calendar_month_rounded, size: 15, color: green),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(dateText,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: muted,
                      fontSize: 11.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700))
            ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 5),
            Text(e['org_name']?.toString() ?? 'Organization',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    color: muted, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            if ((e['description'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(e['description'].toString(),
                  maxLines: 4,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: muted, height: 1.35, fontSize: 12)),
            ],
          ]),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

    final orgName = _orgNameFor(p['org_id']?.toString());
    final submitter = proposalSubmitters[p['requested_by']?.toString()] ??
        'Submitter not available';
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () => _openProposalOrganization(p),
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: .78),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            border: Border.all(color: line.withValues(alpha: .8))),
        child: Row(children: [
          const Icon(Icons.description_outlined, color: green, size: 18),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                Text(p['title']?.toString() ?? 'Proposal',
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: dark)),
                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                Text(orgName,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10.5,
                        color: muted,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text('Submitted by $submitter',
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, color: muted)),
              ])),
          const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: Color(0xFF94A3B8)),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openProposalOrganization(Map<String, dynamic> proposal) {
    final org = orgs
        .where((row) => row['id']?.toString() == proposal['org_id']?.toString())
        .toList();
    if (org.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
            content:
                Text('The organization for this proposal could not be found.')),
      );
      return;
    }
    _openOrg(
      org.first,
      initialTab: 2,
      focusProposalId: proposal['id']?.toString(),
    );
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _ranked() {
    final list = orgs.map((row) {
      final id = row['id']?.toString() ?? '';
      return <String, dynamic>{
        'org': row,
        'score': scores[id] ?? 0,
        'members': orgMembers[id] ?? 0,
        'events': orgEvents[id] ?? 0,
        'proposals': orgProposals[id] ?? 0,
      };
    }).toList();
    list.sort((a, b) => (b['score'] as double).compareTo(a['score'] as double));
    return list;
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _memberComparison() {
    final rows = orgs.map((org) {
      final id = org['id']?.toString() ?? '';
      return <String, dynamic>{
        'org': org,
        'members': orgMembers[id] ?? 0,
      };
    }).toList();
    rows.sort((a, b) => (b['members'] as int).compareTo(a['members'] as int));
    return rows;
  }

  Widget _memberComparisonCard(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final org = row['org'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
    final count = row['members'] as int;
    final rows = _memberComparison();
    final maxCount = rows.isEmpty ? 1 : rows.first['members'] as int;
    final progress = maxCount <= 0 ? 0.0 : count / maxCount;
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 9),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(color: line),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
              color: green.withValues(alpha: .045),
              blurRadius: 12,
              offset: const Offset(0, 5))
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        Row(children: [
          _orgLogo(org['logo_asset']?.toString() ?? '', size: 42),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
              child: Text(org['name']?.toString() ?? 'Organization',
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: dark,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      fontSize: 13.5))),
          Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 6),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: green.withValues(alpha: .10),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30)),
              child: Text('$count member${count == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: green,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      fontSize: 10.5))),
        ]),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        ClipRRect(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          child: LinearProgressIndicator(
            value: progress,
            minHeight: 8,
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE5F5EC),
            valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(green),
          ),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _miniChip(IconData icon, String text) => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 5),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: .80),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
            border: Border.all(color: line.withValues(alpha: .7))),
        child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 12, color: green),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
          Text(text,
              style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 9.5, color: muted, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800))
        ]),
      );

  Widget _orgLogo(String asset, {double size = 64}) {
    final value = asset.trim();
    Widget image;
    if (value.startsWith('http://') || value.startsWith('https://')) {
      image = Image.network(value,
          width: size,
          height: size,
          fit: BoxFit.cover,
          errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _logoFallback(size));
    } else if (value.isNotEmpty) {
      image = Image.asset(value.startsWith('assets/') ? value : 'assets/$value',
          width: size,
          height: size,
          fit: BoxFit.cover,
          errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _logoFallback(size));
    } else {
      image = _logoFallback(size);
    }
    return Container(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          shape: BoxShape.circle,
          color: Colors.white,
          border: Border.all(color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: .9)),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(color: green.withValues(alpha: .08), blurRadius: 12)
          ]),
      child: ClipOval(child: image),
    );
  }

  Widget _logoFallback(double size) => Container(
      color: const Color(0xFFE8F7ED),
      child: Icon(Icons.groups_rounded, color: green, size: size * .48));

  Widget _emptyCard(String text, IconData icon) => Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 220),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(28),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: const LinearGradient(
                colors: [Color(0xFFF8FFFB), Color(0xFFDDF4E8)]),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            border: Border.all(color: line)),
        child: Column(children: [
          Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: green.withValues(alpha: .09), shape: BoxShape.circle),
              child: Icon(icon, color: green, size: 26)),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(text,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(color: muted, height: 1.4))
        ]),
      );

  Widget _badge(String text) => Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: green.withValues(alpha: .10),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30)),
      child: Text(text,
          style: const TextStyle(
              color: dark, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)));

  String _orgNameFor(String? id) {
    if (id == null || id.isEmpty) return 'Organization';
    for (final org in orgs) {
      if (org['id']?.toString() == id) {
        return org['name']?.toString() ?? 'Organization';
      }
    }
    return 'Organization';
  }

  Future<void> _openCreateOrg() async {
    final created = await Navigator.push<bool>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => const AdminCreateOrganizationScreen(),
      ),
    );
    if (created == true) await _load(silent: true);
  }

  void _openOrg(
    Map<String, dynamic> org, {
    int initialTab = 0,
    String? focusProposalId,
  }) {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => AdminOrganizationDetailScreen(
          orgId: org['id'].toString(),
          orgName: org['name']?.toString() ?? 'Organization',
          initialTab: initialTab,
          focusProposalId: focusProposalId,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' as supabase;
import '../../core/app_state.dart';
import '../../widgets/app_header.dart';

class AdminAccountsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AdminAccountsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<AdminAccountsScreen> createState() => _AdminAccountsScreenState();
}

class _AdminAccountsScreenState extends State<AdminAccountsScreen> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> dbUsers = [];
  bool isLoading = true;

  static const Color accent = Color(0xFF22C55E);
  static const Color success = Color(0xFF22C55E);
  static const Color danger = Color(0xFFEF4444);

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _fetchUsersFromDatabase();
  }

  Future<void> _fetchUsersFromDatabase() async {
    try {
      final response =
          await supabase.Supabase.instance.client.from('profiles').select('*');
      setState(() {
        dbUsers = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(response as List);
        isLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        dbUsers = [];
        isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _updateActiveInDatabase(String userId, bool active) async {
    try {
      await supabase.Supabase.instance.client
          .from('profiles')
          .update({'active': active}).eq('id', userId);
    } catch (e) {
      _showSnack('Failed to update status: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _setOfficerPosition(
    Map<String, dynamic> user,
    String position,
  ) async {
    final userId = user['id'].toString();
    final previousPosition = user['officer_position']?.toString() ?? '';
    setState(() {
      final index = dbUsers.indexWhere((item) => item['id'] == user['id']);
      if (index != -1) dbUsers[index]['officer_position'] = position;
    });

    try {
      await supabase.Supabase.instance.client
          .from('profiles')
          .update({'officer_position': position})
          .eq('id', userId);
      if (!mounted) return;
      _showSnack('Officer position updated to $position');
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        final index = dbUsers.indexWhere((item) => item['id'] == user['id']);
        if (index != -1) dbUsers[index]['officer_position'] = previousPosition;
      });
      _showSnack('Failed to update officer position: $e');
    }
  }

  // Show org picker when admin sets role to Officer or Adviser.
  Future<void> _showOrgPickerDialog(
    Map<String, dynamic> user, {
    String role = 'officer',
  }) async {
    final orgs = AppState.instance.organizations;

    if (orgs.isEmpty) {
      _showSnack('No organizations found. Please add organizations first.');
      return;
    }

    Organization? selectedOrg;

    // Pre-select if already assigned.
    final currentOrgId = user['assigned_org_id']?.toString();
    if (currentOrgId != null) {
      try {
        selectedOrg = orgs.firstWhere((o) => o.id == currentOrgId);
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    await showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (ctx, setDialogState) {

                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    'Select which org ${user['name'] ?? user['email']} can access as ${role == 'adviser' ? 'Adviser' : 'Officer'}',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              content: SizedBox(
                width: double.maxFinite,
                child: ListView.builder(
                  shrinkWrap: true,
                  itemCount: orgs.length,
                  itemBuilder: (_, index) {
                    final org = orgs[index];
                    final isChosen = selectedOrg?.id == org.id;

                    return GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () => setDialogState(() => selectedOrg = org),
                      child: AnimatedContainer(
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 12,
                          vertical: 10,
                        ),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: isChosen
                              ? const Color(0xFF22C55E).withValues(alpha: 0.10)
                              : Colors.grey.shade50,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: isChosen
                                ? const Color(0xFF22C55E)
                                : Colors.grey.shade200,
                            width: isChosen ? 1.8 : 1,
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              width: 36,
                              height: 36,
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: isChosen
                                    ? const Color(0xFF22C55E)
                                    : Colors.grey.shade200,
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
                              ),
                              child: Icon(
                                isChosen
                                    ? Icons.check_rounded
                                    : Icons.business_rounded,
                                color: isChosen
                                    ? Colors.white
                                    : Colors.grey.shade500,
                                size: 18,
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 12),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  Text(
                                    org.name,
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                      fontSize: 13.5,
                                      color: isChosen
                                          ? const Color(0xFF22C55E)
                                          : const Color(0xFF0F172A),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  Text(
                                    'ID: ${org.id}',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 11,
                                      color: Colors.grey.shade500,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
              actions: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                  child: const Text(
                    'Cancel',
                    style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
                  ),
                ),
                ElevatedButton(
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF22C55E),
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                    ),
                  ),
                  onPressed: selectedOrg == null
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          Navigator.pop(ctx);

                          final userId = user['id'].toString();
                          final orgId = selectedOrg!.id;

                          try {
                            await supabase.Supabase.instance.client
                                .from('profiles')
                                .update({
                              'role': role,
                              'assigned_org_id': orgId,
                            }).eq('id', userId);

                            if (!mounted) return;

                            setState(() {
                              final idx = dbUsers.indexWhere(
                                (u) => u['id'] == userId,
                              );

                              if (idx != -1) {
                                dbUsers[idx]['role'] = role;
                                dbUsers[idx]['assigned_org_id'] = orgId;
                              }
                            });

                            _showSnack(
                              '${user['name'] ?? user['email']} is now ${role == 'adviser' ? 'Adviser' : 'Officer'} of ${selectedOrg!.name}',
                            );
                          } catch (e) {
                            if (!mounted) return;
                            _showSnack('Error: $e');
                          }
                        },
                  child: const Text(
                    'Confirm',
                    style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

                                      ),
                                    ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 10),
                            Column(
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    color: isActive ? success : danger,
                                    fontSize: 11,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                Switch(
                                  value: isActive,
                                  activeThumbColor: success,
                                  onChanged: (value) async {
                                    await _updateActiveInDatabase(
                                      u['id'].toString(),
                                      value,
                                    );

                                    if (!mounted) return;

                                    setState(() {
                                      final realIdx = dbUsers.indexWhere(
                                        (d) => d['id'] == u['id'],
                                      );

                                      if (realIdx != -1) {
                                        dbUsers[realIdx]['active'] = value;
                                      }
                                    });

                                    _showSnack(
                                      value
                                          ? 'User activated'
                                          : 'User disabled',
                                    );
                                  },
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showSnack(String message) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(message),
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

class AdminOrganizationDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String orgId;
  final String orgName;
  final int initialTab;
  final String? focusProposalId;

  const AdminOrganizationDetailScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.orgId,
    required this.orgName,
    this.initialTab = 0,
    this.focusProposalId,
  });

  @override
  State<AdminOrganizationDetailScreen> createState() =>
      _AdminOrganizationDetailScreenState();
}

class _AdminOrganizationDetailScreenState
    extends State<AdminOrganizationDetailScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  static const green = Color(0xFF128058);
  static const dark = Color(0xFF073B2A);
  static const muted = Color(0xFF4D6F62);
  static const bg = Color(0xFFE6F7EE);
  static const mint = Color(0xFFDDF4E8);
  static const line = Color(0xFFB9E4CF);

  final db = Supabase.instance.client;
  late final TabController tabs;
  bool loading = true;
  Map<String, dynamic>? org;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> members = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> officers = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> advisers = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> events = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> proposals = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> finance = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  Map<String, String> proposalSubmitters = <String, String>{};
  double allocated = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    tabs = TabController(
      length: 4,
      vsync: this,
      initialIndex: widget.initialTab.clamp(0, 3),
    );
    _load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    tabs.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    if (mounted) setState(() => loading = true);
    try {
      final results = await Future.wait<dynamic>([
        db.from('organizations').select().eq('id', widget.orgId).maybeSingle(),
        db
            .from('members')
            .select('id,name,position,profile_id')
            .eq('org_id', widget.orgId),
        db
            .from('profiles')
            .select('id,name,email,role,avatar_url')
            .or('assigned_org_id.eq.${widget.orgId},org_id.eq.${widget.orgId}')
            .order('name'),
        db
            .from('events')
            .select('*')
            .eq('org_id', widget.orgId)
            .order('date', ascending: false),
        db
            .from('event_requests')
            .select('*')
            .eq('org_id', widget.orgId)
            .order('created_at', ascending: false),
        db
            .from('org_financial_transactions')
            .select('*')
            .eq('org_id', widget.orgId)
            .order('transaction_date', ascending: false),
      ]);

      final organization = results[0] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
      final memberRows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[1] as List);
      final profileRows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[2] as List);
      final eventRows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[3] as List);
      final proposalRows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[4] as List);
      final financeRows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[5] as List);

      final submitterNames = <String, String>{};
      for (final person in profileRows) {
        final id = person['id']?.toString() ?? '';
        final name = person['name']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
        final email = person['email']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
        if (id.isNotEmpty) {
          submitterNames[id] = name.isNotEmpty
              ? name
              : (email.isNotEmpty ? email : 'Organization user');
        }
      }

      if (widget.focusProposalId != null) {
        proposalRows.sort((a, b) {
          final aMatch = a['id']?.toString() == widget.focusProposalId ? 0 : 1;
          final bMatch = b['id']?.toString() == widget.focusProposalId ? 0 : 1;
          return aMatch.compareTo(bMatch);
        });
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        org = organization;
        members = memberRows;
        officers = profileRows
            .where((x) => x['role']?.toString() == 'officer')
            .toList();
        advisers = profileRows
            .where((x) => x['role']?.toString() == 'adviser')
            .toList();
        events = eventRows;
        proposals = proposalRows;
        proposalSubmitters = submitterNames;
        finance = financeRows;
        allocated =
            (organization?['allocated_budget'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => loading = false);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Could not load organization: $error')));
    }
  }

  double get income => finance
      .where((x) => x['type'] == 'income')
      .fold(0.0, (sum, x) => sum + ((x['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0));
  double get expenses => finance
      .where((x) => x['type'] == 'expense')
      .fold(0.0, (sum, x) => sum + ((x['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0));
  double get balance => allocated + income - expenses;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final currentOrg = org;
    final logo = currentOrg?['logo_asset']?.toString() ?? '';
    final category = currentOrg?['category']?.toString() ?? 'Organization';

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: bg,
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: loading
            ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: green))
            : Column(
                children: [
                  _hero(currentOrg, logo, category),
                  Container(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    child: TabBar(
                      controller: tabs,
                      labelColor: green,
                      unselectedLabelColor: muted,
                      indicatorColor: green,
                      indicatorWeight: 3,
                      dividerColor: Colors.transparent,
                      isScrollable: true,
                      tabs: const [
                        Tab(
                            icon: Icon(Icons.dashboard_rounded, size: 18),
                            text: 'Overview'),
                        Tab(
                            icon: Icon(Icons.groups_rounded, size: 18),
                            text: 'People'),
                        Tab(
                            icon: Icon(Icons.event_rounded, size: 18),
                            text: 'Events & Proposals'),
                        Tab(
                            icon: Icon(Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded,
                                size: 18),
                            text: 'Liquidation'),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  Expanded(
                      child: TabBarView(controller: tabs, children: [
                    _overview(),
                    _people(),
                    _events(),
                    _liquidation()
                  ])),
                ],
              ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _logo(String asset, double size) {
    Widget image;
    if (asset.startsWith('http')) {
      image = Image.network(asset,
          fit: BoxFit.cover, errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _logoFallback());
    } else if (asset.isNotEmpty) {
      image = Image.asset(asset.startsWith('assets/') ? asset : 'assets/$asset',
          fit: BoxFit.cover, errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _logoFallback());
    } else {
      image = _logoFallback();
    }
    return Container(
        width: size,
        height: size,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
        decoration:
            const BoxDecoration(color: Colors.white, shape: BoxShape.circle),
        child: ClipOval(child: image));
  }

  Widget _events() {
    Map<String, dynamic>? focused;
    if (widget.focusProposalId != null) {
      for (final proposal in proposals) {
        final status = proposal['status']?.toString() ?? '';
        if (proposal['id']?.toString() == widget.focusProposalId &&
            status == 'forwarded_to_admin') {
          focused = proposal;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    final history = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(proposals);

    return _scrollBody([
      _sectionTitle('Events & Proposals',
          'Upcoming events and saved proposal history for this organization'),
      const SizedBox(height: 10),
      _card(Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        const Text('Upcoming Event',
            style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: dark)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        ...(() {
          final now = DateTime.now();
          final upcoming = events.where((e) {
            final raw = e['date']?.toString();
            final date = raw == null ? null : DateTime.tryParse(raw);
            return date != null &&
                !date.isBefore(DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day));
          }).toList()
            ..sort((a, b) => (DateTime.tryParse(a['date']?.toString() ?? '') ??
                    DateTime(9999))
                .compareTo(DateTime.tryParse(b['date']?.toString() ?? '') ??
                    DateTime(9999)));
          return upcoming.isEmpty
              ? <Widget>[
                  const Text('No upcoming event scheduled.',
                      style: TextStyle(color: muted))
                ]
              : <Widget>[_eventRow(upcoming.first)];
        })(),
      ])),
      if (focused != null)
        _card(Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
          const Text('Proposal opened from Home',
              style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: dark)),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          const Text(
              'Review this proposal below before checking the rest of the organization activity.',
              style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 11.5, height: 1.35)),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          _proposalRow(focused),
        ])),
      _card(Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        const Text('Events',
            style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: dark)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        if (events.isEmpty)
          const Text('No events recorded yet.', style: TextStyle(color: muted))
        else
          ...events.take(30).map(_eventRow),
      ])),
      _card(Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        const Text('Proposal History',
            style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: dark)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        if (history.isEmpty)
          const Text('No approved or returned proposals yet.',
              style: TextStyle(color: muted))
        else

      ])),
    ]);
  }

                    style: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 11)),
                trailing: Text(
                    '${isIncome ? '+' : '-'} ${_money((row['amount'] as num? ?? 0).toDouble())}',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        color: isIncome ? Colors.green : Colors.red)),
              );
            }),
        ])),
      ]);

  Future<void> _setBudget() async {
    final controller =
        TextEditingController(text: allocated.toStringAsFixed(2));
    final value = await showDialog<double>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22)),
        title: const Text('Set CSO Budget'),
        content: TextField(
          controller: controller,
          keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
          decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Budget amount',
              prefixText: 'â‚± ',
              border: OutlineInputBorder()),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
              child: const Text('Cancel')),
          FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext,
                  double.tryParse(controller.text.replaceAll(',', '').trim())),
              child: const Text('Save')),
        ],
      ),
    );
    controller.dispose();
    if (value == null) return;
    if (value < 0) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(content: Text('Budget cannot be negative.')));
      }
      return;
    }
    try {
      await db
          .from('organizations')
          .update({'allocated_budget': value}).eq('id', widget.orgId);
      await _load();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
            content: Text('CSO budget updated.'), backgroundColor: green));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update budget: $error')));
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _addReimbursement() async {
    final amount = TextEditingController();
    final description = TextEditingController();
    final eventName = TextEditingController();
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22)),
        title: const Text('Add reimbursement'),
        content: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
            TextField(
                controller: amount,
                keyboardType:
                    const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Amount',
                    prefixText: 'â‚± ',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder())),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
                controller: description,
                maxLines: 2,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Expense description',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder())),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
                controller: eventName,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Event / activity (optional)',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder())),
          ]),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
              child: const Text('Cancel')),
          FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: green),
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
              child: const Text('Record expense')),
        ],
      ),
    );
    final amountValue = double.tryParse(amount.text.replaceAll(',', '').trim());
    final descriptionValue = description.text.trim();
    final eventValue = eventName.text.trim();
    amount.dispose();
    description.dispose();
    eventName.dispose();
    if (ok != true ||
        amountValue == null ||
        amountValue <= 0 ||
        descriptionValue.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await db.from('org_financial_transactions').insert({
        'org_id': widget.orgId,
        'type': 'expense',
        'amount': amountValue,
        'description': 'Reimbursement: $descriptionValue',
        'transaction_date': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        'event_name': eventValue,
        'category': 'reimbursement',
      });
      await _load();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Reimbursement added to expenses.'),
            backgroundColor: green));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      try {
        await db.from('org_financial_transactions').insert({
          'org_id': widget.orgId,
          'type': 'expense',
          'amount': amountValue,
          'description': 'Reimbursement: $descriptionValue',
          'transaction_date': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        });
        await _load();
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
              content: Text('Reimbursement added to expenses.'),
              backgroundColor: green));
        }
      } catch (retryError) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
              content: Text('Could not record reimbursement: $retryError')));
        }
      }
    }
  }

  Widget _proposalRow(Map<String, dynamic> proposal) {
    final status = proposal['status']?.toString() ?? 'pending';

  Future<void> _reviewProposal(
      Map<String, dynamic> proposal, bool approve) async {
    final feedback = TextEditingController();
    try {
      if (!approve) {
        final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
          context: context,
          builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
            title: const Text('Return to Adviser'),
            content: TextField(
                controller: feedback,
                maxLines: 4,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Feedback', border: OutlineInputBorder())),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
                  child: const Text('Cancel')),
              FilledButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
                  child: const Text('Return')),
            ],
          ),
        );
        if (confirmed != true) return;
      }
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final message = approve
          ? 'The proposal â€œ${proposal['title'] ?? 'Activity Proposal'}â€ was approved by the Admin / CSO. The adviser can now ask the officer to prepare the final posting.'
          : 'The proposal â€œ${proposal['title'] ?? 'Activity Proposal'}â€ was returned by the Admin / CSO. Feedback: ${feedback.text.trim()}';
      await db.from('event_requests').update({
        'status': approve ? 'admin_approved' : 'admin_rejected',
        'admin_feedback': feedback.text.trim(),
        'admin_reviewed_at': now.toIso8601String(),
        'reviewed_by': db.auth.currentUser?.id,
        'updated_at': now.toIso8601String(),
      }).eq('id', proposal['id']);
      try {
        await db.from('notifications').insert({
          'id': DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
          'title': approve
              ? 'Proposal Approved by Admin / CSO'
              : 'Proposal Returned by Admin / CSO',
          'message': message,
          'date': now.toIso8601String(),
          'read': false,
          'org_id': widget.orgId,
          'student_id': null,
        });
      } catch (_) {}
      await _load();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
            content: Text(approve
                ? 'Proposal approved.'
                : 'Proposal returned to adviser.'),
            backgroundColor: green));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update proposal: $error')));
      }
    } finally {
      feedback.dispose();
    }
  }

  Widget _status(String text) => Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 6),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: green.withValues(alpha: .10),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30)),
      child: Text(text.replaceAll('_', ' '),
          style: const TextStyle(
              color: dark, fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)));
  String _date(dynamic value) {
    final date = DateTime.tryParse('${value ?? ''}');
    return date == null ? 'No date' : '${date.month}/${date.day}/${date.year}';
  }

  String _money(double value) => 'â‚±${NumberFormat('#,##0.00').format(value)}';
}
