import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import '../auth/unified_login_page.dart';
import '../../widgets/app_header.dart';

class AdminProfileScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AdminProfileScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<AdminProfileScreen> createState() => _AdminProfileScreenState();
}

class _AdminProfileScreenState extends State<AdminProfileScreen> {
  static const _primary = Color(0xFF16A34A);
  static const _bg = Color(0xFFF3FAF5);
  static const _slate0F = Color(0xFF0F2D22);
  static const _slate94 = Color(0xFF64748B);
  static const _red = Color(0xFFDC2626);

  final _db = Supabase.instance.client;
  final _name = TextEditingController();
  final _email = TextEditingController();
  final _contact = TextEditingController();
  final _facebook = TextEditingController();

  Uint8List? _avatarBytes;
  String _avatarUrl = '';
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _saving = false;
  bool _editing = false;
  bool _showZoom = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _name.dispose();
    _email.dispose();
    _contact.dispose();
    _facebook.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final user = _db.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      final profile = await _db
          .from('profiles')
          .select('name,email,contact,facebook,avatar_url')
          .eq('id', user.id)
          .maybeSingle();
      if (profile != null) {
        _name.text = '${profile['name'] ?? ''}';
        _email.text = '${profile['email'] ?? user.email ?? ''}';
        _contact.text = '${profile['contact'] ?? ''}';
        _facebook.text = '${profile['facebook'] ?? ''}';
        _avatarUrl = '${profile['avatar_url'] ?? ''}';
      } else {
        _email.text = user.email ?? '';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Could not load profile: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }



  Future<String?> _uploadAvatar() async {
    if (_avatarBytes == null) return null;
    final user = _db.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return null;

    final path =
        'admin_profiles/${user.id}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.jpg';
    await _db.storage.from('avatar').uploadBinary(
          path,
          _avatarBytes!,
          fileOptions: const FileOptions(
            contentType: 'image/jpeg',
            upsert: true,
          ),
        );
    return _db.storage.from('avatar').getPublicUrl(path);
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final user = _db.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;
    setState(() => _saving = true);
    try {
      final uploaded = await _uploadAvatar();
      final values = <String, dynamic>{
        'name': _name.text.trim(),
        'email': _email.text.trim(),
        'contact': _contact.text.trim(),
        'facebook': _facebook.text.trim(),
      };
      if (uploaded != null) {
        values['avatar_url'] = uploaded;
      }
      await _db.from('profiles').update(values).eq('id', user.id);
      if (uploaded != null) _avatarUrl = uploaded;
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _saving = false;
        _editing = false;
        _avatarBytes = null;
      });
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Profile updated successfully.'),
          backgroundColor: _primary,
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _saving = false);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Could not update profile: $e'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _changePassword() async {
    final password = TextEditingController();
    final confirm = TextEditingController();
    bool obscurePassword = true;
    bool obscureConfirm = true;
    bool changing = false;

    final changed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (dialogContext, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22)),
          title: const Row(
            children: [
              _IconBox(icon: Icons.lock_reset_rounded, color: _primary),
              SizedBox(width: 10),
              Text('Change Password'),
            ],
          ),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              TextField(
                controller: password,
                obscureText: obscurePassword,
                enabled: !changing,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'New password',
                  hintText: 'At least 6 characters',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock_outline),
                  suffixIcon: IconButton(
                    onPressed: () => setDialogState(
                      () => obscurePassword = !obscurePassword,
                    ),
                    icon: Icon(
                      obscurePassword ? Icons.visibility_off : Icons.visibility,
                    ),
                  ),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              TextField(
                controller: confirm,
                obscureText: obscureConfirm,
                enabled: !changing,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Confirm password',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.verified_user_outlined),
                  suffixIcon: IconButton(
                    onPressed: () => setDialogState(
                      () => obscureConfirm = !obscureConfirm,
                    ),
                    icon: Icon(
                      obscureConfirm ? Icons.visibility_off : Icons.visibility,
                    ),
                  ),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed:
                  changing ? null : () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
              child: const Text('Cancel'),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: _primary),
              onPressed: changing
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      final newPassword = password.text.trim();
                      final confirmPassword = confirm.text.trim();
                      if (newPassword.length < 6) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(dialogContext).showSnackBar(
                          const SnackBar(
                            content:
                                Text('Password must be at least 6 characters.'),
                          ),
                        );
                        return;
                      }
                      if (newPassword != confirmPassword) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(dialogContext).showSnackBar(
                          const SnackBar(
                            content: Text('Passwords do not match.'),
                          ),
                        );
                        return;
                      }
                      setDialogState(() => changing = true);
                      try {
                        await _db.auth.updateUser(
                          UserAttributes(password: newPassword),
                        );
                        if (dialogContext.mounted) {
                          Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true);
                        }
                      } catch (e) {
                        if (dialogContext.mounted) {
                          setDialogState(() => changing = false);
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(dialogContext).showSnackBar(
                            SnackBar(
                              content: Text('Could not change password: $e'),
                            ),
                          );
                        }
                      }
                    },
              child: changing
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 18,
                      height: 18,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                        strokeWidth: 2,
                        color: Colors.white,
                      ),
                    )
                  : const Text('Update Password'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );

    password.dispose();
    confirm.dispose();
    if (changed == true && mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Password updated successfully.'),
          backgroundColor: _primary,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _logout() async {
    final shouldLogout = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: const Text('Log out?'),
        content: const Text(
          'You will need to sign in again to access the admin dashboard.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: _red),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
            child: const Text('Log out'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (shouldLogout != true || !mounted) return;

    try {
      await _db.auth.signOut();
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const UnifiedLoginPage()),
        (_) => false,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Could not log out: $e'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  ImageProvider? _imageProvider() {
    if (_avatarBytes != null) return MemoryImage(_avatarBytes!);
    if (_avatarUrl.trim().isNotEmpty) return NetworkImage(_avatarUrl);
    return null;
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

class AdviserAccountsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String orgId, orgName;
  const AdviserAccountsScreen({super.key, required this.orgId, required this.orgName});

  @override
  State<AdviserAccountsScreen> createState() => _AdviserAccountsScreenState();
}

class _AdviserAccountsScreenState extends State<AdviserAccountsScreen> {
  static const green = Color(0xFF128058);
  static const dark = Color(0xFF12352A);
  static const muted = Color(0xFF4D6F62);
  static const bg = Color(0xFFE6F7EE);
  static const card = Color(0xFFF5FFF9);

  final db = Supabase.instance.client;
  bool loading = true;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> members = [];
  final ScrollController _accountsScrollController = ScrollController();

  // Organization positions that use the Officer area. Member is intentionally
  // excluded and remains a regular student account. The adviser assigns each
  // member's own login account; there is no shared officer account.
  static const officerPositions = <String>[
    'President',
    'Vice President',
    'Secretary',
    'Assistant Secretary',
    'Treasurer',
    'Officer',
  ];

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _accountsScrollController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    if (mounted) setState(() => loading = true);
    try {
      // Supabase `members` is the single source of truth. Officers must have
      // an actual membership row for this organization, so we never fabricate
      // member records from `profiles.role` or `assigned_org_id`.
      final response = await db
          .from('members')
          .select('id,name,position,profile_id,profiles(id,name,email,role,active,avatar_url,student_id)')
          .eq('org_id', widget.orgId)
          .order('name');
      final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(response as List);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => members = rows);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) _snack('Could not load accounts: $e', true);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> changeRole(Map<String, dynamic> member) async {
    final profile = member['profiles'];
    if (profile is! Map || profile['id'] == null) {
      _snack('This member is not linked to a login account.', true);
      return;
    }

    final name = profile['name']?.toString().trim().isNotEmpty == true
        ? profile['name'].toString()
        : member['name']?.toString() ?? 'Member';
    final current = member['position']?.toString() ?? 'Member';
    String position = officerPositions.contains(current) ? current : 'Member';

    final result = await showDialog<String?>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
          title: Row(children: [
            const Icon(Icons.workspace_premium_rounded, color: green),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(child: Text('Assign position to $name', maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)),
          ]),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              const Text(
                'Choose the memberâ€™s organization designation. Officer designations can access the Officer area according to their permissions; Member remains a regular student role.',
                style: TextStyle(color: muted, height: 1.4, fontSize: 12.5),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              const Text('Organization position', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: dark)),
              const SizedBox(height: 7),
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                initialValue: position,
                isExpanded: true,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.badge_rounded, color: green),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
                ),
                items: [
                  ...officerPositions.map((v) => DropdownMenuItem(value: v, child: Text(v))),
                  const DropdownMenuItem(value: 'Member', child: Text('Member')),
                ],
                onChanged: (v) => setDialogState(() => position = v ?? 'Member'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx), child: const Text('Cancel')),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: green, foregroundColor: Colors.white),
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, position),
              child: const Text('Save Position'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (result == null) return;
    final makeOfficer = officerPositions.contains(result);

    try {
      // The member keeps their own Supabase account. Assigning an officer
      // position changes access on that account; no shared officer account is created.
      await db.from('profiles').update({
        'role': makeOfficer ? 'officer' : 'student',
        'assigned_org_id': makeOfficer ? widget.orgId : null,
      }).eq('id', profile['id'].toString());

      await db.from('members').update({
        'position': result,
      }).eq('id', member['id'].toString()).eq('org_id', widget.orgId);

      if (!mounted) return;
      _snack(makeOfficer ? '$name is now $result and can access the Officer area.' : '$name is now a regular member.');
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      _snack('Could not change position: $e', true);
    }
  }

  void _snack(String message, [bool error = false]) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(message),
        backgroundColor: error ? Colors.red.shade700 : green,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: bg,
      body: loading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: green))
          : SafeArea(
              child: Container(
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                    colors: [Color(0xFFF1FCF6), Color(0xFFE1F6EB), Color(0xFFD1EFDF)],
                  ),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    // The green header stays fixed; scrolling starts with the
                    // Students / Officers / Members section below it.
                    _accountHeader(),
                    Expanded(
                      child: RefreshIndicator(
                        color: green,
                        backgroundColor: card,
                        onRefresh: load,
                        child: Scrollbar(
                          controller: _accountsScrollController,
                          thumbVisibility: true,
                          trackVisibility: true,
                          radius: const Radius.circular(10),
                          thickness: 7,
                          child: ListView(
                            controller: _accountsScrollController,
                            physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(parent: BouncingScrollPhysics()),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 18, 16, 34),
                            children: [
                              const SizedBox(height: 4),
                              Row(
                                children: [
                                  const Expanded(
                                    child: Text(
                                      'Organization Members',
                                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: dark),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  Text(
                                    '${members.length} total',
                                    style: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 10),
                              if (members.isEmpty)
                                _empty()
                              else
                                ...members.asMap().entries.map((e) => _memberCard(e.value, e.key)),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
    );
  }

                          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, height: 1.0),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ));

  Widget _memberCard(Map<String, dynamic> member, int index) {
    final p = member['profiles'];
    final x = p is Map ? p : <String, dynamic>{};
    final role = x['role']?.toString() ?? 'student';
    final officer = role == 'officer';
    final avatar = x['avatar_url']?.toString() ?? '';
    final name = x['name']?.toString().trim().isNotEmpty == true
        ? x['name'].toString()
        : member['name']?.toString() ?? 'Member';
    final active = x['active'] == true;
    final position = member['position']?.toString() ?? 'Member';

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(15),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: card,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(23),
        border: Border.all(color: green.withValues(alpha: .09)),
        boxShadow: [BoxShadow(color: green.withValues(alpha: .055), blurRadius: 16, offset: const Offset(0, 6))],
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Stack(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 58,
                height: 58,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  color: officer ? green.withValues(alpha: .18) : const Color(0xFFDBEAFE),
                ),
                child: CircleAvatar(
                  backgroundColor: officer ? const Color(0xFFE0F7EA) : const Color(0xFFEFF6FF),
                  backgroundImage: avatar.isNotEmpty ? NetworkImage(avatar) : null,
                  child: avatar.isEmpty
                      ? Icon(officer ? Icons.workspace_premium_rounded : Icons.person_rounded, color: officer ? green : const Color(0xFF2563EB), size: 27)
                      : null,
                ),
              ),
              Positioned(
                right: 1,
                bottom: 1,
                child: Container(
                  width: 12,
                  height: 12,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: active ? green : Colors.grey,
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    border: Border.all(color: card, width: 2),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 13),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(name, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: dark, fontSize: 15)),
                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                Text(x['email']?.toString() ?? 'No email linked', maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted)),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Row(
                  children: [

                      child: Text(officer ? position.toUpperCase() : 'MEMBER', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 9, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: green, letterSpacing: .45)),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 7),
                    Text(active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: active ? green : muted)),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Change member role',
            icon: const Icon(Icons.keyboard_arrow_down_rounded, color: green, size: 28),
            onPressed: () => changeRole(member),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _empty() => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),

          ],
        ),
      );
}

import 'adviser_accounts_screen.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AdviserDashboard extends StatefulWidget {
  final String orgId, orgName;

      {super.key, required this.orgId, required this.orgName});
  @override
  State<AdviserDashboard> createState() => _AdviserDashboardState();

class _AdviserDashboardState extends State<AdviserDashboard> {
  static const green = Color(0xFF128058);
  static const dark = Color(0xFF073B2A);
  static const muted = Color(0xFF4D6F62);
  static const bg = Color(0xFFE6F7EE);
  static const card = Color(0xFFF5FFF9);
  static const mint = Color(0xFFDDF4E8);
  static const line = Color(0xFFB9E4CF);
  final _db = Supabase.instance.client;
  int _tab = 0;
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _loadedOnce = false; // NEW
  bool _showAllPublishedEvents = false;
  bool _showAllProposals = false;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _requests = [], _events = [], _posts = [];
  String _avatarUrl = '';
  String _userName = '';
  DateTime? _proposalSeenAt;
  RealtimeChannel? _proposalChannel;
  static const _finalBriefMarker = '[ADVISER_FINAL_LAYOUT_REQUESTED]';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      AppState.instance.setRole(UserRole.adviser);
      AppState.instance.setCurrentOfficerOrgId(widget.orgId);
    });
    _loadProposalSeenAt();
    _load();
    _proposalChannel = _db.channel(
        'adviser-proposals-${widget.orgId}-${_db.auth.currentUser?.id ?? 'local'}')
      ..onPostgresChanges(
        event: PostgresChangeEvent.all,
        schema: 'public',
        table: 'event_requests',
        filter: PostgresChangeFilter(
            type: PostgresChangeFilterType.eq,
            column: 'org_id',
            value: widget.orgId),
        callback: (_) => _load(),
      )
      ..subscribe();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    final channel = _proposalChannel;
    if (channel != null) {
      _db.removeChannel(channel);
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    // Full-screen spinner only on the very first load.
    // Later calls refresh silently in the background.
    if (mounted && !_loadedOnce) setState(() => _loading = true);
    try {
      final results = await Future.wait([
        _db
            .from('event_requests')
            .select('*')
            .eq('org_id', widget.orgId)
            .order('created_at', ascending: false),
        _db
            .from('events')
            .select('*')
            .eq('org_id', widget.orgId)
            .order('date', ascending: false),
        _db
            .from('notifications')
            .select('id,title,message,date,created_at')
            .eq('org_id', widget.orgId)
            .isFilter('student_id', null)
            .order('created_at', ascending: false),
        _db
            .from('profiles')
            .select('name,avatar_url')
            .eq('id', _db.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '')
            .maybeSingle(),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _requests = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[0] as List);
        _events = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[1] as List)
          ..sort((a, b) => ('${b['date'] ?? b['created_at'] ?? ''}')
              .compareTo('${a['date'] ?? a['created_at'] ?? ''}'));
        // Announcements are adviser-authored posts. Proposal workflow notifications
        // share the notifications table, so exclude them from the Announcements feed.
        _posts =
            List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[2] as List).where((post) {
          final title = post['title']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
          final message = post['message']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
          final combined = '$title $message';
          final isProposalNotice = combined.contains('proposal') ||
              combined.contains('final pictures') ||
              combined.contains('creative submitted') ||
              combined.contains('approved and published') ||
              combined.contains('final posting sent to adviser') ||
              combined.contains('final layout') ||
              combined.contains('adviser review') ||
              combined.contains('forwarded to admin / cso') ||
              combined.contains('revision requested') ||
              combined.contains('sent back to officers');
          return !isProposalNotice;
        }).toList();
        final profile = results[3] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
        _avatarUrl = profile?['avatar_url']?.toString() ?? '';
        _userName = profile?['name']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
        _loading = false; // NEW
        _loadedOnce = true; // NEW
      });
      if (_proposalSeenAt == null && _requests.isNotEmpty) {
        final stamps = _requests
            .map(_proposalTimestamp)
            .whereType<DateTime>()
            .where((d) => !d.isAfter(DateTime.now()))
            .toList();
        if (stamps.isNotEmpty) {
          stamps.sort();
          final latest = stamps.last;
          _proposalSeenAt = latest;
          final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
          await prefs.setString('adviser_proposal_seen_at_${widget.orgId}',
              latest.toIso8601String());
        }
      }
      // Keep the shared member store in sync. The Organization member screen
      // reads AppState.members rather than this dashboard's private list.
      await AppState.instance.fetchMembers();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _loading = false);
        _snack('Unable to load adviser dashboard: $e', true);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadProposalSeenAt() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString('adviser_proposal_seen_at_${widget.orgId}');
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _proposalSeenAt = raw == null ? null : DateTime.tryParse(raw);
    });
  }

  DateTime? _proposalTimestamp(Map<String, dynamic> r) {
    return DateTime.tryParse(r['created_at']?.toString() ?? '') ??
        DateTime.tryParse(r['updated_at']?.toString() ?? '');
  }

  bool get _hasUnreadProposalNotice {
    final seen = _proposalSeenAt;
    if (seen == null) return false;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    return _requests.any((r) {
      final status = r['status']?.toString();
      if (status != 'admin_approved' && status != 'creative_submitted') {
        return false;
      }
      final stamp = _proposalTimestamp(r);
      if (stamp == null || stamp.isAfter(now)) return false;
      return stamp.isAfter(seen);
    });
  }

  void _markProposalNotificationsSeen() {
    // Clear the badge immediately when Proposals is opened. Persist the cursor
    // in the background so navigation never races the async preferences write.
    final mark = DateTime.now();
    if (mounted) setState(() => _proposalSeenAt = mark);
    SharedPreferences.getInstance().then((prefs) {
      return prefs.setString(
        'adviser_proposal_seen_at_${widget.orgId}',
        mark.toIso8601String(),
      );
    });
  }

  String _visibleFeedback(dynamic value) {
    return (value?.toString() ?? '').replaceAll(_finalBriefMarker, '').trim();
  }

  bool _finalBriefSent(Map<String, dynamic> r) {
    return (r['feedback']?.toString() ?? '').contains(_finalBriefMarker);
  }

  Future<void> _tellOfficerToPrepareFinalLayout(Map<String, dynamic> r) async {
    final proposalTitle = r['title']?.toString() ?? 'Activity Proposal';
    final message =
        'Admin / CSO has approved â€œ$proposalTitleâ€. Please prepare the final event post with the activity picture, activity details, venue, date, start time, and end time, then send the final layout to me here for review. Organization members can also share design suggestions in this community chat.';
    try {
      await Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (_) => OrgCommunityChatScreen(
            orgId: widget.orgId,
            orgName: widget.orgName,
            initialMessage: message,
            onMessageSent: () async {
              if (_finalBriefSent(r)) return;
              final now = DateTime.now();
              final existing = _visibleFeedback(r['feedback']);
              final feedback = existing.isEmpty
                  ? _finalBriefMarker
                  : '$existing\n$_finalBriefMarker';
              try {
                await _db.from('event_requests').update({
                  'feedback': feedback,
                  'updated_at': now.toIso8601String(),
                }).eq('id', r['id']);
              } catch (_) {}
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
      await _load();
    } catch (e) {
      _snack('Could not open community chat: $e', true);
    }
  }

  void _snack(String s, [bool err = false]) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
        content: Text(s),
        backgroundColor: err ? Colors.red : green,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating));
  }

  DateTime? _parseFlexibleDate(dynamic value) {
    final raw = '${value ?? ''}'.trim();
    if (raw.isEmpty) return null;
    final iso = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
    if (iso != null) return iso;
    final mdy =
        RegExp(r'^(\d{1,2})[\-/](\d{1,2})[\-/](\d{4})$').firstMatch(raw);
    if (mdy != null) {
      final month = int.tryParse(mdy.group(1)!) ?? 0;
      final day = int.tryParse(mdy.group(2)!) ?? 0;
      final year = int.tryParse(mdy.group(3)!) ?? 0;
      if (year > 0 && month >= 1 && month <= 12 && day >= 1 && day <= 31) {
        return DateTime(year, month, day);
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  String _date(dynamic v) {
    final d = _parseFlexibleDate(v);
    if (d == null) return 'No date';
    return DateFormat('MMMM d, yyyy', 'en_US').format(d);
  }

  String _time(dynamic v) {
    final raw = '${v ?? ''}'.trim();
    if (raw.isEmpty) return '';
    final match = RegExp(r'^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?\s*([AaPp][Mm])?$')
        .firstMatch(raw);
    if (match == null) return raw;
    var hour = int.tryParse(match.group(1)!) ?? 0;
    final minute = int.tryParse(match.group(2)!) ?? 0;
    final suffix = match.group(3)?.toUpperCase();
    if (suffix == null) {
      if (hour < 0 || hour > 23 || minute < 0 || minute > 59) return raw;
      final isPm = hour >= 12;
      hour %= 12;
      if (hour == 0) hour = 12;
      return '${hour.toString()}:${minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} ${isPm ? 'PM' : 'AM'}';
    }
    if (hour < 1 || hour > 12 || minute < 0 || minute > 59) return raw;
    return '${hour.toString()}:${minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} $suffix';
  }

  String _eventDateTime(Map<String, dynamic> e) {
    final date = _date(e['date']);
    final start = _time(e['start_time']);
    final end = _time(e['end_time']);
    if (start.isEmpty) return date;
    return '$date â€¢ $start${end.isNotEmpty ? ' â€“ $end' : ''}';
  }

  List<String> _images(Map<String, dynamic> r) {
    final x = r['image_urls'];
    final y = r['creative_urls'];
    return [
      ...(x is List ? x.whereType<String>() : <String>[]),
      ...(y is List ? y.whereType<String>() : <String>[])
    ];
  }

  String _publicDescription(Map<String, dynamic> r) {
    final parts = <String>[];
    final purpose = r['purpose']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final description = r['description']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final venue = r['venue']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final start = r['start_time']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final end = r['end_time']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    if (purpose.isNotEmpty) parts.add('About: $purpose');
    if (description.isNotEmpty && description != purpose) {
      parts.add(description);
    }
    if (venue.isNotEmpty) parts.add('Venue: $venue');
    if (start.isNotEmpty) {
      parts.add('Time: ${end.isNotEmpty ? '$start â€“ $end' : start}');
    }
    return parts.join('\n');
  }

  String _publicDate(Map<String, dynamic> r) {
    final raw = DateTime.tryParse('${r['date'] ?? ''}');
    if (raw == null) return '${r['date'] ?? ''}';
    final start = r['start_time']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final m24 = RegExp(r'^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$').firstMatch(start);
    final m12 = RegExp(r'^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*([AaPp][Mm])$').firstMatch(start);
    if (m24 == null && m12 == null) return raw.toIso8601String();
    var hour = int.tryParse((m24 ?? m12)!.group(1)!) ?? raw.hour;
    final minute = int.tryParse((m24 ?? m12)!.group(2)!) ?? raw.minute;
    if (m12 != null) {
      final suffix = m12.group(3)!.toUpperCase();
      if (suffix == 'PM' && hour < 12) hour += 12;
      if (suffix == 'AM' && hour == 12) hour = 0;
    }
    return DateTime(raw.year, raw.month, raw.day, hour, minute)
        .toIso8601String();
  }

  Future<void> _sendAdminReturnToOfficers(Map<String, dynamic> r) async {
    final feedback = r['admin_feedback']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    try {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      await _db.from('event_requests').update({
        'status': 'pending',
        'feedback': feedback.isEmpty
            ? 'Please improve the proposal based on the Admin / CSO review.'
            : feedback,
        'adviser_reviewed_at': now.toIso8601String(),
        'reviewed_by': _db.auth.currentUser?.id,
        'updated_at': now.toIso8601String(),
      }).eq('id', r['id']);
      try {
        await _db.from('notifications').insert({
          'id': DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
          'title': 'Proposal Sent Back to Officers',
          'message':
              '${r['title'] ?? 'Activity Proposal'} needs improvement before it can be forwarded to Admin / CSO. ${feedback.isEmpty ? '' : feedback}',
          'date': now.toIso8601String(),
          'read': false,
          'org_id': widget.orgId,
          'student_id': null,
        });
      } catch (_) {}
      _snack(
          'The proposal was sent back to the officers with the Admin / CSO feedback.');
      await _load();
    } catch (e) {
      _snack('Could not send the proposal back to officers: $e', true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _forward(Map<String, dynamic> r) async {
    try {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      await _db.from('event_requests').update({
        'status': 'forwarded_to_admin',
        'adviser_reviewed_at': now.toIso8601String(),
        'reviewed_by': _db.auth.currentUser?.id,
        'updated_at': now.toIso8601String()
      }).eq('id', r['id']);
      try {
        await _db.from('notifications').insert({
          'id': DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
          'title': 'Proposal Forwarded to Admin / CSO',
          'message':
              '${r['title'] ?? 'Activity Proposal'} from ${widget.orgName} is ready for Admin / CSO review.',
          'date': now.toIso8601String(),
          'read': false,
          'org_id': widget.orgId,
          'student_id': null
        });
      } catch (_) {}
      _snack('Proposal forwarded to Admin / CSO.');
      await _load();
    } catch (e) {
      _snack('Could not forward proposal: $e', true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _requestRevision(Map<String, dynamic> r) async {
    final f = await _feedback(
        'Request Revision', 'Tell the officers what needs improvement.');
    if (f == null) return;
    try {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      await _db.from('event_requests').update({
        'status': 'revision_requested',
        'feedback': f,
        'adviser_reviewed_at': now.toIso8601String(),
        'reviewed_by': _db.auth.currentUser?.id,
        'updated_at': now.toIso8601String()
      }).eq('id', r['id']);
      try {
        await _db.from('notifications').insert({
          'id': DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
          'title': 'Proposal Revision Requested',
          'message':
              '${r['title'] ?? 'Activity Proposal'} needs improvement. Feedback: $f',
          'date': now.toIso8601String(),
          'read': false,
          'org_id': widget.orgId,
          'student_id': null
        });
      } catch (_) {}
      _snack('Revision sent back to officers.');
      await _load();
    } catch (e) {
      _snack('Could not request revision: $e', true);
    }
  }

  bool _publishing = false;

  Future<void> _publish(Map<String, dynamic> r) async {
    if (_publishing) return;
    _publishing = true;
    var claimed = false;
    var eventSaved = false;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    try {
      final imgs = _images(r);
      // Step 1: claim the proposal so it can never be published twice.
      final claim = await _db
          .from('event_requests')
          .update({
            'status': 'published',
            'published_at': now.toIso8601String(),
            'adviser_reviewed_at': now.toIso8601String(),
            'reviewed_by': _db.auth.currentUser?.id,
            'updated_at': now.toIso8601String()
          })
          .eq('id', r['id'])
          .eq('status', 'creative_submitted')
          .select();
      if ((claim as List).isEmpty) {
        _snack('This proposal was already published or changed. Refreshing.',
            true);
        await _load();
        return;
      }
      claimed = true;
      // Step 2: create the public event.
      await _db.from('events').insert({
        'title': r['title'],
        'date': _publicDate(r),
        'description': _publicDescription(r),
        'org_name': widget.orgName,
        'org_id': widget.orgId,
        'image_url': imgs.isEmpty ? null : imgs.first,
        'image_urls': imgs,
        'venue': (r['venue'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
        'start_time': (r['start_time'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty
            ? null
            : r['start_time'].toString().trim(),
        'end_time': (r['end_time'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty
            ? null
            : r['end_time'].toString().trim(),
      });
      eventSaved = true;
      try {
        await _db.from('notifications').insert({
          'id': DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
          'title': 'New Event',
          'message':
              '${r['title']} has been approved and published by ${widget.orgName}. It is now visible to guests, students, officers, advisers, and admins.',
          'date': now.toIso8601String(),
          'read': false,
          'org_id': widget.orgId,
          'student_id': null
        });
      } catch (_) {}
      _snack('Event published successfully.');
      await _load();
    } catch (e) {
      if (claimed && !eventSaved) {
        // Event was not created, so put the proposal back for another try.
        try {
          await _db.from('event_requests').update({
            'status': 'creative_submitted',
            'published_at': null,
            'updated_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String()
          }).eq('id', r['id']);
        } catch (_) {}
        await _load();
      }
      _snack('Could not publish event: $e', true);
    } finally {
      _publishing = false;
    }
  }

  Future<String?> _feedback(String title, String hint) async {
    final c = TextEditingController();
    final result = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (x) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
        title: Text(title),
        content: TextField(
            controller: c,
            maxLines: 5,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Feedback',
                hintText: hint,
                border: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)))),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(x), child: const Text('Cancel')),
          FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(
                  x,
                  c.text.trim().isEmpty
                      ? 'Please revise the submission.'
                      : c.text.trim()),
              child: const Text('Send')),
        ],
      ),
    );
    c.dispose();
    return result;
  }

  Future<void> _postAnnouncement() async {
    final t = TextEditingController(), m = TextEditingController();
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (x) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
        title: const Text('New Organization Announcement'),
        content: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
          TextField(
              controller: t,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Title')),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          TextField(
              controller: m,
              maxLines: 5,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Announcement')),
        ]),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(x, false),
              child: const Text('Cancel')),
          FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(x, true),
              child: const Text('Post')),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true || t.text.trim().isEmpty || m.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      t.dispose();
      m.dispose();
      return;
    }
    try {
      await _db.from('notifications').insert({
        'id': DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
        'title': t.text.trim(),
        'message': m.text.trim(),
        'date': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        'read': false,
        'org_id': widget.orgId,
        'student_id': null
      });
      _snack('Announcement posted.');
      await _load();
    } catch (e) {
      _snack('Could not post announcement: $e', true);
    }
    t.dispose();
    m.dispose();
  }

  Widget _eventCard(Map<String, dynamic> e) {
    final imgs = (e['image_urls'] is List ? e['image_urls'] : <dynamic>[])
        .whereType<String>()
        .toList();
    final url = e['image_url']?.toString();
    if (url != null && url.isNotEmpty && !imgs.contains(url)) {
      imgs.insert(0, url);
    }
    final eventId = e['id']?.toString() ?? '';
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFFF3FBF6), Color(0xFFE2F4E8)]),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
        border: Border.all(color: line),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
              color: green.withValues(alpha: .08),
              blurRadius: 16,
              offset: const Offset(0, 6))
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          if (imgs.isNotEmpty)
            SizedBox(
                height: 160,
                width: double.infinity,
                child: Image.network(imgs.first,
                    fit: BoxFit.cover,
                    errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _imagePlaceholder()))
          else
            _imagePlaceholder(),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 14),
            child:
                Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
              Text(e['title']?.toString() ?? 'Untitled event',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: dark)),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              Row(children: [
                const Icon(Icons.calendar_month_rounded,
                    size: 15, color: green),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text(_eventDateTime(e),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: muted,
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700))
              ]),
              if ((e['description'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 8),

                    maxLines: 4,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(

              ],
              if (eventId.isNotEmpty) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 10),

  Widget _detailPill(IconData icon, String text) => Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 7),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: mint,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
          border: Border.all(color: line.withValues(alpha: .75))),
      child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
        Icon(icon, size: 14, color: green),
        const SizedBox(width: 5),
        Text(text,
            style: const TextStyle(
                color: dark, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800))
      ]));

  Widget _actions(Map<String, dynamic> r, String s) {
    if (s == 'pending') {
      return Row(children: [
        Expanded(
            child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => _requestRevision(r),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_note_rounded),
                label: const Text('Ask Revision'))),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Expanded(
            child: FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => _forward(r),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.forward_rounded),
                label: const Text('Forward')))
      ]);
    }
    if (s == 'admin_approved') {
      if (_finalBriefSent(r)) {
        return const _StatusNote(
            icon: Icons.forum_rounded,
            text:
                'The Officer final-layout request was sent in Community Chat. Waiting for the officer to send the finished event post.');
      }
      return _statusAction(
          text: 'Tell Officers in Community Chat',
          icon: Icons.forum_rounded,
          onTap: () => _tellOfficerToPrepareFinalLayout(r));
    }
    if (s == 'adviser_to_officer') {
      return const _StatusNote(
          icon: Icons.forum_rounded,
          text:
              'The officer has been asked in Community Chat to prepare the final event post.');
    }
    if (s == 'admin_rejected') {
      return Row(children: [
        Expanded(
            child: _statusAction(
                text: 'Send to Officers',
                icon: Icons.reply_rounded,
                onTap: () => _sendAdminReturnToOfficers(r)))
      ]);
    }
    if (s == 'creative_submitted') {
      return Row(children: [
        Expanded(
            child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => _requestRevision(r),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.rate_review_outlined),
                label: const Text('Return to Officer'))),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Expanded(
            child: FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => _publish(r),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.publish_rounded),
                label: const Text('Approve & Publish')))
      ]);
    }
    if (s == 'revision_requested') {
      return const _StatusNote(
          icon: Icons.edit_note_rounded,
          text:
              'Revision requested. Waiting for officers to resubmit the improved proposal.');
    }
    if (s == 'forwarded_to_admin') return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return const SizedBox.shrink();
  }

  Widget _statusAction(
          {required String text,
          required IconData icon,
          required VoidCallback onTap}) =>
      SizedBox(
          width: double.infinity,
          child: FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: onTap,
              icon: Icon(icon, size: 17),
              label: Text(text),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: green)));

  Widget _feedbackBox(String title, String text) => Container(

      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(

          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFFDE68A))),
      child: Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
        const Icon(Icons.chat_bubble_outline_rounded,
            size: 17, color: Color(0xFFD97706)),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;
import 'package:printing/printing.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

class AdviserLiquidationScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String orgId;
  final String orgName;
  const AdviserLiquidationScreen(
      {super.key, required this.orgId, required this.orgName});
  @override
  State<AdviserLiquidationScreen> createState() =>
      _AdviserLiquidationScreenState();
}

class _AdviserLiquidationScreenState extends State<AdviserLiquidationScreen> {
  final _db = Supabase.instance.client;
  bool _loading = true;
  final Set<String> _expandedSemesters = <String>{};
  double _allocated = 0;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _transactions = [];
  String? _error;
  RealtimeChannel? _realtimeChannel;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load(showLoading: true);
    _realtimeChannel = _db
        .channel('adviser-liquidation-${widget.orgId}')
        .onPostgresChanges(
          event: PostgresChangeEvent.all,
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'org_financial_transactions',
          filter: PostgresChangeFilter(
            type: PostgresChangeFilterType.eq,
            column: 'org_id',
            value: widget.orgId,
          ),
          callback: (_) => _load(),
        )
        .onPostgresChanges(
          event: PostgresChangeEvent.all,
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'organizations',
          filter: PostgresChangeFilter(
            type: PostgresChangeFilterType.eq,
            column: 'id',
            value: widget.orgId,
          ),
          callback: (_) => _load(),
        )
        .subscribe();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    final channel = _realtimeChannel;
    if (channel != null) _db.removeChannel(channel);
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load({bool showLoading = false}) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (showLoading) {
      setState(() {
        _loading = true;
        _error = null;
      });
    }
    try {
      final results = await Future.wait<dynamic>([
        _db
            .from('organizations')
            .select('allocated_budget')
            .eq('id', widget.orgId)
            .maybeSingle(),
        _db
            .from('org_financial_transactions')
            .select('*')
            .eq('org_id', widget.orgId)
            .order('transaction_date', ascending: false),
      ]);
      final org = results[0] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _allocated = (org?['allocated_budget'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;
        _transactions = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[1] as List);
        _loading = false;
        _error = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _loading = false;
        _error =
            'Could not load liquidation details. Please check organization finance access.';
      });
    }
  }

  Map<String, Map<String, double>> _eventSummariesForSemester(String semester) {
    final result = <String, Map<String, double>>{};
    for (final row in _transactions) {
      final date = DateTime.tryParse(row['transaction_date']?.toString() ?? '');
      if (date == null) continue;
      final label = date.month >= 8 || date.month <= 1
          ? 'Semester 1 â€¢ ${date.month >= 8 ? date.year : date.year - 1}-${date.month >= 8 ? date.year + 1 : date.year}'
          : 'Semester 2 â€¢ ${date.year}';
      if (label != semester) continue;
      final event = row['event_name']?.toString().trim().isNotEmpty == true
          ? row['event_name'].toString().trim()
          : 'General organization funds';
      final bucket = result.putIfAbsent(
          event, () => {'income': 0.0, 'expense': 0.0, 'reimbursement': 0.0});
      final type = row['type']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? 'expense';
      final amount = (row['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;
      if (type == 'income') {
        bucket['income'] = bucket['income']! + amount;
      } else {
        bucket['expense'] = bucket['expense']! + amount;
        if (type == 'reimbursement' ||
            (row['category']
                    ?.toString()
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .startsWith('reimbursement') ??
                false) ||
            (row['description']
                    ?.toString()
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .startsWith('reimbursement:') ??
                false))
          bucket['reimbursement'] = bucket['reimbursement']! + amount;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  Future<void> _copyFinancialReport() async {
    final document = pw.Document();
    final semesterRows = _semesterSummaries().entries.toList();
    final transactions = _transactions;
    pw.Widget cell(String value, {bool bold = false}) => pw.Padding(
          padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(6),
          child: pw.Text(value,
              style: pw.TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 9,
                  fontWeight:
                      bold ? pw.FontWeight.bold : pw.FontWeight.normal)),
        );
    document.addPage(pw.MultiPage(
      pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
      margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(28),
      build: (context) => [
        pw.Center(
            child: pw.Column(children: [
          pw.Text('Financial Report',
              style:
                  pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 24, fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold)),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 5),
          pw.Text(widget.orgName,
              style:
                  pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold)),
          pw.Text('Generated ${DateFormat.yMMMMd().format(DateTime.now())}',
              style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9)),
        ])),
        pw.SizedBox(height: 18),
        pw.Text('Financial Summary',
            style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold)),
        pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
        pw.Table(
            border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey400, width: .5),
            children: [
              pw.TableRow(children: [
                cell('Budget allocated by Admin', bold: true),
                cell(_money(_allocated))
              ]),
              pw.TableRow(children: [
                cell('Total income', bold: true),
                cell(_money(_sum('income')))
              ]),
              pw.TableRow(children: [
                cell('Total expenses', bold: true),
                cell(_money(_sum('expense')))
              ]),
              pw.TableRow(children: [
                cell('Reimbursements', bold: true),
                cell(_money(_sum('reimbursement')))
              ]),
              pw.TableRow(children: [
                cell('Available balance', bold: true),
                cell(_money(_balance))
              ]),
            ]),
        pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
        pw.Text('Semester Summary',
            style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold)),
        pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
        if (semesterRows.isEmpty)
          pw.Text('No semester transactions recorded.')
        else
          pw.Table(
            border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey400, width: .5),
            children: [
              pw.TableRow(
                  children: [
                'Semester',
                'Income',
                'Expenses',
                'Reimbursements',
                'Profit'
              ].map((v) => cell(v, bold: true)).toList()),
              ...semesterRows.map((entry) => pw.TableRow(children: [
                    cell(entry.key),
                    cell(_money(entry.value['income']!)),
                    cell(_money(entry.value['expense']!)),
                    cell(_money(entry.value['reimbursement'] ?? 0)),
                    cell(_money(
                        entry.value['income']! - entry.value['expense']!)),
                  ])),
            ],
          ),
        pw.SizedBox(height: 16),
        pw.Text('Transaction Details',
            style: pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold)),
        pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
        if (transactions.isEmpty)
          pw.Text('No liquidation transactions have been recorded.')
        else
          pw.Table(
            border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey400, width: .5),
            columnWidths: {
              0: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.1),
              1: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.5),
              2: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(.9),
              3: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2),
              4: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1)
            },
            children: [
              pw.TableRow(
                  children: ['Date', 'Event', 'Type', 'Description', 'Amount']
                      .map((v) => cell(v, bold: true))
                      .toList()),
              ...transactions.map((row) => pw.TableRow(children: [
                    cell(row['transaction_date']?.toString() ?? ''),
                    cell(row['event_name']?.toString() ?? ''),
                    cell((row['type'] ?? '').toString().toUpperCase()),
                    cell((row['description'] ?? row['category'] ?? '')
                        .toString()),
                    cell(_money((row['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0)),
                  ])),
            ],
          ),
      ],
    ));
    await Printing.layoutPdf(
      name:
          'Financial_Report_${widget.orgName.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+'), '_')}.pdf',
      onLayout: (_) async => document.save(),
    );
  }

  Map<String, Map<String, double>> _semesterSummaries() {
    final result = <String, Map<String, double>>{};
    for (final row in _transactions) {
      final raw = DateTime.tryParse(row['transaction_date']?.toString() ?? '');
      if (raw == null) continue;
      final semester = raw.month >= 8 || raw.month <= 1
          ? 'Semester 1 â€¢ ${raw.month >= 8 ? raw.year : raw.year - 1}-${raw.month >= 8 ? raw.year + 1 : raw.year}'
          : 'Semester 2 â€¢ ${raw.year}';
      final bucket = result.putIfAbsent(semester,
          () => {'income': 0.0, 'expense': 0.0, 'reimbursement': 0.0});
      final type = row['type']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? 'expense';
      final amount = (row['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;
      if (type == 'income') {
        bucket['income'] = bucket['income']! + amount;
      } else {
        bucket['expense'] = bucket['expense']! + amount;
        if (type == 'reimbursement' ||
            (row['category']
                    ?.toString()
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .startsWith('reimbursement') ??
                false) ||
            (row['description']
                    ?.toString()
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .startsWith('reimbursement:') ??
                false))
          bucket['reimbursement'] = bucket['reimbursement']! + amount;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  bool _isReimbursement(Map<String, dynamic> r) {
    final t = r['type']?.toString().toLowerCase();
    return t == 'reimbursement' ||
        (r['category']?.toString().toLowerCase().startsWith('reimbursement') ??
            false) ||
        (r['description']
                ?.toString()
                .toLowerCase()
                .startsWith('reimbursement') ??
            false);
  }

  double _sum(String type) => _transactions.where((r) {
        final t = r['type']?.toString().toLowerCase();
        if (type == 'reimbursement')
          return t != 'income' && _isReimbursement(r);
        if (type == 'expense') return t == 'expense' || t == 'reimbursement';
        return t == type;
      }).fold(0.0, (sum, r) => sum + ((r['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0));

  double get _balance => _allocated + _sum('income') - _sum('expense');
  String _money(double n) =>
      NumberFormat.currency(locale: 'en_PH', symbol: 'â‚±', decimalDigits: 2)
          .format(n);

                                                    'Reimbursements',
                                                    event.value[
                                                            'reimbursement'] ??
                                                        0),
                                                const Divider(height: 15),
                                                _reportLine(
                                                    'Profit (income âˆ’ expenses)',
                                                    event.value['income']! -
                                                        event.value['expense']!,
                                                    bold: true)
                                              ]))),
                                    if (allEvents.length > 5)
                                      Align(
                                          alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                                          child: TextButton.icon(
                                              onPressed: () => setState(() {
                                                    if (_expandedSemesters
                                                        .contains(entry.key)) {
                                                      _expandedSemesters
                                                          .remove(entry.key);
                                                    } else {
                                                      _expandedSemesters
                                                          .add(entry.key);
                                                    }
                                                  }),
                                              icon: Icon(_expandedSemesters
                                                      .contains(entry.key)
                                                  ? Icons.expand_less_rounded
                                                  : Icons.expand_more_rounded),
                                              label: Text(_expandedSemesters
                                                      .contains(entry.key)
                                                  ? 'Show less'
                                                  : 'View all ${allEvents.length} events'))),
                                  ])),
                        );
                      }),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      if (_transactions.isEmpty)
                        const Card(
                            child: Padding(
                                padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
                                child: Text(
                                    'No liquidation transactions have been recorded yet.')))
                      else
                        ..._transactions.map((r) {
                          final type = r['type']?.toString().toLowerCase() ??
                              'transaction';
                          final date = DateTime.tryParse(
                              r['transaction_date']?.toString() ?? '');
                          return Card(
                            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                            elevation: 0,
                            color: Colors.white,
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                                side:
                                    const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFD1FAE5))),
                            child: ListTile(
                              leading: CircleAvatar(
                                  backgroundColor: type == 'income'
                                      ? const Color(0xFFDCFCE7)
                                      : const Color(0xFFFFEDD5),
                                  child: Icon(
                                      type == 'income'
                                          ? Icons.trending_up_rounded
                                          : Icons.receipt_long_rounded,
                                      color: type == 'income'
                                          ? const Color(0xFF15803D)
                                          : const Color(0xFFB45309))),
                              title: Text(
                                  r['description']
                                              ?.toString()
                                              .trim()
                                              .isNotEmpty ==
                                          true
                                      ? r['description'].toString()
                                      : (r['category']?.toString() ?? type),
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                              subtitle: Text(
                                  '${type.toUpperCase()}${date == null ? '' : ' â€¢ ${DateFormat.yMMMd().format(date)}'}${r['category'] == null ? '' : ' â€¢ ${r['category']}'}'),
                              trailing: Text(
                                  _money(
                                      (r['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0),
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
                            ),
                          );
                        }),
                    ],
                  ),
      );

  Widget _reportLine(String label, double value, {bool bold = false}) =>
      Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
          child: Row(children: [
            Expanded(
                child: Text(label,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: const Color(0xFF496657),
                        fontWeight: bold ? FontWeight.w900 : FontWeight.w500))),
            Text(_money(value),
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    color: const Color(0xFF073B2A),
                    fontWeight: bold ? FontWeight.w900 : FontWeight.w700))
          ]));

  Widget _amountCard(String label, double value, IconData icon) => Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFD1FAE5)),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
                color: const Color(0xFF15803D).withValues(alpha: .07),
                blurRadius: 20,
                offset: const Offset(0, 7))
          ],
        ),
        child: Row(children: [
          Container(
              width: 42,
              height: 42,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: const LinearGradient(
                      colors: [Color(0xFFDCFCE7), Color(0xFFCCFBF1)]),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
              child: Icon(icon, color: const Color(0xFF128058))),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
              child: Text(label,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: Color(0xFF4D6F62),
                      fontSize: 12))),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Flexible(
              child: Text(_money(value),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.end,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 15,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      color: Color(0xFF073B2A)))),
        ]),
      );
}
