                            child: const Icon(
                                Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded,
                                color: Colors.white,
                                size: 26),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                const Text('Treasurer Financial Report',
                                    maxLines: 2,
                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: Colors.white,
                                        fontSize: 20,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
                                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                Text(
                                    org?['name']?.toString() ??
                                        'Organization finances',
                                    maxLines: 1,
                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        color: Colors.white70,
                                        fontSize: 12,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                Expanded(
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, constraints) {
                          final columns = constraints.maxWidth >= 560
                              ? 4
                              : (constraints.maxWidth >= 360 ? 2 : 1);
                          final gap = 10.0;
                          final cardWidth =
                              (constraints.maxWidth - gap * (columns - 1)) /
                                  columns;
                          Widget metric(String label, String value,
                                  IconData icon, Color color) =>
                              Container(
                                width: cardWidth,
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: color.withValues(alpha: .08),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                        color: color.withValues(alpha: .22))),
                                child: Column(
                                    crossAxisAlignment:
                                        CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                    children: [
                                      Icon(icon, color: color, size: 21),
                                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                                      Text(label,
                                          style: const TextStyle(
                                              color: Color(0xFF48665A),
                                              fontSize: 11,
                                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                      Text(value,
                                          maxLines: 2,
                                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                          style: TextStyle(
                                              color: color,
                                              fontSize: 16,
                                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
                                    ]),
                              );
                          return Wrap(spacing: gap, runSpacing: gap, children: [
                            metric('Allocated budget', money(allocated),
                                Icons.savings_rounded, const Color(0xFF0F766E)),
                            metric(
                                'Total income',
                                money(income),
                                Icons.trending_up_rounded,
                                const Color(0xFF15803D)),
                            metric(
                                'Total expenses',
                                money(expenses),
                                Icons.trending_down_rounded,
                                const Color(0xFFB45309)),
                            metric(
                                'Available balance',
                                money(allocated + income - expenses),
                                Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded,
                                const Color(0xFF166534)),
                          ]);
                        }),
                        const SizedBox(height: 22),
                        Row(children: [
                          const Expanded(
                              child: Text('Transaction details',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 17,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                      color: Color(0xFF14532D)))),
                          Text(
                              '${rows.length} record${rows.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12,
                                  color: Color(0xFF64748B),
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ]),
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        if (rows.isEmpty)
                          Container(
                              width: double.infinity,
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(22),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: const Color(0xFFF0FDF4),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                                  border: Border.all(
                                      color: const Color(0xFFD1FAE5))),
                              child: const Column(children: [
                                Icon(Icons.receipt_long_rounded,
                                    size: 34, color: Color(0xFF16A34A)),
                                SizedBox(height: 8),
                                Text('No financial transactions recorded yet.',
                                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: Color(0xFF48665A),
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600))
                              ]))
                        else
                          ...(_showAllFinanceTransactions
                                  ? rows
                                  : rows.take(5).toList())
                              .map((r) {
                            final rawKind = (r['type'] ?? 'transaction')
                                .toString()
                                .toLowerCase();
                            final isReimb = rawKind == 'expense' &&
                                (r['category']?.toString().toLowerCase() ==
                                        'reimbursement' ||
                                    r['description']
                                            ?.toString()
                                            .toLowerCase()
                                            .startsWith('reimbursement') ==
                                        true);
                            final kind = isReimb ? 'reimbursement' : rawKind;
                            final color = kind == 'income'
                                ? const Color(0xFF15803D)
                                : (kind == 'reimbursement'
                                    ? const Color(0xFF7C3AED)
                                    : const Color(0xFFB45309));
                            final eventName =
                                r['event_name']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
                            final description =
                                r['description']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
                            final heading = eventName.isNotEmpty
                                ? eventName
                                : (description.isNotEmpty
                                    ? description
                                    : 'Transaction');
                            return Container(
                              width: double.infinity,
                              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: const Color(0xFFFAFFFB),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                                  border: Border.all(
                                      color: const Color(0xFFDCEFE2))),
                              child: Row(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: [
                                    Container(
                                        width: 42,
                                        height: 42,
                                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                            color: color.withValues(alpha: .10),
                                            borderRadius:
                                                BorderRadius.circular(13)),
                                        child: Icon(Icons.receipt_long_rounded,
                                            color: color)),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                                    Expanded(
                                        child: Column(
                                            crossAxisAlignment:
                                                CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                            children: [
                                          Text(heading,
                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                                  color: Color(0xFF173D2D),
                                                  fontSize: 14)),
                                          const SizedBox(height: 5),
                                          Wrap(
                                              spacing: 7,
                                              runSpacing: 5,
                                              crossAxisAlignment:
                                                  WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                                              children: [
                                                Text(
                                                    r['transaction_date']
                                                            ?.toString() ??
                                                        'Date not set',
                                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                                        fontSize: 12,
                                                        color:
                                                            Color(0xFF64748B))),
                                                Container(
                                                    padding: const EdgeInsets
                                                        .symmetric(
                                                        horizontal: 8,
                                                        vertical: 3),
                                                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                                        color: color.withValues(
                                                            alpha: .10),
                                                        borderRadius:
                                                            BorderRadius
                                                                .circular(20)),
                                                    child: Text(
                                                        kind.toUpperCase(),
                                                        style: TextStyle(
                                                            fontSize: 10,
                                                            fontWeight:
                                                                FontWeight.w900,
                                                            color: color))),
                                              ]),
                                          if (description.isNotEmpty &&
                                              description != heading) ...[
                                            const SizedBox(height: 6),
                                            Text(description,
                                                style: const TextStyle(
                                                    fontSize: 12,
                                                    height: 1.35,
                                                    color: Color(0xFF48665A))),
                                          ],
                                          if (r['category']
                                                  ?.toString()
                                                  .trim()
                                                  .isNotEmpty ==
                                              true) ...[
                                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                            Text('Category: ${r['category']}',
                                                style: const TextStyle(
                                                    fontSize: 11,
                                                    color: Color(0xFF64748B))),
                                          ],
                                        ])),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                    Flexible(
                                        child: Text(
                                            money((r['amount'] as num?)
                                                    ?.toDouble() ??
                                                0),
                                            textAlign: TextAlign.end,
                                            style: TextStyle(
                                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                                color: color,
                                                fontSize: 14))),
                                  ]),
                            );
                          }),
                        if (rows.length > 5)
                          Align(
                              alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                              child: TextButton.icon(
                                onPressed: () {
                                  setState(() => _showAllFinanceTransactions =
                                      !_showAllFinanceTransactions);
                                  Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                                  _viewFinanceReport(context, orgId);
                                },
                                icon: Icon(_showAllFinanceTransactions
                                    ? Icons.expand_less_rounded
                                    : Icons.expand_more_rounded),
                                label: Text(_showAllFinanceTransactions
                                    ? 'View latest 5'
                                    : 'View all ${rows.length} records'),
                              )),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      _snack('Could not load financial report: $e', Colors.red);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openTreasurerFinance(BuildContext context, String orgId) async {
    if (orgId.isEmpty) return;
    final amountCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final eventCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final descCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final categoryCtrl = TextEditingController();
    String type = 'expense';
    DateTime date = DateTime.now();
    final save = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (dialogContext) => StatefulBuilder(
            builder: (ctx, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
                  titlePadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 0),
                  title: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 14, vertical: 15),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          gradient: const LinearGradient(
                              colors: [Color(0xFF128058), Color(0xFF16A34A)]),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                      child: const Row(children: [
                        Icon(Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded,
                            color: Colors.white),
                        SizedBox(width: 10),
                        Expanded(
                            child: Text('Treasurer Financial Report',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    color: Colors.white,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                    fontSize: 17)))
                      ])),
                  content: SizedBox(
                      width: 420,
                      child: SingleChildScrollView(
                          child:
                              Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
                        DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                            initialValue: type,
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                                labelText: 'Transaction type'),
                            items: const [
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'expense',
                                  child: Text(
                                      'Expense / Paid from organization funds')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'income',
                                  child: Text('Income / Money received')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'reimbursement',
                                  child: Text(
                                      'Reimbursement (paid with personal money)'))
                            ],
                            onChanged: (v) {
                              if (v != null) setDialogState(() => type = v);
                            }),
                        TextField(
                            controller: eventCtrl,
                            decoration:
                                const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Event name')),
                        TextField(
                            controller: amountCtrl,
                            keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                                decimal: true),
                            decoration:
                                const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Amount (â‚±)')),
                        TextField(
                            controller: categoryCtrl,
                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                                labelText: type == 'reimbursement'
                                    ? 'Expense category (e.g. supplies, transport)'
                                    : 'Category (e.g. supplies, tickets)')),
                        if (type == 'reimbursement')
                          const Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                              child: Text(
                                  'Use this when a member paid an event expense using personal money. Submitting records it for the adviser to review.',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54))),
                        TextField(
                            controller: descCtrl,
                            maxLines: 2,
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                                labelText: 'Details / receipt notes')),
                        ListTile(
                            contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                            leading: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month_rounded),
                            title: const Text('Transaction date'),
                            subtitle: Text(
                                '${date.year}-${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}'),
                            onTap: () async {
                              final d = await showDatePicker(
                                  context: ctx,
                                  initialDate: date,
                                  firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                                  lastDate: DateTime(2100));
                              if (d != null) setDialogState(() => date = d);
                            }),
                        const Text(
                            'The adviser and admin can review these transactions in the organization financial report.',
                            style:
                                TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black54)),
                      ]))),
                  actions: [
                    TextButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
                        child: const Text('Cancel')),
                    FilledButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
                        child: const Text('Submit report'))
                  ],
                )));
    if (save != true) {
      amountCtrl.dispose();
      eventCtrl.dispose();
      descCtrl.dispose();
      categoryCtrl.dispose();
      return;
    }
    final amount = double.tryParse(amountCtrl.text.trim().replaceAll(',', ''));
    if (amount == null || amount <= 0 || eventCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      _snack('Enter a valid amount and event name.', Colors.orange);
      amountCtrl.dispose();
      eventCtrl.dispose();
      descCtrl.dispose();
      categoryCtrl.dispose();
      return;
    }
    try {
      final isReimbursement = type == 'reimbursement';
      final userCategory = categoryCtrl.text.trim();
      final userDetails = descCtrl.text.trim();
      final reimbursementText =
          [userCategory, userDetails].where((s) => s.isNotEmpty).join(' - ');
      await Supabase.instance.client.from('org_financial_transactions').insert({
        'org_id': orgId,
        'type': isReimbursement ? 'expense' : type,
        'amount': amount,
        'category': isReimbursement ? 'reimbursement' : userCategory,
        'description': isReimbursement
            ? 'Reimbursement: ${reimbursementText.isNotEmpty ? reimbursementText : eventCtrl.text.trim()}'
            : userDetails,
        'event_name': eventCtrl.text.trim(),
        'transaction_date':
            '${date.year}-${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
        'created_by': Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id,
      });
      _snack(
          type == 'reimbursement'
              ? 'Reimbursement submitted for adviser review.'
              : 'Financial transaction submitted.',
          _ok);
    } catch (e) {
      _snack('Could not submit financial transaction: $e', Colors.red);
    } finally {
      amountCtrl.dispose();
      eventCtrl.dispose();
      descCtrl.dispose();
      categoryCtrl.dispose();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _viewAttendance(
      BuildContext context, List<Member> members) async {
    final orgId =
        widget.organizationId ?? AppState.instance.currentOfficerOrgId;
    if (orgId == null || orgId.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      final db = Supabase.instance.client;
      final events = await _loadAttendanceActivities(orgId);
      if (!context.mounted) return;
      if (events.isEmpty) {
        _snack(
            'There are no attendance records yet. The Secretary can create an event or meeting from Record Attendance.',
            Colors.orange);
        return;
      }
      // Start on the activity/session that was most recently recorded, rather than
      // blindly showing the activity with the newest scheduled date (which may be empty).
      final latestAttendance = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
        await db
            .from('organization_member_attendance')
            .select('event_id,session,marked_at')
            .eq('org_id', orgId)
            .order('marked_at', ascending: false)
            .limit(1),
      );
      final latestEventId = latestAttendance.isEmpty
          ? null
          : latestAttendance.first['event_id']?.toString();
      final selectedActivity =
          events.where((e) => e['id']?.toString() == latestEventId).toList();
      String selectedEvent = selectedActivity.isNotEmpty
          ? selectedActivity.first['id'].toString()
          : (events.first['id']?.toString() ?? '');
      final selectedRow =
          latestAttendance.isNotEmpty && latestEventId == selectedEvent
              ? latestAttendance.first
              : null;
      bool isMeeting = events
              .firstWhere((e) => e['id']?.toString() == selectedEvent,
                  orElse: () => events.first)['activity_type']
              ?.toString()
              .toLowerCase() ==
          'meeting';
      // The database only permits 'morning' or 'afternoon' in the session column.
      // Meetings use the single stored 'morning' slot internally; the UI hides the session picker.
      String session = isMeeting
          ? 'morning'
          : ((selectedRow?['session']?.toString() == 'afternoon')
              ? 'afternoon'
              : 'morning');
      List<Map<String, dynamic>> records = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
          await db
              .from('organization_member_attendance')
              .select('profile_id,status,marked_at,session')
              .eq('org_id', orgId)
              .eq('event_id', selectedEvent)
              .eq('session', session));
      if (!context.mounted) return;
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        useSafeArea: false,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        builder: (dialogContext) =>
            StatefulBuilder(builder: (dialogContext, setDialogState) {
          final byProfile = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
            for (final row in records)
              if (row['profile_id'] != null) row['profile_id'].toString(): row
          };
          final presentCount = records
              .where((r) => r['status']?.toString().toLowerCase() == 'present')
              .length;
          final absentCount = records
              .where((r) => r['status']?.toString().toLowerCase() == 'absent')
              .length;
          final event = events.firstWhere(
              (e) => e['id']?.toString() == selectedEvent,
              orElse: () => events.first);
          return Scaffold(
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF0FDF4),
            appBar: PreferredSize(
                preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(160),
                child: _attendanceFullHeader(dialogContext, 'View Attendance',
                    Icons.fact_check_rounded)),
            body: SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                height: MediaQuery.of(dialogContext).size.height - 180,
                child: Scrollbar(
                    thumbVisibility: true,
                    interactive: true,
                    child: SingleChildScrollView(
                        primary: true,
                        child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 24),
                            child: Column(
                                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                children: [
                                  Row(children: [
                                    const Expanded(
                                        child: Text('LATEST ACTIVITY',
                                            style: TextStyle(
                                                fontSize: 11,
                                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                                letterSpacing: 1.0,
                                                color: _p))),
                                    OutlinedButton.icon(
                                      icon: const Icon(Icons.history_rounded,
                                          size: 17),
                                      label:
                                          Text('View All (${events.length})'),
                                      onPressed: () async {
                                        final chosen = await showDialog<
                                            Map<String, dynamic>>(
                                          context: dialogContext,
                                          builder: (pickerContext) =>
                                              AlertDialog(
                                            title: const Text(
                                                'All Attendance Activities'),
                                            content: SizedBox(
                                              width: 420,
                                              height:
                                                  MediaQuery.of(pickerContext)
                                                          .size
                                                          .height *
                                                      .55,
                                              child: ListView.separated(
                                                itemCount: events.length,
                                                separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                                                    const Divider(height: 1),
                                                itemBuilder:
                                                    (pickerContext, index) {
                                                  final item = events[index];
                                                  final itemId =
                                                      item['id']?.toString() ??
                                                          '';
                                                  return ListTile(
                                                    leading: Icon(
                                                      item['activity_type']
                                                                  ?.toString()
                                                                  .toLowerCase() ==
                                                              'meeting'
                                                          ? Icons.groups_rounded
                                                          : Icons.event_rounded,
                                                      color: _p,
                                                    ),
                                                    title: Text(
                                                        item['title']
                                                                ?.toString() ??
                                                            'Activity',
                                                        maxLines: 2,
                                                        overflow: TextOverflow
                                                            .ellipsis),
                                                    subtitle: Text(
                                                        '${_attendanceDateLabel(item['date'])} â€¢ ${(item['activity_type']?.toString() ?? 'event').toUpperCase()}'),
                                                    trailing: itemId ==
                                                            selectedEvent
                                                        ? const Icon(
                                                            Icons
                                                                .check_circle_rounded,
                                                            color: _p)
                                                        : const Icon(Icons
                                                            .chevron_right_rounded),
                                                    onTap: () => Navigator.pop(
                                                        pickerContext, item),
                                                  );
                                                },
                                              ),
                                            ),
                                            actions: [
                                              TextButton(
                                                  onPressed: () =>
                                                      Navigator.pop(
                                                          pickerContext),
                                                  child: const Text('Cancel'))
                                            ],
                                          ),
                                        );
                                        if (chosen == null ||
                                            !dialogContext.mounted) return;
                                        final nextId =
                                            chosen['id']?.toString() ?? '';
                                        final nextIsMeeting =
                                            chosen['activity_type']
                                                    ?.toString()
                                                    .toLowerCase() ==
                                                'meeting';
                                        final nextSession = nextIsMeeting
                                            ? 'morning'
                                            : 'morning';
                                        try {
                                          final rows = await db
                                              .from(
                                                  'organization_member_attendance')
                                              .select(
                                                  'profile_id,status,marked_at,session')
                                              .eq('org_id', orgId)
                                              .eq('event_id', nextId)
                                              .eq('session', nextSession);
                                          if (!dialogContext.mounted) return;
                                          selectedEvent = nextId;
                                          isMeeting = nextIsMeeting;
                                          session = nextSession;
                                          records =
                                              List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
                                                  rows as List);
                                          setDialogState(() {});
                                        } catch (e) {
                                          _snack(
                                              'Could not load this activity: $e',
                                              Colors.red);
                                        }
                                      },
                                    ),
                                  ]),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                  Container(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(13),
                                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                          color: const Color(0xFFF0FDF4),
                                          borderRadius:
                                              BorderRadius.circular(16),
                                          border: Border.all(
                                              color: const Color(0xFFD5F0DE))),
                                      child: Column(
                                          crossAxisAlignment:
                                              CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                          children: [
                                            Row(children: [
                                              Expanded(
                                                  child: Text(
                                                      event['title']
                                                              ?.toString() ??
                                                          'Event',
                                                      maxLines: 2,
                                                      overflow:
                                                          TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                                          fontSize: 16,
                                                          fontWeight:
                                                              FontWeight.w900,
                                                          color: Color(
                                                              0xFF14532D)))),
                                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                              Container(
                                                  padding: const EdgeInsets
                                                      .symmetric(
                                                      horizontal: 9,
                                                      vertical: 5),
                                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                                      color: const Color(
                                                          0xFFDDF5E5),
                                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius
                                                          .circular(20)),
                                                  child: Text(
                                                      (event['activity_type']
                                                                  ?.toString() ??
                                                              'event')
                                                          .toUpperCase(),
                                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                                          fontSize: 9,
                                                          fontWeight:
                                                              FontWeight.w900,
                                                          color: Color(
                                                              0xFF166534))))
                                            ]),
                                            const SizedBox(height: 9),
                                            Row(children: [
                                              const Icon(
                                                  Icons.calendar_month_rounded,
                                                  size: 17,
                                                  color: _p),
                                              const SizedBox(width: 7),
                                              Expanded(
                                                  child: Text(
                                                      _attendanceDateLabel(
                                                          event['date']),
                                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                                          fontWeight:
                                                              FontWeight.w700)))
                                            ]),
                                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                            Row(children: [
                                              const Icon(Icons.schedule_rounded,
                                                  size: 17, color: _p),
                                              const SizedBox(width: 7),
                                              Expanded(
                                                  child: Text(
                                                      _attendanceTimeLabel(
                                                          event['date']),
                                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                                          fontWeight:
                                                              FontWeight.w700)))
                                            ]),
                                          ])),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                  if (!isMeeting)
                                    _attendanceSessionPicker(
                                        session: session,
                                        onChanged: (value) async {
                                          try {
                                            final rows = await db
                                                .from(
                                                    'organization_member_attendance')
                                                .select(
                                                    'profile_id,status,marked_at,session')
                                                .eq('org_id', orgId)
                                                .eq('event_id', selectedEvent)
                                                .eq('session', value);
                                            if (!dialogContext.mounted) return;
                                            session = value;
                                            records =
                                                List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
                                                    rows as List);
                                            setDialogState(() {});
                                          } catch (e) {
                                            _snack(
                                                'Could not load this session: $e',
                                                Colors.red);
                                          }
                                        }),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                                  Text(
                                      '$presentCount present  â€¢  $absentCount absent  â€¢  ${members.length - records.length < 0 ? 0 : members.length - records.length} not recorded',
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                          color: _p,
                                          fontSize: 12)),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                  ConstrainedBox(
                                      constraints: BoxConstraints(
                                          maxHeight:
                                              MediaQuery.of(dialogContext)
                                                      .size
                                                      .height *
                                                  .52),
                                      child: Scrollbar(
                                          thumbVisibility: true,
                                          interactive: true,
                                          child: ListView.separated(
                                              shrinkWrap: true,
                                              itemCount: members.length,
                                              separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                                                  const Divider(height: 1),
                                              itemBuilder: (_, index) {
                                                final member = members[index];
                                                final row =
                                                    member.profileId == null
                                                        ? null
                                                        : byProfile[
                                                            member.profileId!];
                                                final status = row?['status']
                                                    ?.toString()
                                                    .toLowerCase();
                                                final isPresent =
                                                    status == 'present';
                                                return ListTile(
                                                  dense: true,
                                                  contentPadding:
                                                      EdgeInsets.zero,
                                                  leading: CircleAvatar(
                                                      radius: 17,
                                                      backgroundColor: status ==
                                                              null
                                                          ? Colors.grey.shade100
                                                          : isPresent
                                                              ? const Color(
                                                                  0xFFDCFCE7)
                                                              : const Color(
                                                                  0xFFFFE4E6),
                                                      child: Icon(
                                                          status == null
                                                              ? Icons
                                                                  .hourglass_empty_rounded
                                                              : isPresent
                                                                  ? Icons
                                                                      .check_rounded
                                                                  : Icons
                                                                      .close_rounded,
                                                          size: 18,
                                                          color: status == null
                                                              ? Colors.grey
                                                              : isPresent
                                                                  ? _p
                                                                  : Colors
                                                                      .redAccent)),
                                                  title: Text(member.name,
                                                      softWrap: true,
                                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                                          fontWeight:
                                                              FontWeight.w700)),
                                                  subtitle: Text(
                                                      member.position,
                                                      maxLines: 1,
                                                      overflow: TextOverflow
                                                          .ellipsis),
                                                  trailing: Text(
                                                      status == null
                                                          ? 'Not recorded'
                                                          : isPresent
                                                              ? 'Present'
                                                              : 'Absent',
                                                      style: TextStyle(
                                                          fontSize: 11,
                                                          fontWeight:
                                                              FontWeight.w800,
                                                          color: status == null
                                                              ? Colors.grey
                                                              : isPresent
                                                                  ? _p
                                                                  : Colors
                                                                      .redAccent)),
                                                );
                                              }))),
                                ]))))),
          );
        }),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      _snack('Could not load attendance: $e', Colors.red);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _manageAttendance(
      BuildContext context, List<Member> members) async {
    final orgId =
        widget.organizationId ?? AppState.instance.currentOfficerOrgId;
    if (orgId == null || orgId.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      final db = Supabase.instance.client;
      if (!context.mounted) return;
      // Reuse an existing activity when recording another session later in the day.
      final choice = await _pickOrCreateAttendanceActivity(context, orgId);
      if (choice == null || !context.mounted) return;
      final activity = choice['_create_new'] == true
          ? await _createAttendanceActivity(context, orgId)
          : choice;
      if (activity == null || !context.mounted) return;
      final events = <Map<String, dynamic>>[activity];
      String selectedEvent = activity['id']?.toString() ?? '';
      final isMeeting =
          activity['activity_type']?.toString().toLowerCase() == 'meeting';
      // The database only permits 'morning' or 'afternoon' in the session column.
      // Meetings use the single stored 'morning' slot internally; the UI hides the session picker.
      String session = 'morning';
      final selected = <String>{};
      Future<void> loadSelected() async {
        final rows = await db
            .from('organization_member_attendance')
            .select('profile_id,status')
            .eq('event_id', selectedEvent)
            .eq('org_id', orgId)
            .eq('session', session);
        selected.clear();
        for (final row in rows as List) {
          if (row['status']?.toString().toLowerCase() == 'present') {
            final id = row['profile_id']?.toString() ?? '';
            if (id.isNotEmpty) selected.add(id);
          }
        }
      }

      await loadSelected();
      if (!context.mounted) return;
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        useSafeArea: false,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        builder: (dialogContext) => StatefulBuilder(
            builder: (dialogContext, setDialogState) => Scaffold(
                  backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF0FDF4),
                  appBar: PreferredSize(
                      preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(160),
                      child: _attendanceFullHeader(dialogContext,
                          'Record Attendance', Icons.event_available_rounded)),
                  body: SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      height: MediaQuery.of(dialogContext).size.height - 260,
                      child: Scrollbar(
                          thumbVisibility: true,
                          interactive: true,
                          child: SingleChildScrollView(
                              primary: true,
                              child: Padding(
                                  padding:
                                      const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 24),
                                  child: Column(
                                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                      crossAxisAlignment:
                                          CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                      children: [
                                        Container(
                                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                              color: const Color(0xFFEAF7EF),
                                              borderRadius:
                                                  BorderRadius.circular(14)),
                                          child: Row(children: [
                                            const Icon(
                                                Icons.edit_calendar_rounded,
                                                color: _p),
                                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                            Expanded(
                                                child: Text(
                                                    'Attendance for: ${events.first['title'] ?? 'Event or meeting'}',
                                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                                        fontWeight:
                                                            FontWeight.w800,
                                                        color: Color(
                                                            0xFF173B2B)))),
                                          ]),
                                        ),
                                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                        Builder(builder: (_) {
                                          final event = events.firstWhere(
                                              (e) =>
                                                  e['id']?.toString() ==
                                                  selectedEvent,
                                              orElse: () => events.first);
                                          return Container(
                                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(13),
                                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                                  color:
                                                      const Color(0xFFF0FDF4),
                                                  borderRadius:
                                                      BorderRadius.circular(16),
                                                  border: Border.all(
                                                      color: const Color(
                                                          0xFFD5F0DE))),
                                              child: Column(
                                                  crossAxisAlignment:
                                                      CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                                  children: [
                                                    Row(children: [
                                                      Expanded(
                                                          child: Text(
                                                              event['title']
                                                                      ?.toString() ??
                                                                  'Event',
                                                              maxLines: 2,
                                                              overflow:
                                                                  TextOverflow
                                                                      .ellipsis,
                                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                                  fontSize: 16,
                                                                  fontWeight:
                                                                      FontWeight
                                                                          .w900,
                                                                  color: Color(
                                                                      0xFF14532D)))),
                                                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                                      Container(
                                                          padding:
                                                              const EdgeInsets
                                                                  .symmetric(
                                                                  horizontal: 9,
                                                                  vertical: 5),
                                                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                                              color: const Color(
                                                                  0xFFDDF5E5),
                                                              borderRadius:
                                                                  BorderRadius
                                                                      .circular(
                                                                          20)),
                                                          child: Text(
                                                              (event['activity_type']
                                                                          ?.toString() ??
                                                                      'event')
                                                                  .toUpperCase(),
                                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                                  fontSize: 9,
                                                                  fontWeight:
                                                                      FontWeight
                                                                          .w900,
                                                                  color: Color(
                                                                      0xFF166534))))
                                                    ]),
                                                    const SizedBox(height: 9),
                                                    Row(children: [
                                                      const Icon(
                                                          Icons
                                                              .calendar_month_rounded,
                                                          size: 17,
                                                          color: _p),
                                                      const SizedBox(width: 7),
                                                      Expanded(
                                                          child: Text(
                                                              _attendanceDateLabel(
                                                                  event[
                                                                      'date']),
                                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                                  fontWeight:
                                                                      FontWeight
                                                                          .w700)))
                                                    ]),
                                                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                                    Row(children: [
                                                      const Icon(
                                                          Icons
                                                              .schedule_rounded,
                                                          size: 17,
                                                          color: _p),
                                                      const SizedBox(width: 7),
                                                      Expanded(
                                                          child: Text(
                                                              _attendanceTimeLabel(
                                                                  event[
                                                                      'date']),
                                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                                  fontWeight:
                                                                      FontWeight
                                                                          .w700)))
                                                    ]),
                                                  ]));
                                        }),
                                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                        if (!isMeeting)
                                          _attendanceSessionPicker(
                                              session: session,
                                              onChanged: (value) async {
                                                try {
                                                  session = value;
                                                  await loadSelected();
                                                  if (!dialogContext.mounted)
                                                    return;
                                                  setDialogState(() {});
                                                } catch (e) {
                                                  _snack(
                                                      'Could not load this session: $e',
                                                      Colors.red);
                                                }
                                              }),
                                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                        Text(
                                            isMeeting
                                                ? 'Check the members who attended this meeting.'
                                                : 'Check the members who are present for the ${session == 'morning' ? 'morning' : 'afternoon'} session.',
                                            style: const TextStyle(
                                                fontSize: 12,
                                                color: Colors.blueGrey)),
                                        const SizedBox(height: 6),
                                        Container(
                                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                                horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
                                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                                color: const Color(0xFFF7FAF8),
                                                borderRadius:
                                                    BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                                            child: Row(children: [
                                              const Icon(Icons.groups_2_rounded,
                                                  size: 17, color: _p),
                                              const SizedBox(width: 7),
                                              Expanded(
                                                  child: Text(
                                                      '${members.length} members',
                                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                                          fontWeight:
                                                              FontWeight.w800,
                                                          color: Color(
                                                              0xFF315342)))),
                                              Text('${selected.length} present',
                                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                                      fontSize: 12,
                                                      fontWeight:
                                                          FontWeight.w800,
                                                      color: _p))
                                            ])),
                                        ConstrainedBox(
                                            constraints: BoxConstraints(
                                                maxHeight:
                                                    MediaQuery.of(dialogContext)
                                                            .size
                                                            .height *
                                                        .52),
                                            child: Scrollbar(
                                                thumbVisibility: true,
                                                interactive: true,
                                                child: ListView.separated(
                                                    shrinkWrap: true,
                                                    itemCount: members.length,
                                                    separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                                                        const Divider(
                                                            height: 1),
                                                    itemBuilder: (_, index) {
                                                      final member =
                                                          members[index];
                                                      final id =
                                                          member.profileId;
                                                      if (id == null ||
                                                          id.isEmpty)
                                                        return const SizedBox
                                                            .shrink();
                                                      final present =
                                                          selected.contains(id);
                                                      return CheckboxListTile(
                                                          value: present,
                                                          activeColor: _p,
                                                          contentPadding:
                                                              EdgeInsets.zero,
                                                          controlAffinity:
                                                              ListTileControlAffinity
                                                                  .leading,
                                                          title: Text(
                                                              member.name,
                                                              softWrap: true,
                                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                                  fontWeight:
                                                                      FontWeight
                                                                          .w800)),
                                                          subtitle: Text(
                                                              member.position,
                                                              maxLines: 1,
                                                              overflow:
                                                                  TextOverflow
                                                                      .ellipsis),
                                                          onChanged: (value) =>
                                                              setDialogState(() =>
                                                                  value == true
                                                                      ? selected
                                                                          .add(
                                                                              id)
                                                                      : selected
                                                                          .remove(id)));
                                                    }))),
                                      ]))))),
                  bottomNavigationBar: SafeArea(
                      child: Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                          child: FilledButton.icon(
                              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                                  backgroundColor: _p,
                                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                                  padding:
                                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 15)),
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, size: 18),
                              onPressed: () async {
                                try {
                                  final now =
                                      DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String();
                                  final me = db.auth.currentUser?.id;
                                  final seen = <String>{};
                                  final payload = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
                                  for (final member in members) {
                                    final id = member.profileId;
                                    if (id == null ||
                                        id.isEmpty ||
                                        !seen.add(id)) continue;
                                    payload.add({
                                      'org_id': orgId,
                                      'event_id': selectedEvent,
                                      'profile_id': id,
                                      'session': session,
                                      'status': selected.contains(id)
                                          ? 'present'
                                          : 'absent',
                                      'marked_by': me,
                                      'marked_at': now,
                                      'submitted_at': now,
                                      'submitted_by': me,
                                      'submission_status': 'submitted',
                                    });
                                  }
                                  if (payload.isEmpty) {
                                    _snack(
                                        'No members with linked accounts to record.',
                                        Colors.orange);
                                    return;
                                  }
                                  await db
                                      .from('organization_member_attendance')
                                      .upsert(payload,
                                          onConflict:
                                              'event_id,profile_id,session');
                                  if (!dialogContext.mounted) return;
                                  Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                                  await _loadEngagementData();
                                  if (!mounted) return;
                                  _snack(
                                      isMeeting
                                          ? 'Meeting attendance saved and sent to the adviser.'
                                          : '${session == 'morning' ? 'Morning' : 'Afternoon'} attendance saved and sent to the adviser.',
                                      _ok);
                                } catch (e) {
                                  if (!mounted) return;
                                  _snack('Could not save attendance: $e',
                                      Colors.red);
                                }
                              },
                              label: const Text('Save & Send')))),
                )),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      _snack('Could not load attendance: $e', Colors.red);
    }
  }
