  // â”€â”€ Member dialog â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  void _dialog(BuildContext context, {Member? existing}) {
    final nameCtrl = TextEditingController(text: existing?.name ?? '');
    // AFTER
    const validPositions = [
      'Member',
      'Officer',
      'President',
      'Vice President',
      'Secretary',
      'Assistant Secretary',
      'Treasurer'
    ];

    String position =
        (existing != null && validPositions.contains(existing.position))
            ? existing.position
            : 'Member';

    // Hardcoded officer org â€” resolved once at dialog open, never from user input
    final String? officerOrgId = AppState.instance.currentOfficerOrgId;
    final String officerOrgName = officerOrgId != null
        ? AppState.instance.organizations
            .firstWhere(
              (o) => o.id == officerOrgId,
              orElse: () => AppState.instance.organizations.first,
            )
            .name
        : (existing?.orgName ?? '');

    // Guard: bail out if no officer org context is available
    if (officerOrgId == null) {
      _snack('No organization context. Please re-login.', Colors.red);
      return;
    }

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (ctx, ss) => Dialog(
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
                child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                      children: [
                        _DialogHeader(
                            existing == null
                                ? Icons.person_add_rounded
                                : Icons.edit_rounded,
                            existing == null ? 'Add Member' : 'Edit Member'),
                        const SizedBox(height: 20),
                        _Field(
                            ctrl: nameCtrl,
                            label: 'Full Name',
                            hint: 'Enter member name',
                            icon: Icons.person_rounded),
                        const SizedBox(height: 14),
                        // Designation choices shared by adviser and organization leadership
                        _FieldLabel('Position'),
                        DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                          initialValue: position,
                          decoration: _fieldDeco(Icons.badge_rounded),
                          items: [
                            'President',
                            'Vice President',
                            'Secretary',
                            'Assistant Secretary',
                            'Treasurer',
                            'Officer',
                            'Member',
                          ]
                              .map((v) =>
                                  DropdownMenuItem(value: v, child: Text(v)))
                              .toList(),
                          onChanged: (v) => ss(() => position = v ?? 'Member'),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 14),
                        // Read-only org display â€” not editable by officer
                        _FieldLabel('Organization'),
                        Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0)),
                          ),
                          child: Row(children: [
                            const Icon(Icons.groups_rounded,
                                color: Color(0xFF16A34A), size: 18),
                            const SizedBox(width: 10),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text(
                                officerOrgName,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 14,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                                    color: Color(0xFF64748B)),
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              ),
                            ),
                            const Icon(Icons.lock_rounded,
                                color: Color(0xFFCBD5E1), size: 14),
                          ]),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 22),
                        Row(children: [
                          Expanded(
                              child:
                                  _CancelBtn(onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx))),
                          const SizedBox(width: 12),
                          Expanded(child: _SaveBtn(onTap: () async {
                            final name = nameCtrl.text.trim();
                            final navigator = Navigator.of(ctx);
                            final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(ctx);
                            if (name.isEmpty) return;
                            if (existing == null) {
                              // ADD: org identifiers sourced from officer session only
                              await AppState.instance.addMember(
                                name: name,
                                position: position,
                                orgName: officerOrgName,
                                orgId: officerOrgId,
                              );
                              await AppState.instance
                                  .fetchMembers(organizationId: officerOrgId);
                              _showSnack(messenger, 'Added $name', _ok);
                            } else {
                              // UPDATE: preserve id, override org identifiers.
                              final updated = existing.copyWith(
                                name: name,
                                position: position,
                                orgName: officerOrgName,
                                orgId: officerOrgId,
                              );
                              final saved =
                                  await AppState.instance.updateMember(updated);
                              if (!saved) {
                                _showSnack(
                                    messenger,
                                    'Could not save position: ${AppState.instance.lastMemberUpdateError ?? 'Unknown database error'}',
                                    Colors.redAccent);
                                return;
                              }
                              // Keep account-level access synchronized with the
                              // membership position. The dashboard reads the exact
                              // position from members, while profiles.role controls
                              // student/officer routing.
                              if (existing.profileId != null &&
                                  existing.profileId!.isNotEmpty) {
                                final officerPosition =
                                    _officerPositions.contains(position) ||
                                        position == 'Officer';
                                try {
                                  await Supabase.instance.client
                                      .from('profiles')
                                      .update({
                                    'role':
                                        officerPosition ? 'officer' : 'student',
                                    'assigned_org_id':
                                        officerPosition ? officerOrgId : null,
                                  }).eq('id', existing.profileId!);
                                } catch (e) {
                                  debugPrint(
                                      'Could not synchronize officer account role: $e');
                                }
                              }
                              await AppState.instance
                                  .fetchMembers(organizationId: officerOrgId);
                              if (!mounted) return;
                              _showSnack(
                                  messenger, 'Updated $name to $position', _ok);
                            }
                            if (!mounted) return;
                            navigator.pop();
                          })),
                        ]),
                      ],
                    )),
              )),
    );
  }

  void _showSnack(ScaffoldMessengerState messenger, String msg, Color bg) =>
      messenger.showSnackBar(SnackBar(
        content: Text(msg),
        backgroundColor: bg,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
      ));
}

// â”€â”€ Member card â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class _MemberCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final Member member;
  final bool readOnly;
  final int index;
  final Color accentColor;
  final int chatCount;
  final int commentCount;
  final int attendancePresent;
  final int attendanceTotal;
  final VoidCallback onEdit, onDelete;
  const _MemberCard({
    required this.member,
    this.readOnly = false,
    required this.index,
    required this.accentColor,
    this.chatCount = 0,
    this.commentCount = 0,
    this.attendancePresent = 0,
    this.attendanceTotal = 0,
    required this.onEdit,
    required this.onDelete,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final initial = member.name.isNotEmpty ? member.name[0].toUpperCase() : '?';
    return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
      tween: Tween(begin: 0, end: 1),
      duration: Duration(milliseconds: 240 + index * 50),
      curve: Curves.easeOut,
      builder: (_, v, child) => Opacity(
          opacity: v,
          child: Transform.translate(
              offset: Offset(0, 12 * (1 - v)), child: child)),
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE4F0E8)),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
                color: const Color(0xFF16A34A).withValues(alpha: 0.06),
                blurRadius: 20,
                offset: const Offset(0, 6))
          ],
        ),
        child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
            child: Row(children: [
              // Avatar
              Container(
                width: 46,
                height: 46,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle),
                child: Center(
                    child: Text(initial,
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: accentColor,
                            fontSize: 18,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800))),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),
              Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                    // Keep the complete member/officer name visible. The card
                    // grows vertically for long names instead of truncating.
                    Text(member.name,
                        softWrap: true,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 14,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            color: Color(0xFF0F172A))),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(member.orgName,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12, color: Color(0xFF94A3B8))),
                    const SizedBox(height: 5),
                    Wrap(
                      spacing: 6,
                      runSpacing: 5,
                      children: [
                        Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.10),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                          ),
                          child: Text(member.position,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 10.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  color: accentColor)),
                        ),
                        if (chatCount > 0)
                          _tinyMetric(
                              Icons.chat_bubble_rounded, '$chatCount chat'),
                        if (commentCount > 0)
                          _tinyMetric(Icons.forum_rounded,
                              '$commentCount comment${commentCount == 1 ? '' : 's'}'),
                        _tinyMetric(
                            Icons.event_available_rounded,
                            attendanceTotal == 0
                                ? 'Attendance â€”'
                                : 'Attendance ${((attendancePresent / attendanceTotal) * 100).round()}%'),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ])),
              if (!readOnly)
                Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
                  _IconBtn(
                      icon: Icons.edit_rounded,
                      color: const Color(0xFF16A34A),
                      onTap: onEdit,
                      tip: 'Edit'),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  _IconBtn(
                      icon: Icons.delete_rounded,
                      color: const Color(0xFFEF4444),
                      onTap: onDelete,
                      tip: 'Remove'),
                ]),
            ])),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ImpactSection extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<Member> members;
  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> impactByStudentId;
  final double Function(Map<String, dynamic>) averageFor;
  final bool adviserView;
  const _ImpactSection(
      {required this.members,
      required this.impactByStudentId,
      required this.averageFor,
      this.adviserView = false});

  double _rating(dynamic value) {
    final n = double.tryParse(value?.toString() ?? '') ?? 0;
    return n > 5 ? (n / 20).clamp(1, 5) : n.clamp(1, 5);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final rows = members
        .where((m) =>
            m.profileId != null && impactByStudentId.containsKey(m.profileId))
        .toList();
    final impacts = rows.map((m) => impactByStudentId[m.profileId!]!).toList();
    final avgScore = impacts.isEmpty
        ? 0.0
        : impacts
                .map((impact) => averageFor(impact))
                .map((v) => v > 5 ? v / 20 : v)
                .reduce((a, b) => a + b) /
            impacts.length;
    // A 1/5 response means no perceived impact (0%); 5/5 means full impact (100%).
    final percent = impacts.isEmpty
        ? 0
        : (((avgScore - 1) / 4) * 100).round().clamp(0, 100);
    final level = impacts.isEmpty
        ? 'Awaiting responses'
        : percent >= 75
            ? 'High impact'
            : percent >= 50
                ? 'Moderate impact'
                : 'Low impact';
    final high = impacts.where((i) {
      final a = averageFor(i);
      final p = (((((a > 5 ? a / 20 : a) - 1) / 4) * 100));
      return p >= 75;
    }).length;
    final moderate = impacts.where((i) {
      final a = averageFor(i);
      final p = (((((a > 5 ? a / 20 : a) - 1) / 4) * 100));
      return p >= 50 && p < 75;
    }).length;
    final low = impacts.length - high - moderate;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFFEAF9F0),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFB7E2C9))),
      child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: [
        Row(children: [
          const Icon(Icons.insights_rounded,
              color: Color(0xFF15803D), size: 22),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          const Expanded(
              child: Text('Organization Impact',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 17,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      color: Color(0xFF12352A)))),
          if (impacts.isNotEmpty)
            Text('$percent%',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 22,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    color: Color(0xFF166534)))
        ]),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        Text(
            impacts.isEmpty
                ? 'No member impact responses have been submitted yet.'
                : '$level â€¢ Overall result from ${impacts.length} submitted member response${impacts.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}.',
            style: const TextStyle(
                color: Color(0xFF3F6255),
                fontSize: 12,
                height: 1.4,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        if (impacts.isNotEmpty) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                  value: percent / 100,
                  minHeight: 10,
                  backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                  color: const Color(0xFF16A34A))),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: [
            _summaryPill('High impact', high),
            _summaryPill('Moderate impact', moderate),
            _summaryPill('Low impact', low)
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 7),
          const Text(
              'Impact bands: High 75â€“100%, Moderate 50â€“74%, Low below 50%. These are suggested reporting bands based on the 1â€“5 self-reported scale.',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: Color(0xFF48665A), fontSize: 10.5, height: 1.35)),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        if (impacts.isEmpty)
          const Text(
              'Members rate Academic, Social, Leadership, and Confidence from 1 to 5. Their combined answers are converted to an overall percentage.',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: Color(0xFF48665A), fontSize: 11.5, height: 1.4))
        else
          ...rows.map((member) {
            final impact = impactByStudentId[member.profileId!]!;
            final avg = averageFor(impact);
            final normalized = avg > 5 ? avg / 20 : avg;
            final memberPercent =
                ((((normalized - 1) / 4) * 100).round()).clamp(0, 100);
            final memberLevel = memberPercent >= 75
                ? 'High'
                : memberPercent >= 50
                    ? 'Moderate'
                    : 'Low';
            return Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 9),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFD1FAE5))),
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(children: [
                        Expanded(
                            child: Text(member.name,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                    color: Color(0xFF12352A)))),
                        Text('$memberPercent% â€¢ $memberLevel',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                color: Color(0xFF166534),
                                fontSize: 11))
                      ]),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: [
                        _impactChip(
                            'Academic', _rating(impact['academic_growth'])),
                        _impactChip('Social', _rating(impact['social_growth'])),
                        _impactChip(
                            'Leadership', _rating(impact['leadership_growth'])),
                        _impactChip(
                            'Confidence', _rating(impact['confidence_growth']))
                      ]),
                    ]));
          }),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _summaryPill(String label, int count) => Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 7),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      child: Text('$label: $count',
          style: const TextStyle(
              color: Color(0xFF166534),
              fontSize: 10.5,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)));

  Widget _impactChip(String label, double value) => Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 6),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFFDCFCE7),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30)),
      child: Text('$label ${value.round()}/5',
          style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 9.5,
              color: Color(0xFF166534),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)));
}

class _MemberActivitySection extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<Member> members;
  final Set<String> activeProfileIds;
  final Map<String, int> chatMessageCounts;
  final Map<String, int> commentCounts;
  final Map<String, int> attendancePresent;
  final Map<String, int> attendanceTotal;
  const _MemberActivitySection(
      {required this.members,
      required this.activeProfileIds,
      required this.chatMessageCounts,
      required this.commentCounts,
      required this.attendancePresent,
      required this.attendanceTotal});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final totalMembers = members.where((m) => m.profileId != null).length;
    final active = members
        .where((m) =>
            m.profileId != null && activeProfileIds.contains(m.profileId))
        .length;
    final chatParticipants = members
        .where((m) =>
            m.profileId != null &&
            ((chatMessageCounts[m.profileId] ?? 0) > 0 ||
                (commentCounts[m.profileId] ?? 0) > 0))
        .length;
    final totalAttendance =
        attendanceTotal.values.fold<int>(0, (a, b) => a + b);
    final presentAttendance =
        attendancePresent.values.fold<int>(0, (a, b) => a + b);
    final attendanceRate = totalAttendance == 0
        ? 0
        : (presentAttendance / totalAttendance * 100).round();
    return Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.white,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
            border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFDCEFE2))),
        child:
            Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: [
          const Row(children: [
            Icon(Icons.groups_rounded, color: Color(0xFF0F766E), size: 22),
            SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
                child: Text('Member Activity',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 17,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        color: Color(0xFF12352A))))
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 5),
          const Text(
              'A separate participation measure based on attendance and engagement in the organization community during the last 30 days.',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: Color(0xFF48665A), fontSize: 11.5, height: 1.4)),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Row(children: [
            Expanded(
                child: _activityMetric('Active members',
                    '$active/$totalMembers', Icons.verified_user_rounded)),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
                child: _activityMetric('Chat / comments', '$chatParticipants',
                    Icons.forum_rounded)),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
                child: _activityMetric(
                    'Attendance',
                    totalAttendance == 0 ? 'â€”' : '$attendanceRate%',
                    Icons.fact_check_rounded))
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (members.isEmpty)
            const Text('No members found for this organization.',
                style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF48665A), fontSize: 11.5))
          else
            ...members.where((m) => m.profileId != null).map((m) {
              final id = m.profileId!;
              final present = attendancePresent[id] ?? 0;
              final total = attendanceTotal[id] ?? 0;
              final messages = chatMessageCounts[id] ?? 0;
              final comments = commentCounts[id] ?? 0;
              final isActive = activeProfileIds.contains(id);
              return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                  child: Row(children: [
                    Expanded(
                        child: Text(m.name,
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                color: Color(0xFF234638)))),
                    Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                            '${isActive ? 'Active' : 'No recent activity'}  â€¢  Chat $messages  â€¢  Comments $comments  â€¢  Attendance ${total == 0 ? 'â€”' : '$present/$total'}',
                            textAlign: TextAlign.end,
                            maxLines: 2,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 9.5,
                                color: Color(0xFF48665A),
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)))
                  ]));
            }),
        ]));
  }

  Widget _activityMetric(String label, String value, IconData icon) =>
      Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(9),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: const Color(0xFFF0FDF4),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
          child:
              Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
            Icon(icon, color: const Color(0xFF15803D), size: 18),
            const SizedBox(height: 5),
            Text(value,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    fontSize: 15,
                    color: Color(0xFF14532D))),
            Text(label,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    fontSize: 9,
                    color: Color(0xFF48665A)))
          ]));
}

class _Field extends StatelessWidget {
  final TextEditingController ctrl;
  final String label, hint;
  final IconData icon;
  const _Field(
      {required this.ctrl,
      required this.label,
      required this.hint,
      required this.icon});

  @override

class _OfficerOrgProfileScreenState extends State<OfficerOrgProfileScreen> {

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    // Find org from AppState
    final foundOrgs =
        AppState.instance.organizations.where((o) => o.id == widget.orgId);
    _orgLoaded = foundOrgs.isNotEmpty;
    _org = _orgLoaded
        ? foundOrgs.first
        : Organization(

            name: '',
            logoAsset: '',
            shortDesc: '',
          );

    _nameCtrl = TextEditingController(text: _org.name);

  Future<void> _loadOrganizationPeople() async {
    try {
      final rows = await Supabase.instance.client
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id,name,role,avatar_url,assigned_org_id,org_id')
          .or('assigned_org_id.eq.${widget.orgId},org_id.eq.${widget.orgId}')
          .order('name');
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _orgPeople = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(rows);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Organization people load error: $e');
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic>? _personByRole(String role) {
    final target = role.toLowerCase();
    for (final person in _orgPeople) {
      if (person['role']?.toString().toLowerCase() == target) return person;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override

    _missionCtrl.dispose();
    _visionCtrl.dispose();

  // â”€â”€ Pick image from gallery â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  Future<void> _pickLogo() async {
    final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
      type: FileType.image,
      withData: true,
    );
    if (result != null && result.files.single.bytes != null) {
      setState(() {
        _pickedImageBytes = result.files.single.bytes;
        _pickedImageExt = result.files.single.extension ?? 'png';
      });
    }
  }

  // â”€â”€ Upload logo to Supabase Storage, returns public URL â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  Future<String?> _uploadLogo() async {
    if (_pickedImageBytes == null) return null;

    try {
      final fileBytes = _pickedImageBytes!;
      final fileExt = _pickedImageExt ?? 'png';
      final fileName =
          'org_logos/${widget.orgId}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.$fileExt';

      await Supabase.instance.client.storage.from('org-assets').uploadBinary(
            fileName,
            fileBytes,
            fileOptions: FileOptions(
              contentType: 'image/$fileExt',
              upsert: true,
            ),
          );

      final publicUrl = Supabase.instance.client.storage
          .from('org-assets')
          .getPublicUrl(fileName);

      return publicUrl;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Logo upload error: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<String?> _uploadOfficerPhoto(Uint8List bytes, String ext) async {
    try {
      final fileName =
          'org_officers/${widget.orgId}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext';
      await Supabase.instance.client.storage.from('org-assets').uploadBinary(
            fileName,
            bytes,
            fileOptions: FileOptions(
              contentType: 'image/$ext',
              upsert: true,
            ),
          );
      return Supabase.instance.client.storage
          .from('org-assets')
          .getPublicUrl(fileName);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Officer photo upload error: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }

  String _existingOfficerAvatar(String name) {
    final target = name.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (final profile in _officerProfiles) {
      if (profile.name.trim().toLowerCase() == target &&
          profile.avatarUrl.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        return profile.avatarUrl.trim();
      }
    }
    for (final person in _orgPeople) {
      if ((person['name']?.toString().trim().toLowerCase() ?? '') == target) {
        return person['avatar_url']?.toString() ?? '';
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  Future<void> _addOfficer() async {
    final profile = await _showOfficerEditor();
    if (profile == null) return;
    setState(() {
      _officers.add('${profile.role}: ${profile.name}');
      _officerProfiles.removeWhere(
        (item) =>
            item.name.trim().toLowerCase() == profile.name.trim().toLowerCase(),
      );
      _officerProfiles.add(profile);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _editOfficer(int index) async {
    final raw = _officers[index];
    final split = raw.indexOf(':');
    final currentName =
        split == -1 ? raw.trim() : raw.substring(split + 1).trim();
    final currentRole =
        split == -1 ? 'Officer' : raw.substring(0, split).trim();
    final existing = _officerProfiles.cast<OrgOfficerProfile?>().firstWhere(
          (p) => p?.name.trim().toLowerCase() == currentName.toLowerCase(),
          orElse: () => OrgOfficerProfile(
            name: currentName,
            role: currentRole,
            avatarUrl: _existingOfficerAvatar(currentName),
          ),
        );
    final updated = await _showOfficerEditor(existing: existing);
    if (updated == null) return;
    setState(() {
      _officers[index] = '${updated.role}: ${updated.name}';
      _officerProfiles.removeWhere(
        (item) => item.name.trim().toLowerCase() == currentName.toLowerCase(),
      );
      _officerProfiles.removeWhere(
        (item) =>
            item.name.trim().toLowerCase() == updated.name.trim().toLowerCase(),
      );
      _officerProfiles.add(updated);
    });
  }

  String _facebookNameFromStoredValue(String raw) {
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return '';
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(value.contains('://') ? value : 'https://$value');
    final host = uri?.host.toLowerCase().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^www\.'), '');
    if (uri != null && host == 'facebook.com') {
      final query = uri.queryParameters['q'];
      if (query != null && query.trim().isNotEmpty) return query.trim();
      final path = uri.pathSegments.where((part) => part.isNotEmpty).join(' ');
      if (path.isNotEmpty) return path.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[-_]'), ' ');
    }
    return value;
  }

  // â”€â”€ Save all changes â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (_isSaving) return;
    if (!_orgLoaded) {
      _snack(
          'Organization data is still loading. Go back and reopen this page.',
          isError: true);
      return;
    }

    final name = _nameCtrl.text.trim();
    if (name.isEmpty) {
      _snack('Organization name cannot be empty.', isError: true);
      return;
    }
    final facebookName = _socialLinkCtrl.text.trim();
    if (facebookName.contains('://') &&
        !facebookName.toLowerCase().contains('facebook.com')) {
      _snack(
          'Please enter the organization Facebook name or a Facebook page URL.',
          isError: true);
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    try {
      // Upload new logo if one was picked
      // Upload new logo if one was picked
      String finalLogoAsset = _logoAsset;
      if (_pickedImageBytes != null) {
        final uploadedUrl = await _uploadLogo();
        if (uploadedUrl != null) {
          // Evict old cached image so the new logo shows immediately everywhere
          await CachedNetworkImage.evictFromCache(_logoAsset);
          finalLogoAsset = uploadedUrl;
        } else {
          _snack('Logo upload failed. Other changes will still be saved.',
              isError: false);
        }
      }

      // Build updated org object
      final updated = _org.copyWith(
        name: name,
        acronym: _org.acronym,
        category: _categoryCtrl.text.trim(),
        about: _aboutCtrl.text.trim(),
        mission: _missionCtrl.text.trim(),
        vision: _visionCtrl.text.trim(),
        goals: _goalsCtrl.text.trim(),
        adviser: _adviserCtrl.text.trim(),
        socialLink: facebookName,
        officers: _officers,
        officerProfiles: _officerProfiles,
        activitiesHighlights: [
          ..._highlights,
          ..._org.activitiesHighlights
              .where((i) => i.type != 'image' && i.type != 'video'),
        ],
        logoAsset: finalLogoAsset,
      );

      // This already handles Supabase + AppState update
      await AppState.instance.updateOrganization(updated);

      if (!mounted) return;
      _snack('Organization profile updated!');
      Navigator.of(context).pop();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) _snack('Failed to save changes.', isError: true);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSaving = false);
    }
  }

  void _snack(String msg, {bool isError = false}) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(msg),
        backgroundColor:
            isError ? const Color(0xFFEF4444) : const Color(0xFF22C55E),
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
      ),
    );
  }

  // â”€â”€ Section label widget â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  Widget _sectionLabel(String text) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Container(
          width: 3,
          height: 16,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: const LinearGradient(
              colors: [_primary, _secondary],
              begin: Alignment.topCenter,
              end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
            ),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 10),
        Text(
          text.toUpperCase(),
          style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            letterSpacing: 1.8,
            color: _secondary,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  // â”€â”€ Reusable text field â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  Widget _field({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
    int maxLines = 1,
    TextInputType? keyboardType,
  }) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          colors: [Color(0xFFE9FFF2), Color(0xFFBDF3D0)],
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFB9E4CF)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
              color: _primary.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
              blurRadius: 16,
              offset: const Offset(0, 6))
        ],
      ),
      child: TextField(
        controller: controller,
        maxLines: maxLines,
        minLines: 1,
        keyboardType: keyboardType,
        style: const TextStyle(
          fontSize: 14,
          color: _textDark,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        ),
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          filled: true,
          fillColor: const Color(0xFFF8FFFB),
          labelText: label,
          labelStyle: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: _textMuted,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          ),
          prefixIcon: Icon(icon, color: _primary, size: 20),
          border: OutlineInputBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            borderSide: BorderSide.none,
          ),
          enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            borderSide: const BorderSide(color: _fieldBorder, width: 1.2),
          ),
          focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            borderSide: const BorderSide(color: _primary, width: 1.8),
          ),
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: 16,
            vertical: maxLines > 1 ? 14 : 0,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// _LogoPicker â€” shows current logo and a camera button to change it
// =============================================================================
class _LogoPicker extends StatelessWidget {
  final Uint8List? pickedFile;
  final String logoUrl;
  final String logoAsset;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final Color primary;

  const _LogoPicker({
    required this.pickedFile,
    required this.logoUrl,
    required this.logoAsset,
    required this.onTap,
    required this.primary,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const double size = 88;
    return SizedBox(
      width: 96,
      height: 96,
      child: Stack(
        clipBehavior: Clip.none,
        children: [
          // Compact logo for the member-style horizontal organization card.
          Container(
            width: size,
            height: size,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
              color: Colors.transparent,
              border:
                  Border.all(color: primary.withValues(alpha: 0.28), width: 2),
              boxShadow: [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                  blurRadius: 14,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 5),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            child: ClipOval(child: _logoWidget()),
          ),
          Positioned(
            right: -1,
            bottom: 1,
            child: GestureDetector(
              behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
              onTap: onTap,
              child: Container(
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: primary,
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: 3),
                  boxShadow: [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.16),
                      blurRadius: 7,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 3),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                child: const Icon(
                  Icons.camera_alt_rounded,
                  color: Colors.white,
                  size: 18,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _logoWidget() {
    // Priority: newly picked file > network URL > asset
    if (pickedFile != null) {
      return Image.memory(
        pickedFile!,
        fit: BoxFit.contain,
        width: 88,
        height: 88,
      );
    }
    if (logoUrl.isNotEmpty) {
      return CachedNetworkImage(
        imageUrl: logoUrl,
        fit: BoxFit.contain,
        width: 88,
        height: 88,
        placeholder: (_, __) => _fallbackIcon(),
        errorWidget: (_, __, ___) => _fallbackIcon(),
      );
    }
    if (logoAsset.isNotEmpty) {
      return Image.asset(
        logoAsset,
        fit: BoxFit.contain,
        width: 88,
        height: 88,
        errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _fallbackIcon(),
      );
    }
    return _fallbackIcon();
  }

  Widget _fallbackIcon() => Container(
        color: const Color(0xFFE0E7FF),
        child: Icon(Icons.groups_rounded, color: primary, size: 40),
      );
}

// =============================================================================
// _EditablePeopleCard â€” visual officer/adviser profile editor
// =============================================================================
class _ProfilePersonEditorCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final String label;
  final String name;
  final String avatarUrl;
  final double width;
  final VoidCallback? onEdit;

  const _ProfilePersonEditorCard({
    required this.label,
    required this.name,
    required this.avatarUrl,
    this.width = 172,
    this.onEdit,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final displayName = name.trim().isEmpty ? 'No name added yet' : name.trim();
    final displayRole = label.trim().isEmpty ? 'Officer' : label.trim();
    return SizedBox(
      width: width,
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: width,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 10, 10, 12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                  colors: [Color(0xFFFFFFFF), Color(0xFFF3FCF6)]),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFB9E4CF), width: 1.2),
              boxShadow: const [
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Color(0x0D0F8A61),
                    blurRadius: 14,
                    offset: Offset(0, 6))
              ],
            ),
            child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    child: SizedBox(
                      height: 122,
                      child: avatarUrl.trim().isNotEmpty
                          ? CachedNetworkImage(
                              imageUrl: avatarUrl.trim(),
                              fit: BoxFit.cover,
                              alignment: Alignment.center,
                              placeholder: (_, __) => _personFallback(),
                              errorWidget: (_, __, ___) => _personFallback())
                          : _personFallback(),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Container(
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 5),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: const Color(0xFFE3F7EA),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)),
                    child: Text(displayRole,
                        softWrap: true,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Color(0xFF15803D),
                            fontSize: 10,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                            letterSpacing: .5)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 7),
                  Text(displayName,
                      softWrap: true,
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Color(0xFF0F172A),
                          fontSize: 14.5,
                          height: 1.15,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
                ]),
          ),
          if (onEdit != null)
            Positioned(
                top: 6,
                right: 6,
                child: Material(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  shape: const CircleBorder(),
                  elevation: 2,
                  child: IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Edit adviser',
                      onPressed: onEdit,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(7),
                      constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_rounded,
                          size: 16, color: Color(0xFF16A34A))),
                )),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _personFallback() => Container(
      color: const Color(0xFFE7F7EF),
      child: const Center(
          child:
              Icon(Icons.person_rounded, color: Color(0xFF16A34A), size: 42)));
}

class _OfficerPeopleEditor extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<String> officers;
  final List<OrgOfficerProfile> profiles;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> people;
  final VoidCallback onAdd;
  final void Function(int index) onEdit;
  final void Function(int index) onRemove;

  const _OfficerPeopleEditor({
    required this.officers,
    required this.profiles,
    required this.people,
    required this.onAdd,
    required this.onEdit,
    required this.onRemove,
  });

  String _nameOnly(String raw) {
    final text = raw.trim();
    final split = text.indexOf(':');
    return split == -1 ? text : text.substring(split + 1).trim();
  }

  String _roleOnly(String raw) {
    final text = raw.trim();
    final split = text.indexOf(':');
    return split == -1 ? 'Officer' : text.substring(0, split).trim();
  }

  String _avatarFor(String name) {
    final target = name.toLowerCase();
    for (final person in people) {
      if ((person['name']?.toString().trim().toLowerCase() ?? '') == target) {
        return person['avatar_url']?.toString() ?? '';
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  String _profileAvatar(String name) {
    final target = name.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (final profile in profiles) {
      if (profile.name.trim().toLowerCase() == target &&
          profile.avatarUrl.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        return profile.avatarUrl.trim();
      }
    }
    return _avatarFor(name);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 12, 12, 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: const LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFFF8FFFB), Color(0xFFDDF4E8)],
          ),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFB9E4CF)),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: const Color(0xFF16A34A).withValues(alpha: .07),
              blurRadius: 14,
              offset: const Offset(0, 5),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            if (officers.isEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                child: Text(
                  'No officers added yet. Add an officer below.',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.grey.shade500,
                    fontSize: 12.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
                ),
              )
            else
              SingleChildScrollView(
                scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                child: Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    for (var index = 0; index < officers.length; index++) ...[
                      if (index > 0) const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      Builder(
                        builder: (context) {
                          final raw = officers[index];
                          final name = _nameOnly(raw);
                          final role = _roleOnly(raw);
                          return Stack(
                            clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                            children: [
                              _ProfilePersonEditorCard(
                                label: role,
                                name: name,
                                avatarUrl: _profileAvatar(name),
                                width: 172,
                              ),
                              Positioned(
                                top: -5,
                                right: -4,
                                child: Row(
                                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                  children: [
                                    GestureDetector(
                                      onTap: () => onEdit(index),
                                      child: Container(
                                        width: 26,
                                        height: 26,
                                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                          color: Colors.white,
                                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                          border: Border.all(
                                              color: const Color(0xFFB9E4CF)),
                                          boxShadow: const [
                                            BoxShadow(
                                              color: Color(0x12000000),
                                              blurRadius: 6,
                                              offset: Offset(0, 2),
                                            ),
                                          ],
                                        ),
                                        child: const Icon(
                                          Icons.edit_rounded,
                                          size: 14,
                                          color: Color(0xFF16A34A),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                    GestureDetector(
                                      onTap: () => onRemove(index),
                                      child: Container(
                                        width: 26,
                                        height: 26,
                                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                          color: Colors.white,
                                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                          border: Border.all(
                                              color: Colors.red.shade100),
                                          boxShadow: const [
                                            BoxShadow(
                                              color: Color(0x12000000),
                                              blurRadius: 6,
                                              offset: Offset(0, 2),
                                            ),
                                          ],
                                        ),
                                        child: Icon(
                                          Icons.close_rounded,
                                          size: 16,
                                          color: Colors.red.shade400,
                                        ),

// _MediaEditCard â€” rich media editor for Highlights & Activities

class _MediaEditCard extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<OrgMediaItem> items;
  final Color accentColor;
  final String orgId;
  final ValueChanged<List<OrgMediaItem>> onChanged;

  const _MediaEditCard({
    required this.items,
    required this.accentColor,
    required this.orgId,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  @override
  State<_MediaEditCard> createState() => _MediaEditCardState();
}

class _MediaEditCardState extends State<_MediaEditCard> {
  bool _isUploading = false;

  Future<String?> _uploadFile(Uint8List bytes, String ext, String mime) async {
    try {
      final fileName =
          'org_activities/${widget.orgId}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.$ext';
      await Supabase.instance.client.storage.from('org-assets').uploadBinary(
            fileName,
            bytes,
            fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: mime, upsert: true),
          );
      return Supabase.instance.client.storage
          .from('org-assets')
          .getPublicUrl(fileName);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Media upload error: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _addImage() async {
    final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
      type: FileType.image,
      withData: true,
      allowMultiple: true,
    );
    if (result == null || result.files.isEmpty) return;

    setState(() => _isUploading = true);
    try {
      final newItems = <OrgMediaItem>[];
      for (final f in result.files) {
        if (f.bytes == null) continue;
        final ext = f.extension ?? 'jpg';
        final url = await _uploadFile(f.bytes!, ext, 'image/$ext');
        if (url != null && mounted) {
          final activityNameCtrl = TextEditingController();
          final descriptionCtrl = TextEditingController();
          final details = await showDialog<Map<String, String>>(
            context: context,
            builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18)),
              title: const Text('Add activity picture'),
              content: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      f.name,
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey.shade600),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    TextField(
                      controller: activityNameCtrl,
                      autofocus: true,
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Activity name',
                        hintText: 'e.g. Attending Mass',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    TextField(
                      controller: descriptionCtrl,
                      maxLines: 3,
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Short description (optional)',
                        hintText: 'Add a brief note about the activity',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              actions: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(),
                  child: const Text('Skip'),
                ),
                FilledButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop({
                    'title': activityNameCtrl.text.trim(),
                    'description': descriptionCtrl.text.trim(),
                  }),
                  child: const Text('Save'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
          newItems.add(
            OrgMediaItem(
              type: 'image',
              content: url,
              title: details?['title'] ?? '',
              description: details?['description'] ?? '',
            ),
          );
        }
      }
      widget.onChanged([...widget.items, ...newItems]);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isUploading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _addVideo() async {
    final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
      type: FileType.video,
      withData: true,
    );
    if (result == null || result.files.single.bytes == null) return;

    setState(() => _isUploading = true);
    try {
      final f = result.files.single;
      final ext = f.extension ?? 'mp4';
      final url = await _uploadFile(f.bytes!, ext, 'video/$ext');
      if (url != null) {
        String activityName = '';
        String description = '';
        if (mounted) {
          final activityNameCtrl = TextEditingController();
          final descriptionCtrl = TextEditingController();
          final details = await showDialog<Map<String, String>>(
            context: context,
            builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
              ),
              title: const Text('Add activity video'),
              content: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      f.name,
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey.shade600),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    TextField(
                      controller: activityNameCtrl,
                      autofocus: true,
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Activity name',
                        hintText: 'e.g. Attending Mass',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    TextField(
                      controller: descriptionCtrl,
                      maxLines: 3,
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Short description (optional)',
                        hintText: 'Add a brief note about the activity',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              actions: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(),
                  child: const Text('Skip'),
                ),
                FilledButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop({
                    'title': activityNameCtrl.text.trim(),
                    'description': descriptionCtrl.text.trim(),
                  }),
                  child: const Text('Save'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
          activityName = details?['title'] ?? '';
          description = details?['description'] ?? '';
        }
        widget.onChanged([
          ...widget.items,
          OrgMediaItem(
            type: 'video',
            content: url,
            title: activityName,
            description: description,
          ),
        ]);
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isUploading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final visibleItems = widget.items
        .where((item) => item.type == 'image' || item.type == 'video')
        .toList();
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFFF8FFFB), Color(0xFFDDF4E8)]),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFB9E4CF)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
              color: const Color(0xFF16A34A).withValues(alpha: 0.07),
              blurRadius: 14,
              offset: const Offset(0, 5))
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          if (_isUploading)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            )
          else if (visibleItems.isEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
              child: Text(
                  'No highlights yet. Add an activity picture or video.',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.grey.shade400)),
            )
          else
            ...visibleItems.asMap().entries.map((e) {
              final item = e.value;
              return Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFFF0FDF4),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0)),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    // Preview
                    ClipRRect(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      child: item.type == 'image'
                          ? CachedNetworkImage(
                              imageUrl: item.content,
                              width: 56,
                              height: 56,
                              fit: BoxFit.cover,
                              placeholder: (_, __) => Container(
                                  width: 56,
                                  height: 56,
                                  color: Colors.grey.shade200),
                              errorWidget: (_, __, ___) => Container(
                                  width: 56,
                                  height: 56,
                                  color: Colors.grey.shade200,
                                  child: const Icon(Icons.broken_image)),
                            )
                          : item.type == 'video'
                              ? Container(
                                  width: 56,
                                  height: 56,
                                  color: Colors.black87,
                                  child: const Icon(
                                      Icons.play_circle_fill_rounded,
                                      color: Colors.white,
                                      size: 28),
                                )
                              : Container(
                                  width: 56,
                                  height: 56,
                                  color: widget.accentColor
                                      .withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                                  child: Icon(Icons.text_snippet_rounded,
                                      color: widget.accentColor, size: 26),
                                ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    // Content
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            item.type == 'text'
                                ? item.content
                                : item.type == 'image'
                                    ? 'Pictures'
                                    : 'Video',
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                              color: item.type == 'image'
                                  ? widget.accentColor
                                  : Colors.grey.shade700,
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (item.title.trim().isNotEmpty ||
                              item.caption.trim().isNotEmpty) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 3),
                            Text(
                              item.title.trim().isNotEmpty
                                  ? item.title.trim()
                                  : item.caption.trim(),
                              maxLines: 2,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                          if (item.description.trim().isNotEmpty) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 2),
                            Text(
                              item.description.trim(),
                              maxLines: 2,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11.5,
                                color: Colors.grey.shade500,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    // Delete
                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () {
                        final target = item;
                        final updated = [...widget.items]..removeWhere(
                            (candidate) => identical(candidate, target));
                        widget.onChanged(updated);
                      },
                      child: Icon(Icons.remove_circle_outline_rounded,
                          size: 20, color: Colors.red.shade300),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }),

          const SizedBox(height: 6),

          // Action buttons row
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: _addBtn(
                  icon: Icons.image_rounded,
                  label: 'Activity Picture',
                  onTap: _isUploading ? null : _addImage,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: _addBtn(
                  icon: Icons.videocam_rounded,
                  label: 'Activity Video',
                  onTap: _isUploading ? null : _addVideo,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _addBtn({
    required IconData icon,
    required String label,
    required VoidCallback? onTap,
  }) {
    return OutlinedButton.icon(
      onPressed: onTap,
      icon: Icon(icon, size: 16, color: widget.accentColor),
      label: Text(label,
          style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: widget.accentColor)),
      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
        side: BorderSide(color: widget.accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
      ),
    );
  }
}
