class _StudentDashboardScreenState extends State<StudentDashboardScreen> {
  // â”€â”€â”€ Color tokens â€” MUST match ProfileScreen exactly â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  static const Color _primary = Color(0xFF16A34A);
  static const Color _background = Color(0xFFF0FDF4);

  // Per-action accent colors â€” all within the permitted palette
  static const Color _profileAccent = Color(0xFF16A34A);
  static const Color _orgAccent = Color(0xFF0F766E);
  static const Color _eventsAccent = Color(0xFF15803D);

  // â”€â”€â”€ Double-tap-to-exit state tracker â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  DateTime? _lastBackPressed;
  int _selectedIndex = 0;

  // â”€â”€â”€ AppState listener so badge refreshes when notifications change â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    AppState.instance.addListener(_onAppStateChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    AppState.instance.removeListener(_onAppStateChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onAppStateChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final student = AppState.instance.currentStudent;
    final unreadCount = student == null
        ? 0
        : AppState.instance.notifications.where((n) {
            final title = n.title.toLowerCase();
            final message = n.message.toLowerCase();
            final isInterview = title.contains('interview') ||
                message.contains('scheduled interview');
            final isMember = title.contains('congratulations') ||
                message.contains('officially a member');
            return (n.studentId == student.id ||
                    n.studentId == student.studentId) &&
                (isInterview || isMember) &&
                !n.read;
          }).length;

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (bool didPop, dynamic result) {
        final now = DateTime.now();

        if (_lastBackPressed == null ||
            now.difference(_lastBackPressed!) > const Duration(seconds: 2)) {
          _lastBackPressed = now;

          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars();
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: const Text(
                'Tap again to exit',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  color: Colors.white,
                ),
              ),
              duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
              behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF1E293B),
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              ),
              margin: EdgeInsets.only(
                bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height - 140,
                left: 40,
                right: 40,
              ),
            ),
          );
        } else {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars();
          SystemChannels.platform.invokeMethod('SystemNavigator.pop');
        }
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: _background,
        body: IndexedStack(
          index: _selectedIndex,
          children: [
            if (kUseNewHome)
              NewHomeTab(
                onSwitchTab: (i) => setState(() => _selectedIndex = i),
                onOpenApplications: () => Navigator.push(
                  context,
                  MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (_) => const _MyApplicationsScreen()),
                ),
                onOpenJoinedOrgs: () => Navigator.push(
                  context,
                  MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (_) => const _JoinedOrganizationsScreen()),
                ),
                onOpenNotifications: () => Navigator.push(
                  context,
                  MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (_) =>
                          const NotificationScreen(showBackButton: true)),
                ),
              )
            else
              const _HomeTab(),
            const OrgListScreen(),
            const StudentDashboard(),
            const ProfileScreen(),
          ],
        ),
        bottomNavigationBar: _buildBottomNav(unreadCount),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBottomNav(int unreadCount) {
    final screenWidth = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width;
    final iconSize = (screenWidth * 0.065).clamp(22.0, 30.0);
    final fontSize = (screenWidth * 0.028).clamp(10.0, 13.0);

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
            blurRadius: 16,
            offset: const Offset(0, -4),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: SizedBox(
          height: (screenWidth * 0.18).clamp(56.0, 72.0),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
            children: [
              _NavItem(
                icon: Icons.home_rounded,
                label: 'Home',
                index: 0,
                selectedIndex: _selectedIndex,
                iconSize: iconSize,
                fontSize: fontSize,
                primaryColor: _primary,
                onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedIndex = 0),
              ),
              _NavItem(
                icon: Icons.groups_rounded,
                label: 'Orgs',
                index: 1,
                selectedIndex: _selectedIndex,
                iconSize: iconSize,
                fontSize: fontSize,
                primaryColor: _orgAccent,
                onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedIndex = 1),
              ),
              _NavItem(
                icon: Icons.calendar_month_rounded,
                label: 'Events',
                index: 2,
                selectedIndex: _selectedIndex,
                iconSize: iconSize,
                fontSize: fontSize,
                primaryColor: _eventsAccent,
                onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedIndex = 2),
              ),
              _NavItem(
                icon: Icons.person_rounded,
                label: 'Profile',
                index: 3,
                selectedIndex: _selectedIndex,
                iconSize: iconSize,
                fontSize: fontSize,
                primaryColor: _profileAccent,
                onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedIndex = 3),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _MyApplicationsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const _MyApplicationsScreen();

  @override
  State<_MyApplicationsScreen> createState() => _MyApplicationsScreenState();
}

class _MyApplicationsScreenState extends State<_MyApplicationsScreen> {
  bool _refreshing = true;
  bool _failed = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _refreshApplications();
  }

  Future<void> _refreshApplications() async {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _refreshing = true;
        _failed = false;
      });
    }
    try {
      final app = AppState.instance;
      if (app.currentStudent == null) await app.loadStudentProfile();

      // Only what this screen needs, and in parallel.
      await Future.wait<void>([
        app.fetchApplications(),
        if (app.organizations.isEmpty) app.fetchOrganizations(),
      ]);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Could not refresh My Applications: $e');
      if (mounted) _failed = true;
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _refreshing = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Rebuilds automatically when AppState changes (fetch finishes).
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: AppState.instance,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final authUserId =
            supabase.Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;

        // SECURITY: match ONLY on the authenticated user id (see section 3).
        final apps = AppState.instance.applications
            .where((a) => authUserId != null && a.userId == authUserId)
            .toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.compareTo(a.createdAt));

        Widget body;
        if (apps.isEmpty && _refreshing) {
          body = const Center(
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF0F8A61)));
        } else if (apps.isEmpty && _failed) {
          body = _QuickEmpty(
            icon: Icons.wifi_off_rounded,
            title: 'Could not load applications',
            subtitle: 'Check your connection and pull down to try again.',
          );
        } else if (apps.isEmpty) {
          body = const _QuickEmpty(
            icon: Icons.assignment_outlined,
            title: 'No applications yet',
            subtitle:
                'Organizations you apply to will appear here with their current status.',
          );
        } else {
          body = ListView.separated(
            physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 18, 18, 36),
            itemCount: apps.length,
            separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 10),
            itemBuilder: (_, i) => _ApplicationCard(application: apps[i]),
          );
        }

        return Scaffold(
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF1FAF6),
          body: Column(children: [
            AppHeader(
              title: 'My Applications',
              subtitle: 'Track your organization applications',
              status: apps.isEmpty
                  ? 'NO APPLICATIONS YET'
                  : '${apps.length} APPLICATION${apps.length == 1 ? '' : 'S'}',
              icon: Icons.assignment_rounded,
              onBack: () => Navigator.of(context).maybePop(),
            ),
            // Thin bar: old data stays visible while fresh data loads.
            if (_refreshing && apps.isNotEmpty)
              const LinearProgressIndicator(
                  minHeight: 2, color: Color(0xFF0F8A61)),
            Expanded(
              child: RefreshIndicator(
                color: const Color(0xFF0F8A61),
                onRefresh: _refreshApplications,
                child: apps.isEmpty
                    ? ListView(children: [
                        SizedBox(
                            height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.5,
                            child: body)
                      ])
                    : body,
              ),
            ),
          ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _ApplicationCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final Application application;
  const _ApplicationCard({required this.application});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final color = _statusColor(application.status);
    final rawApplicationOrgName = application.orgName.trim();
    final normalizedApplicationOrgName = rawApplicationOrgName.toLowerCase();
    final org =
        AppState.instance.organizations.cast<Organization?>().firstWhere(
              (candidate) =>
                  candidate != null &&
                  ((application.orgId != null &&
                          candidate.id == application.orgId) ||
                      candidate.name.trim().toLowerCase() ==
                          normalizedApplicationOrgName ||
                      candidate.acronym.trim().toLowerCase() ==
                          normalizedApplicationOrgName ||
                      (normalizedApplicationOrgName == 'scap' &&
                          candidate.acronym.trim().toLowerCase() == 'scap') ||
                      (normalizedApplicationOrgName.contains('el teatro') &&
                          candidate.name
                              .trim()
                              .toLowerCase()
                              .contains('el teatro'))),
              orElse: () => null,
            );

    // The organization was renamed from SCAP to Student Catholic Action.
    // Prefer the current organization record everywhere on the card so an
    // older application row cannot make the UI revert to the old name.
    final displayName = org?.name.trim().isNotEmpty == true
        ? org!.name
        : (normalizedApplicationOrgName == 'scap'
            ? 'Student Catholic Action'
            : rawApplicationOrgName);
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFCBE8DC)),
        boxShadow: const [
          BoxShadow(
              color: Color(0x090F8A61), blurRadius: 15, offset: Offset(0, 6))
        ],
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          if (org != null)
            _OrgLogo(asset: org.logoAsset, size: 46)
          else
            Container(
              width: 46,
              height: 46,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFFE4F7EF),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
              child: const Icon(Icons.groups_rounded, color: Color(0xFF0F8A61)),
            ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(displayName,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Color(0xFF173B30),
                        fontSize: 15,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  'Applied ${application.createdAt.month}/${application.createdAt.day}/${application.createdAt.year}',
                  style:
                      const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF6B8178), fontSize: 11.5),
                ),
                if (application.status == ApplicationStatus.declined &&
                    application.declineReason.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text('Reason: ${application.declineReason}',
                      maxLines: 3,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Color(0xFFB91C1C),
                          fontSize: 11.5,
                          height: 1.35)),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 6),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: color.withValues(alpha: .10),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
            child: Text(_statusLabel(application.status),
                style: TextStyle(
                    color: color, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static Color _statusColor(ApplicationStatus status) {
    switch (status) {
      case ApplicationStatus.accepted:
        return const Color(0xFF0F8A61);
      case ApplicationStatus.declined:
        return const Color(0xFFDC2626);
      case ApplicationStatus.interviewed:
      case ApplicationStatus.interviewScheduled:
        return const Color(0xFFD97706);
      default:
        return const Color(0xFF2563EB);
    }
  }

  static String _statusLabel(ApplicationStatus status) {
    if (status == ApplicationStatus.approved ||
        status == ApplicationStatus.accepted) {
      return 'Approved';
    }
    return status.name
        .replaceAll('_', ' ')
        .split(' ')
        .map((word) => word.isEmpty
            ? word
            : '${word[0].toUpperCase()}${word.substring(1)}')
        .join(' ');
  }
}

class _JoinedOrganizationsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const _JoinedOrganizationsScreen();

  @override
  State<_JoinedOrganizationsScreen> createState() =>
      _JoinedOrganizationsScreenState();

class _JoinedOrganizationsScreenState
    extends State<_JoinedOrganizationsScreen> {
  final Set<String> _joinedOrgIds = <String>{};
  final Set<String> _joinedOrgNames = <String>{};
  bool _loading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance
        .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadJoinedOrganizations());
  }

  Future<void> _loadJoinedOrganizations() async {
    if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = true);
    try {
      if (AppState.instance.currentStudent == null) {
        await AppState.instance.loadStudentProfile();
      }
      // These three reads are independent; load them concurrently so Joined
      // Organizations does not wait for each Supabase request one after another.
      await Future.wait<void>([
        AppState.instance.fetchOrganizations(),
        AppState.instance.fetchMembers(),
      ]);
      // Joined Organizations is derived directly from the fresh membership,
      // application, and profile data below; no extra membership-sync round trip
      // is needed just to render this screen.

      final student = AppState.instance.currentStudent;
      final ids = <String>{...?student?.joinedOrgIds};
      final names = <String>{};

      // Existing member rows.
      for (final member in AppState.instance.members) {
        final profileMatch = member.profileId == student?.id;
        final legacyNameMatch = student != null &&
            student.name.trim().isNotEmpty &&
            member.name.trim().toLowerCase() ==
                student.name.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!profileMatch && !legacyNameMatch) continue;
        final memberId = member.orgId?.trim();
        if (memberId != null && memberId.isNotEmpty) ids.add(memberId);
        final memberName = member.orgName.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (memberName.isNotEmpty) names.add(memberName);
      }

      // Use the applications already fetched for the signed-in student.
      // Supabase RLS permits students to read their own applications, so this
      // stays within AppState and avoids a second client-specific query here.
      for (final application in AppState.instance.applications) {
        final status = application.status.name.toLowerCase();
        if (status != 'approved' && status != 'accepted') continue;

        final matchesUser = student != null &&
            application.userId != null &&
            application.userId == student.id;
        final matchesStudentId = student != null &&
            student.studentId.trim().isNotEmpty &&
            application.studentId.trim() == student.studentId.trim();
        if (!matchesUser && !matchesStudentId) continue;

        final orgId = application.orgId?.trim();
        final orgName = application.orgName.trim();
        if (orgId != null && orgId.isNotEmpty) ids.add(orgId);
        if (orgName.isNotEmpty) names.add(orgName.toLowerCase());
      }

      // Name matching is a fallback for old records whose org_id is missing or
      // no longer matches the current organizations row.
      for (final org in AppState.instance.organizations) {
        if (names.contains(org.name.trim().toLowerCase())) ids.add(org.id);
      }

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _joinedOrgIds
            ..clear()
            ..addAll(ids);
          _joinedOrgNames
            ..clear()
            ..addAll(names);
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error loading Joined Orgs: $e');
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: AppState.instance,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final joined = AppState.instance.organizations
            .where((org) =>
                _joinedOrgIds.contains(org.id) ||
                _joinedOrgNames.contains(org.name.trim().toLowerCase()))
            .toList();

        return Scaffold(
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF1FAF6),
          body: Column(
            children: [
              AppHeader(
                title: 'Joined Organizations',
                subtitle: 'Your organization communities',
                status: joined.isEmpty
                    ? 'NO ORGANIZATIONS YET'
                    : '${joined.length} JOINED',
                icon: Icons.groups_rounded,
                onBack: () => Navigator.of(context).maybePop(),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: _loading
                    ? const Center(
                        child:
                            CircularProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF0F8A61)),
                      )
                    : joined.isEmpty
                        ? const _QuickEmpty(
                            icon: Icons.groups_outlined,
                            title: 'No organizations joined yet',
                            subtitle:
                                'When an application is accepted, your organization will appear here.',
                          )
                        : ListView.separated(
                            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 18, 18, 36),
                            itemCount: joined.length,
                            separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                            itemBuilder: (_, i) =>
                                _JoinedOrgCard(org: joined[i]),
                          ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

bool _isWorkflowOrganizationNotification(Notification n) {
  final title = n.title.trim().toLowerCase();
  final message = n.message.trim().toLowerCase();
  const workflowWords = [
    'proposal',
    'proposal approved',
    'proposal forwarded',
    'proposal revision',
    'proposal sent back',
    'admin / cso',
    'final posting',
    'creative submitted',
    'revision requested',
    'forwarded to admin',
    'approved and published',
    'has been approved and published',
    'final pictures',
  ];
  return workflowWords
          .any((word) => title.contains(word) || message.contains(word)) ||
      title == 'new event';
}

class _JoinedOrgCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final Organization org;
  const _JoinedOrgCard({required this.org});

  @override

                      org.shortDesc.isEmpty

                          color: Color(0xFF6B8178),

                      children: [
                        const Icon(Icons.campaign_rounded,

                        const SizedBox(width: 4),
                        Text(
                          updates == 0
                              ? 'No new updates'
                              : '$updates new update${updates == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Color(0xFF0F8A61),
                              fontSize: 10.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),

              ),
              const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: Color(0xFF6B8178)),

class _MemberOrganizationSpace extends StatefulWidget {
  final Organization org;
  const _MemberOrganizationSpace({required this.org});

  @override
  State<_MemberOrganizationSpace> createState() =>
      _MemberOrganizationSpaceState();
}

class _MemberOrganizationSpaceState extends State<_MemberOrganizationSpace> {
  final _messageController = TextEditingController();
  List<Notification> _orgAnnouncements = <Notification>[];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _orgPeople = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  bool _loadingCommunity = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadCommunityData());
  }

  Future<void> _loadCommunityData() async {
    if (mounted) setState(() => _loadingCommunity = true);
    try {
      final client = supabase.Supabase.instance.client;
      final results = await Future.wait<dynamic>([
        AppState.instance.fetchOrganizations(),
        AppState.instance.fetchEvents(),
        AppState.instance.fetchMembers(),
        AppState.instance.fetchNotifications(),
        client
            .from('notifications')
            .select('id,title,message,date,read,org_id,student_id,created_at')
            .eq('org_id', widget.org.id)
            .order('created_at', ascending: false),
        client
            .from('profiles')
            .select('id,name,role,avatar_url,assigned_org_id,org_id')
            .or('assigned_org_id.eq.${widget.org.id},org_id.eq.${widget.org.id}')
            .order('name'),
      ]);

      // Read organization notifications directly so adviser announcements are
      // shown even when an older notification row was mistakenly addressed to
      // a student's ID. Personal notification types stay in Notifications.
      final notificationRows =
          List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[4] as List);
      final announcements = notificationRows
          .map((row) => Notification(
                id: row['id']?.toString() ?? '',
                title: row['title']?.toString() ?? '',
                message: row['message']?.toString() ?? '',
                date: DateTime.tryParse(
                        (row['date'] ?? row['created_at'])?.toString() ?? '') ??
                    DateTime.now(),
                read: row['read'] == true,
                orgId: row['org_id']?.toString(),
                studentId: row['student_id']?.toString(),
              ))
          .where((n) =>
              !_isPersonalStudentNotification(n) &&
              !_isWorkflowOrganizationNotification(n))
          .toList()
        ..sort((a, b) => b.date.compareTo(a.date));

      final people = (results[5] as List)
          .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map))
          .toList();

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _orgAnnouncements = announcements;
          _orgPeople = people;
          _loadingCommunity = false;
        });
      }

      // Opening the organization space counts as seeing the adviser updates.
      final unreadAnnouncements = announcements
          .where((n) => !n.read && !_isWorkflowOrganizationNotification(n))
          .toList();
      for (final announcement in unreadAnnouncements) {
        await AppState.instance.markNotificationRead(announcement.id);
      }
      if (mounted && unreadAnnouncements.isNotEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          _orgAnnouncements = announcements
              .map((n) => unreadAnnouncements.any((u) => u.id == n.id)
                  ? n.copyWith(read: true)
                  : n)
              .toList();
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error loading member organization community: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _orgAnnouncements = <Notification>[];
          _orgPeople = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
          _loadingCommunity = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  bool _isPersonalStudentNotification(Notification n) {
    final title = n.title.trim().toLowerCase();
    final message = n.message.trim().toLowerCase();
    return title.contains('interview scheduled') ||
        title == 'application update' ||
        title.contains('congratulations') ||
        message.contains('your interview') ||
        message.contains('your application');
  }

  bool _isFeeAnnouncement(Notification n) {
    final text = '${n.title} ${n.message}'.toLowerCase();
    return RegExp(
            r'\bfee\b|fees|registration|membership dues|dues|payment|payable|â‚±|php')
        .hasMatch(text);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _messageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final org = widget.org;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final events = AppState.instance.events
        .where((e) =>
            (e.orgId == org.id || e.orgName == org.name) &&
            !DateTime(e.date.year, e.date.month, e.date.day)
                .isBefore(DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day)))
        .toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => a.date.compareTo(b.date));

    final members = AppState.instance.members
        .where((m) => m.orgId == org.id || m.orgName == org.name)
        .toList();

    final regularAnnouncements =
        _orgAnnouncements.where((n) => !_isFeeAnnouncement(n)).toList();
    final officers = _orgPeople
        .where((p) => p['role']?.toString().toLowerCase() == 'officer')
        .toList();
    final advisers = _orgPeople
        .where((p) => p['role']?.toString().toLowerCase() == 'adviser')
        .toList();
    // Officers are also organization members. Merge the organization roster
    // with saved member rows so officer positions and profile photos are shown.
    final memberRows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final memberNames = <String>{};
    for (final member in members) {
      final profile = _orgPeople.cast<Map<String, dynamic>?>().firstWhere(
            (p) => p?['id']?.toString() == member.profileId,
            orElse: () => null,
          );
      final name = member.name.trim();
      if (name.isEmpty || !memberNames.add(name.toLowerCase())) continue;
      memberRows.add({
        'name': name,
        'role': member.position,
        'avatar_url': profile?['avatar_url']?.toString() ?? ''
      });
    }
    for (final raw in org.officers) {
      final colon = raw.indexOf(':');
      final role = colon < 0 ? 'Officer' : raw.substring(0, colon).trim();
      final name = (colon < 0 ? raw : raw.substring(colon + 1)).trim();
      if (name.isEmpty || !memberNames.add(name.toLowerCase())) continue;
      final profile = _orgPeople.cast<Map<String, dynamic>?>().firstWhere(
            (p) =>
                p?['name']?.toString().trim().toLowerCase() ==
                name.toLowerCase(),
            orElse: () => null,
          );
      memberRows.add({
        'name': name,
        'role': role,
        'avatar_url': profile?['avatar_url']?.toString() ?? ''
      });
    }

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF1FAF6),
      body: Column(children: [
        _StudentOrgHeader(org: org),
        Expanded(
          child: RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: _loadCommunityData,
            color: const Color(0xFF0F8A61),

              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 28),
              children: [
                // Organization announcements only: meetings, reminders, deadlines,
                // rehearsals, orientations, and other messages sent to all members.
                _CommunitySection(
                  title: 'Organization announcements',
                  icon: Icons.campaign_rounded,
                  child: _loadingCommunity
                      ? const Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                          child: Center(
                              child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2)),
                        )
                      : regularAnnouncements.isEmpty
                          ? const Text(
                              'No organization announcements have been posted yet. Meeting notices, reminders, deadlines, and other member updates will appear here.',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: Color(0xFF6B8178), height: 1.45),
                            )
                          : Column(
                              children: regularAnnouncements.take(10).map((n) {
                                return Container(
                                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(13),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: const Color(0xFFF7FCF9),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                        color: const Color(0xFFDCEFE6)),
                                  ),
                                  child: Row(
                                    crossAxisAlignment:
                                        CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                    children: [
                                      Container(
                                        width: 42,

                                        decoration: BoxDecoration(

                                          borderRadius:
                                              BorderRadius.circular(13),
                                        ),
                                        child: const Icon(
                                            Icons.campaign_rounded,
                                            color: Color(0xFF0F8A61)),
                                      ),
                                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                      Expanded(
                                        child: Column(
                                          crossAxisAlignment:
                                              CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                          children: [
                                            Text(n.title,
                                                style: const TextStyle(
                                                    fontWeight:
                                                        FontWeight.w800)),
                                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                            Text(n.message,
                                                style: const TextStyle(
                                                    color: Color(0xFF4E665E),
                                                    height: 1.35)),
                                            const SizedBox(height: 6),
                                            Text(
                                              '${n.date.month}/${n.date.day}/${n.date.year}',
                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                  color: Color(0xFF0F8A61),

                // Fee/payment notices are pulled from the organization's own

                  child: events.isEmpty

                      : Column(

                            final image = e.imageUrl ??
                                (e.imageUrls.isNotEmpty
                                    ? e.imageUrls.first

                      else

                                      ?.toString()
                                      .trim() ??

                                  savedProfile?.avatarUrl.trim() ?? '';

class _OrgLogo extends StatelessWidget {
  final String asset;
  final double size;

  const _OrgLogo({required this.asset, required this.size});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const fallbackColor = Color(0xFFE4F7EF);
    const iconColor = Color(0xFF0F8A61);

    Widget fallback() => Container(
          width: size,
          height: size,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: fallbackColor,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: const Icon(
            Icons.groups_rounded,
            color: iconColor,
            size: 28,
          ),
        );

    final value = asset.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return fallback();

    if (value.startsWith('data:')) {
      try {
        final comma = value.indexOf(',');
        if (comma >= 0) {
          return ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
            child: Image.memory(
              base64Decode(value.substring(comma + 1)),
              width: size,
              height: size,
              fit: BoxFit.cover,
              errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => fallback(),
            ),
          );
        }
      } catch (_) {
        return fallback();
      }
    }

    if (value.startsWith('http://') || value.startsWith('https://')) {
      return ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
        child: Image.network(
          value,
          width: size,
          height: size,
          fit: BoxFit.cover,
          errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => fallback(),
        ),
      );
    }

    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
      child: Image.asset(
        value,
        width: size,
        height: size,
        fit: BoxFit.cover,
        errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => fallback(),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _OrganizationPersonTile extends StatelessWidget {
  final Map<String, dynamic> person;
  final IconData fallbackIcon;
  final bool wide;

  const _OrganizationPersonTile({
    required this.person,
    required this.fallbackIcon,
    this.wide = false,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final name = (person['name']?.toString().trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)
        ? person['name'].toString().trim()
        : 'Organization member';
    final role = person['role']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final avatarUrl = person['avatar_url']?.toString().trim() ?? '';

    final image = Container(
      width: wide ? 82 : 86,
      height: wide ? 82 : 86,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFFE4F7EF),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFCBE8DC), width: 1.4),
      ),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: avatarUrl.isNotEmpty
          ? Image.network(
              avatarUrl,
              fit: BoxFit.cover,
              errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => Icon(
                fallbackIcon,
                color: const Color(0xFF0F8A61),
                size: 30,
              ),
            )
          : Icon(fallbackIcon, color: const Color(0xFF0F8A61), size: 30),
    );

    if (wide) {
      return Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: const LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFFF8FFFB), Color(0xFFE7F8F0)],
          ),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFCBE8DC)),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            image,
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    name,
                    maxLines: 2,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Color(0xFF24463C),
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    role.isEmpty ? 'Adviser' : _roleLabel(role),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Color(0xFF0F8A61),
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 7),
                  const Text(
                    'Organization adviser',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Color(0xFF6B8178),
                      fontSize: 11,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    return Container(
      width: 132,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFFF8FFFB),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFD8EEE4)),
        boxShadow: const [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Color(0x070F8A61),
            blurRadius: 12,
            offset: Offset(0, 5),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          image,
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            name,
            maxLines: 2,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: Color(0xFF24463C),
              fontSize: 11.5,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
              height: 1.2,
            ),
          ),
          if (role.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 3),
            Text(
              _roleLabel(role),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Color(0xFF6B8178),
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _roleLabel(String role) {
    if (role.isEmpty) return role;
    return role[0].toUpperCase() + role.substring(1);
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// _HomeTab â€” shown when index == 0 (the hero header + welcome content)
// =============================================================================
class _HomeTab extends StatefulWidget {
  const _HomeTab();

  @override
  State<_HomeTab> createState() => _HomeTabState();
}

class _HomeTabState extends State<_HomeTab> {
  static const Color _primary = Color(0xFF16A34A);
  static const Color _secondary = Color(0xFF0F766E);
  static const Duration _postLifetime = Duration(days: 30);
  bool _showAllEvents = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    AppState.instance.fetchEvents();
    AnalyticsService.instance
        .logUsage('open_student_dashboard', route: 'student/home');
  }

  ImageProvider? _headerAvatar() {
    final url = AppState.instance.currentStudent?.avatarUrl ?? '';
    if (url.startsWith('data:')) {
      try {
        return MemoryImage(base64Decode(url.substring(url.indexOf(',') + 1)));
      } catch (_) {
        return null;
      }
    }
    return url.isNotEmpty ? NetworkImage(url) : null;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: AppState.instance,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final now = DateTime.now();
        final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
        final cutoff = now.subtract(_postLifetime);
        final allActiveEvents = AppState.instance.events.where((event) {
          final eventDay =
              DateTime(event.date.year, event.date.month, event.date.day);
          return !eventDay.isBefore(today) && !event.createdAt.isBefore(cutoff);
        }).toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.compareTo(a.createdAt));
        final events =
            _showAllEvents ? allActiveEvents : allActiveEvents.take(3).toList();

        return Column(
          children: [
            // The profile symbol in the hero is always synced with the
            // student's saved profile through AppState.
            AppHeader(
              title: () {
                final name = (AppState.instance.currentStudent?.name ?? '')
                    .trim()
                    .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
                    .where((p) => p.isNotEmpty)
                    .take(2)
                    .join(' ');
                return name.isNotEmpty
                    ? 'Welcome Back, $name ðŸ‘‹'
                    : 'Welcome Back ðŸ‘‹';
              }(),
              subtitle: 'Manage your organizations and campus life',
              status: 'STUDENT DASHBOARD',
              avatarImage: _headerAvatar(),
            ),
            const _QuickActionsRow(),
            // Scrolling intentionally starts at Upcoming Events.
            Expanded(
              child: Scrollbar(
                thumbVisibility: true,
                interactive: true,
                thickness: 7,
                radius: const Radius.circular(10),
                child: ListView(
                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 96),
                  children: [
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 24, 20, 14),
                      child: Row(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 4,
                            height: 22,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: _secondary,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
                          const Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text('Upcoming Events',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 18,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                        color: Color(0xFF0F0D2E),
                                        letterSpacing: -0.4)),
                                Text(
                                    'Latest posts from all campus organizations.',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 11.5,
                                        color: Color(0xFF6B6B8E),
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400)),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (allActiveEvents.length > 3)
                            TextButton(
                              onPressed: () => setState(
                                  () => _showAllEvents = !_showAllEvents),
                              child: Text(
                                  _showAllEvents ? 'Latest 3' : 'View all'),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (events.isEmpty)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 20, vertical: 40),
                        child: Center(
                          child: Column(
                            children: [
                              Container(
                                width: 72,
                                height: 72,
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  gradient: const LinearGradient(
                                      colors: [_primary, _secondary],
                                      begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                                      end: Alignment.bottomRight),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                                ),
                                child: const Icon(Icons.event_note_rounded,
                                    color: Colors.white, size: 32),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 16),
                              const Text('No events yet',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 18,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                      color: Color(0xFF0F0D2E))),
                              const SizedBox(height: 6),
                              const Text(
                                  'Events from your organizations\nwill appear here.',
                                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 13.5,
                                      color: Color(0xFF6B6B8E),
                                      height: 1.55)),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      )
                    else
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 32),
                        child: Column(
                          children: events
                              .map((event) => _EventFeedCard(event: event))
                              .toList(),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// _NavItem â€” a single bottom nav tab button
// =============================================================================
class _NavItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final IconData icon;
  final String label;
  final int index;
  final int selectedIndex;
  final double iconSize;
  final double fontSize;
  final Color primaryColor;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const _NavItem({
    required this.icon,
    required this.label,
    required this.index,
    required this.selectedIndex,
    required this.iconSize,
    required this.fontSize,
    required this.primaryColor,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isSelected = index == selectedIndex;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: onTap,
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected
              ? primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.10)
              : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Stack(
              clipBehavior: Clip.none,
              children: [
                Icon(
                  icon,
                  size: iconSize,
                  color: isSelected ? primaryColor : const Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 3),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: fontSize,
                fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                color: isSelected ? primaryColor : const Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// _EventFeedCard â€” rich card shown in the student home feed
// =============================================================================
// =============================================================================
// _EventFeedCard â€” rich card with multi-image carousel
// =============================================================================
class _EventFeedCard extends StatefulWidget {
  final Event event;
  const _EventFeedCard({required this.event});

  @override
  State<_EventFeedCard> createState() => _EventFeedCardState();
}

class _EventFeedCardState extends State<_EventFeedCard> {
  int _currentImageIndex = 0;

  // Build the final list of image URLs to show
  List<String> get _imageUrls {
    if (widget.event.imageUrls.isNotEmpty) return widget.event.imageUrls;
    if (widget.event.imageUrl != null && widget.event.imageUrl!.isNotEmpty) {
      return [widget.event.imageUrl!];
    }
    return [];
  }

  ImageProvider _eventImageProvider(String url) {
    if (url.startsWith('data:')) {
      try {
        final comma = url.indexOf(',');
        if (comma >= 0) {
          return MemoryImage(base64Decode(url.substring(comma + 1)));
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    return NetworkImage(url);
  }

  Widget _buildImage(String url, double height) {
    if (url.startsWith('data:')) {
      try {
        final comma = url.indexOf(',');
        if (comma >= 0) {
          return Image.memory(
            base64Decode(url.substring(comma + 1)),
            width: double.infinity,
            height: height,
            fit: BoxFit.cover,
            errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _imageFallback(height),
          );
        }
      } catch (_) {}
      return _imageFallback(height);
    }

    return Image.network(
      url,
      width: double.infinity,
      height: height,
      fit: BoxFit.cover,
      loadingBuilder: (context, child, progress) {
        if (progress == null) return child;
        return Container(
          height: height,
          color: const Color(0xFFDCFCE7),
          child: const Center(
            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
              color: Color(0xFF16A34A),
              strokeWidth: 2,
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _imageFallback(height),
    );
  }

  Widget _imageFallback(double height) => Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        height: height,
        color: const Color(0xFFDCFCE7),
        alignment: Alignment.center,
        child: const Icon(
          Icons.broken_image_rounded,
          color: Color(0xFF16A34A),
          size: 36,
        ),
      );

  void _openZoom(BuildContext context, String url) {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => Scaffold(
          backgroundColor: Colors.black,
          appBar: AppBar(
            backgroundColor: Colors.black,
            iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: Colors.white),
            elevation: 0,
          ),
          body: Center(
            child: InteractiveViewer(
              minScale: 0.8,
              maxScale: 4.0,
              child:
                  Image(image: _eventImageProvider(url), fit: BoxFit.contain),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    final isUpcoming = !DateTime(widget.event.date.year,
            widget.event.date.month, widget.event.date.day)
        .isBefore(today);
    final urls = _imageUrls;
    final hasImages = urls.isNotEmpty;
    final hasMultiple = urls.length > 1;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(
          color: isUpcoming
              ? const Color(0xFF16A34A).withValues(alpha: 0.18)
              : const Color(0xFFE8E9F3),
        ),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: const Color(0xFF16A34A).withValues(alpha: 0.06),
            blurRadius: 20,
            offset: const Offset(0, 6),
          ),
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
            blurRadius: 6,
            offset: const Offset(0, 2),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          // â”€â”€ Image / Carousel â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
          if (hasImages)
            ClipRRect(
              borderRadius:
                  const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
              child: Stack(
                children: [
                  // â”€â”€ Carousel or single image â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  String _formatDate(DateTime dt) {
    const months = [
      'Jan',
      'Feb',
      'Mar',
      'Apr',
      'May',
      'Jun',
      'Jul',
      'Aug',
      'Sep',
      'Oct',
      'Nov',
      'Dec'
    ];
    return '${months[dt.month - 1]} ${dt.day}, ${dt.year}';
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart' hide Notification;
import '../../../core/app_state.dart';
import 'home_tokens.dart';

import 'home_event_utils.dart';

class AllUpcomingEventsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AllUpcomingEventsPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<AllUpcomingEventsPage> createState() => _AllUpcomingEventsPageState();
}

class _AllUpcomingEventsPageState extends State<AllUpcomingEventsPage> {
  Map<String, int> _interest = {};
  String _lastLoadedKey = '';
  int _sortChoice = 0; // 0: Soonest first, 1: Newest posts

  Future<void> _fetchInterests(List<String> ids) async {
    if (ids.isEmpty) return;
    final key = ids.join(',');
    _lastLoadedKey = key;
    try {
      final counts = await HomeData.fetchEventInterestCounts(ids);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _interest = counts;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error fetching event interest counts: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _reloadInterest() async {
    _lastLoadedKey = '';
    final events = HomeData.upcomingEvents();
    final ids = events.map((e) => e.id).toList()..sort();
    await _fetchInterests(ids);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return HomeLayout.capText(
      context,
      AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: AppState.instance,
        builder: (context, child) {
          final events = HomeData.upcomingEvents();
          final ids = events.map((e) => e.id).toList()..sort();
          final currentKey = ids.join(',');

          if (currentKey != _lastLoadedKey) {
            _lastLoadedKey = currentKey;
            WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
              _fetchInterests(ids);
            });
          }

          final displayEvents = List<Event>.from(events);
          if (_sortChoice == 1) {
            displayEvents.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.compareTo(a.createdAt));
          }

          return Scaffold(
            backgroundColor: HC.bg,
            body: RefreshIndicator(
              color: HC.primary,
              onRefresh: () async {
                try {
                  await AppState.instance.fetchEvents();
                  await _reloadInterest();
                } catch (e) {
                  debugPrint('Error refreshing upcoming events: $e');
                }
              },
              child: ListView.builder(
                physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(
                  parent: BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                ),
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(
                  bottom: 32 + MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom,
                ),
                itemCount:
                    2 + (displayEvents.isEmpty ? 1 : displayEvents.length),
                itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                  if (index == 0) {
                    return _buildHeader(context, displayEvents.length);
                  }
                  if (index == 1) {
                    return Center(
                      child: ConstrainedBox(
                        constraints: BoxConstraints(
                          maxWidth: HomeLayout.of(context).contentWidth,
                        ),
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                            HomeLayout.of(context).hPad,
                            16,
                            HomeLayout.of(context).hPad,
                            8,
                          ),
                          child: _buildSortChips(),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  }

                  if (displayEvents.isEmpty) {
                    return Center(
                      child: ConstrainedBox(
                        constraints: BoxConstraints(
                          maxWidth: HomeLayout.of(context).contentWidth,
                        ),
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: HomeLayout.of(context).hPad,
                            vertical: 24,
                          ),
                          child: const _EmptyStateCard(),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  }

                  final eventIndex = index - 2;
                  final event = displayEvents[eventIndex];
                  return Center(
                    child: ConstrainedBox(
                      constraints: BoxConstraints(
                        maxWidth: HomeLayout.of(context).contentWidth,
                      ),
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: HomeLayout.of(context).hPad,
                          vertical: 7,
                        ),
                        child: _EventCard(
                          event: event,
                          interestedCount: _interest[event.id] ?? 0,
                          onTap: () {
                            showEventDetailsSheet(
                              context,
                              event: event,
                              interestedCount: _interest[event.id] ?? 0,
                              onInterestChanged: _reloadInterest,
                            );
                          },
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeader(BuildContext context, int count) {
    final topPadding = MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top;
    final width = HomeLayout.of(context).contentWidth;
    final hPad = HomeLayout.of(context).hPad;
    final subtitle = count == 1 ? '1 event' : '$count events';

    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        gradient: HC.heroGradient,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(bottom: Radius.circular(26)),
      ),
      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(hPad, topPadding + 12, hPad, 20),
      child: Center(
        child: ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: width),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Row(
                children: [
                  SizedBox(
                    width: 44,
                    height: 44,
                    child: IconButton(
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.maybePop(context),
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        size: 20,
                      ),
                      tooltip: 'Back',
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  const Text(
                    'Upcoming Events',
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontSize: 20,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 52),
                child: Text(
                  subtitle,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
                    fontSize: 14,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSortChips() {
    return ConstrainedBox(
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 40),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          ChoiceChip(
            label: const Text('Soonest first'),
            selected: _sortChoice == 0,
            onSelected: (selected) {
              if (selected) {
                setState(() {
                  _sortChoice = 0;
                });
              }
            },
            selectedColor: HC.mint,
            backgroundColor: Colors.white,
            labelStyle: TextStyle(
              color: _sortChoice == 0 ? HC.dark : HC.ink,
              fontWeight:
                  _sortChoice == 0 ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          ChoiceChip(
            label: const Text('Newest posts'),
            selected: _sortChoice == 1,
            onSelected: (selected) {
              if (selected) {
                setState(() {
                  _sortChoice = 1;
                });
              }
            },
            selectedColor: HC.mint,
            backgroundColor: Colors.white,
            labelStyle: TextStyle(
              color: _sortChoice == 1 ? HC.dark : HC.ink,
              fontWeight:
                  _sortChoice == 1 ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart' hide Notification;
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' as supabase;

import '../../../core/app_state.dart';
import '../../analytics/event_comments_sheet.dart';
import 'home_event_utils.dart';
import 'home_tokens.dart';

/// Shows event information and lets students manage interest and comments.
Future<void> showEventDetailsSheet(
  BuildContext context, {
  required Event event,
  int interestedCount = 0,
  VoidCallback? onInterestChanged,
}) async {
  await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
    context: context,
    isScrollControlled: true,
    useSafeArea: true,
    backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
    builder: (sheetContext) {
      return HomeLayout.capText(
        sheetContext,
        DraggableScrollableSheet(
          expand: false,
          initialChildSize: 0.88,
          minChildSize: 0.5,
          maxChildSize: 0.95,
          builder: (context, scrollController) {
            return _EventDetailsSheet(
              event: event,
              interestedCount: interestedCount,
              onInterestChanged: onInterestChanged,
              scrollController: scrollController,
            );
          },
        ),
      );
    },
  );
}

/// Implements the scrollable event details and interaction controls.
class _EventDetailsSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const _EventDetailsSheet({
    required this.event,
    required this.interestedCount,
    required this.scrollController,
    this.onInterestChanged,
  });

  final Event event;
  final int interestedCount;
  final VoidCallback? onInterestChanged;
  final ScrollController scrollController;

  @override
  State<_EventDetailsSheet> createState() => _EventDetailsSheetState();
}

class _EventDetailsSheetState extends State<_EventDetailsSheet> {
  final PageController _imageController = PageController();

  late List<String> _images;
  late int _interestedCount;

  int _currentImage = 0;
  bool _isInterested = false;
  bool _isCheckingInterest = true;
  bool _isWritingInterest = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _images = _collectImages(widget.event);
    _interestedCount = widget.interestedCount.clamp(0, 1 << 30).toInt();
    _loadInterestStatus();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _EventDetailsSheet oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);

    if (oldWidget.event.id != widget.event.id) {
      _images = _collectImages(widget.event);
      _currentImage = 0;
      _interestedCount = widget.interestedCount.clamp(0, 1 << 30).toInt();
      _isInterested = false;
      _isCheckingInterest = true;
      _isWritingInterest = false;

      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted && _imageController.hasClients) {
          _imageController.jumpToPage(0);
        }
      });

      _loadInterestStatus();
    } else if (oldWidget.interestedCount != widget.interestedCount &&
        !_isWritingInterest) {
      _interestedCount = widget.interestedCount.clamp(0, 1 << 30).toInt();
    }
  }

  List<String> _collectImages(Event event) {
    final images = event.imageUrls
        .map((url) => url.trim())
        .where((url) => url.isNotEmpty)
        .toList(growable: false);

    if (images.isNotEmpty) {
      return images;
    }

    final cover = event.imageUrl?.trim();
    if (cover != null && cover.isNotEmpty) {
      return <String>[cover];
    }

    return <String>[];
  }

  Future<void> _loadInterestStatus() async {
    final client = supabase.Supabase.instance.client;
    final userId = client.auth.currentUser?.id;

    if (userId == null) {
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _isInterested = false;
        _isCheckingInterest = false;
      });
      return;
    }

    try {
      final row = await client
          .from('event_reactions')
          .select('reaction')
          .eq('event_id', widget.event.id)
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .maybeSingle();

      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _isInterested = row != null && row['reaction'] == 'heart';
        _isCheckingInterest = false;
      });
    } catch (error, stackTrace) {
      debugPrint('Unable to load event interest status: $error\n$stackTrace');

      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _isInterested = false;
        _isCheckingInterest = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _toggleInterest() async {
    if (_isWritingInterest || _isCheckingInterest) {
      return;
    }

    final client = supabase.Supabase.instance.client;
    final userId = client.auth.currentUser?.id;

    if (userId == null) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Please log in to mark interest.'),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final wasInterested = _isInterested;
    final previousCount = _interestedCount;

    setState(() {
      _isWritingInterest = true;
      _isInterested = !wasInterested;

      if (wasInterested) {
        if (_interestedCount > 0) {
          _interestedCount--;
        }
      } else {
        _interestedCount++;
      }
    });

    try {
      if (wasInterested) {
        await client
            .from('event_reactions')
            .delete()
            .eq('event_id', widget.event.id)
            .eq('user_id', userId);
      } else {
        await client.from('event_reactions').upsert(
          <String, dynamic>{
            'event_id': widget.event.id,
            'user_id': userId,
            'reaction': 'heart',
          },
          onConflict: 'event_id,user_id',
        );
      }

      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _isWritingInterest = false;
      });

      widget.onInterestChanged?.call();
    } catch (error, stackTrace) {
      debugPrint('Unable to update event interest: $error\n$stackTrace');

      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _isInterested = wasInterested;
        _interestedCount = previousCount;
        _isWritingInterest = false;
      });

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Could not update interest. Please try again.'),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  void _openImage(int index) {
    if (_images.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => _FullScreenImageGallery(
          images: _images,
          initialPage: index,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildImageArea() {
    if (_images.isEmpty) {
      return ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        child: SizedBox(
          height: 220,
          width: double.infinity,
          child: eventGradientFallback(iconSize: 46),
        ),
      );
    }

    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      child: SizedBox(
        height: 220,
        width: double.infinity,
        child: Stack(
          fit: StackFit.expand,
          children: <Widget>[
            PageView.builder(
              controller: _imageController,
              itemCount: _images.length,
              onPageChanged: (index) {
                if (!mounted) {
                  return;
                }

                setState(() {
                  _currentImage = index;
                });
              },
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                return GestureDetector(
                  behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                  onTap: () => _openImage(index),
                  child: EventImage(
                    url: _images[index],
                    fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
            if (_images.length > 1)
              Positioned(
                top: 10,
                right: 10,
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 10,
                    vertical: 6,
                  ),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: HC.dark.withValues(alpha: 0.82),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    '${_currentImage + 1} / ${_images.length}',
                    style: const TextStyle(

            if (_images.length > 1)

/// Displays event images on a black route with pinch-to-zoom support.
class _FullScreenImageGallery extends StatefulWidget {
  const _FullScreenImageGallery({
    required this.images,
    required this.initialPage,
  });

  final List<String> images;
  final int initialPage;

  @override
  State<_FullScreenImageGallery> createState() =>
      _FullScreenImageGalleryState();
}

class _FullScreenImageGalleryState extends State<_FullScreenImageGallery> {
  late final PageController _controller;
  late int _currentPage;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    _currentPage =
        widget.initialPage.clamp(0, widget.images.length - 1).toInt();
    _controller = PageController(initialPage: _currentPage);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.black,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: Colors.black,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        title: widget.images.length > 1
            ? Text(
                '${_currentPage + 1} / ${widget.images.length}',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
              )
            : const SizedBox.shrink(),
      ),
      body: PageView.builder(
        controller: _controller,
        itemCount: widget.images.length,
        onPageChanged: (index) {
          if (!mounted) {
            return;
          }

          setState(() {
            _currentPage = index;
          });
        },
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          return InteractiveViewer(
            minScale: 0.8,
            maxScale: 4,
            child: SizedBox.expand(
              child: EventImage(
                url: widget.images[index],
                fit: BoxFit.contain,
                fallback: const SizedBox.expand(),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

/// Presents up to five campus events in an autoplaying featured banner.
class FeaturedEventCarousel extends StatefulWidget {
  const FeaturedEventCarousel({
    super.key,
    required this.events,
    required this.onViewDetails,
  });

  final List<Event> events;
  final void Function(Event) onViewDetails;

  @override
  State<FeaturedEventCarousel> createState() => _FeaturedEventCarouselState();
}

class _FeaturedEventCarouselState extends State<FeaturedEventCarousel> {
  final PageController _pageController = PageController(viewportFraction: 1);

  Timer? _autoplayTimer;
  DateTime? _pauseAutoplayUntil;

  int _currentPage = 0;
  bool _animationsDisabled = false;

  List<Event> get _events => widget.events.take(5).toList(growable: false);

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();

    _animationsDisabled = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
    _syncAutoplayTimer();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant FeaturedEventCarousel oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);

    final eventCount = _events.length;

    if (eventCount == 0) {
      _currentPage = 0;
    } else if (_currentPage >= eventCount) {
      _currentPage = eventCount - 1;
    }

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted && _pageController.hasClients) {
        _pageController.jumpToPage(_currentPage);
      }
    });

    _syncAutoplayTimer();
  }

  void _syncAutoplayTimer() {
    if (_animationsDisabled || _events.length < 2) {
      _autoplayTimer?.cancel();
      _autoplayTimer = null;
      return;
    }

    if (_autoplayTimer != null) {
      return;
    }

    _autoplayTimer = Timer.periodic(
      const Duration(seconds: 6),
      (_) => _advancePage(),
    );
  }

  void _pauseAutoplay() {
    _pauseAutoplayUntil = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(seconds: 10));
  }

  void _advancePage() {
    if (!mounted ||
        _animationsDisabled ||
        _events.length < 2 ||
        !_pageController.hasClients) {
      return;
    }

    final pausedUntil = _pauseAutoplayUntil;
    if (pausedUntil != null && DateTime.now().isBefore(pausedUntil)) {
      return;
    }

    final nextPage = (_currentPage + 1) % _events.length;

    _pageController.animateToPage(
      nextPage,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
      curve: Curves.easeInOut,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBanner(
    BuildContext context,

    final isWide = width >= 340;
    final cover = eventCoverImage(event);

        label: formatDateShort(event.date),

        _FeaturedMetaItem(
          icon: Icons.schedule_rounded,
          label: event.timeLabel.trim(),
          maxWidth: metaMaxWidth,
        ),
      if (event.venue.trim().isNotEmpty)
        _FeaturedMetaItem(
          icon: Icons.location_on_outlined,
          label: event.venue.trim(),
          maxWidth: metaMaxWidth,
        ),
    ];

    return Semantics(
      button: true,
      label: 'Featured event: ${event.title}, button',
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: () => widget.onViewDetails(event),

  @override
  void dispose() {

    _pageController.dispose();
