  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final events = _events;

    if (events.isEmpty) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final width = constraints.maxWidth.isFinite
            ? constraints.maxWidth
            : MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width -
                (HomeLayout.of(context).hPad * 2);

        final height = (width * 0.58).clamp(190.0, 250.0).toDouble();

        return SizedBox(

                  _currentPage = index;
                });

                return _buildBanner(
                  context,
                  events[index],
                  width,
                  height,
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

===== FILE: lib\screens\Student_Role\home\home_data.dart =====

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' as supabase;
import '../../../core/app_state.dart';

/// Read-only data helpers for the new Home tab.
/// Every method fails safe: on error it returns an empty/zero result.
class HomeData {
  /// org id -> number of members (uses get_org_member_counts()).
  static Future<Map<String, int>> fetchOrgMemberCounts() async {
    try {
      final rows =
          await supabase.Supabase.instance.client.rpc('get_org_member_counts');
      final out = <String, int>{};
      for (final r in (rows as List)) {
        final id = r['org_id']?.toString() ?? '';
        if (id.isEmpty) continue;
        out[id] = (r['member_count'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
      }
      return out;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('HomeData.fetchOrgMemberCounts failed: $e');
      return <String, int>{};
    }
  }

  /// event id -> number of reactions (shown as "interested").
  static Future<Map<String, int>> fetchEventInterestCounts(
      Iterable<String> eventIds) async {
    final ids = eventIds.where((e) => e.isNotEmpty).toList();
    if (ids.isEmpty) return <String, int>{};
    try {
      final rows = await supabase.Supabase.instance.client
          .from('event_reactions')
          .select('event_id')
          .inFilter('event_id', ids);
      final out = <String, int>{};
      for (final r in (rows as List)) {
        final id = r['event_id']?.toString() ?? '';
        if (id.isEmpty) continue;
        out[id] = (out[id] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
      return out;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('HomeData.fetchEventInterestCounts failed: $e');
      return <String, int>{};
    }
  }

  /// Applications still in progress for the signed-in user (badge number).
  static int inProgressApplicationCount() {
    final uid = supabase.Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return 0;
    const active = {
      ApplicationStatus.pending,
      ApplicationStatus.interviewScheduled,
      ApplicationStatus.interviewed,
      ApplicationStatus.forApproval,
    };
    return AppState.instance.applications
        .where((a) => a.userId == uid && active.contains(a.status))
        .length;
  }

  /// Same unread rule the old dashboard used for its bell badge.
  static int unreadNotificationCount() {
    final student = AppState.instance.currentStudent;
    if (student == null) return 0;
    return AppState.instance.notifications.where((n) {
      final title = n.title.toLowerCase();
      final message = n.message.toLowerCase();
      final isInterview = title.contains('interview') ||
          message.contains('scheduled interview');
      final isMember = title.contains('congratulations') ||
          message.contains('officially a member');
      return (n.studentId == student.id || n.studentId == student.studentId) &&
          (isInterview || isMember) &&
          !n.read;
    }).length;
  }

  /// Upcoming events, soonest first. Same visibility rule as before:
  /// not in the past, and posted within the last [maxAgeDays] days.
  static List<Event> upcomingEvents({int maxAgeDays = 30}) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    final cutoff = now.subtract(Duration(days: maxAgeDays));
    final list = AppState.instance.events.where((e) {
      final day = DateTime(e.date.year, e.date.month, e.date.day);
      return !day.isBefore(today) && !e.createdAt.isBefore(cutoff);
    }).toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => a.date.compareTo(b.date));
    return list;
  }
}

class _HomeEventsSectionState extends State<HomeEventsSection> {
  Map<String, int> _interest = <String, int>{};
  String? _interestKey;

  void _scheduleInterestLoad(List<String> ids) {
    final key = ids.join('|');

    if (key == _interestKey) {
      return;
    }

    // Record the key before scheduling the load to avoid repeated requests
    // during subsequent builds.
    _interestKey = key;

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      _loadInterestForKey(ids, key);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadInterestForKey(
    List<String> ids,
    String key,
  ) async {
    if (ids.isEmpty) {
      if (!mounted || _interestKey != key) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _interest = <String, int>{};
      });
      return;
    }

    try {
      final counts = await HomeData.fetchEventInterestCounts(ids);

      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      if (_interestKey != key) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _interest = <String, int>{
          for (final id in ids) id: counts[id] ?? 0,
        };
      });
    } catch (error, stackTrace) {
      debugPrint('Unable to load event interest counts: $error\n$stackTrace');

      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      if (_interestKey != key) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _interest = <String, int>{
          for (final id in ids) id: 0,
        };
      });
    }
  }

    final ids = HomeData.upcomingEvents()
        .map((event) => event.id)
        .toList(growable: false);

    _loadInterestForKey(ids, key);

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:cached_network_image/cached_network_image.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart' hide Notification;

import '../../../core/app_state.dart';
import 'home_tokens.dart';

/// Returns the first usable image URL for an event.
String? eventCoverImage(Event event) {
  for (final url in event.imageUrls) {
    if (url.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return url.trim();
    }
  }

  final singleImage = event.imageUrl;
  if (singleImage != null && singleImage.trim().isNotEmpty) {
    return singleImage.trim();
  }

  return null;
}

/// Displays a network image, an embedded base64 image, or a fallback.
class EventImage extends StatefulWidget {
  const EventImage({
    super.key,
    required this.url,
    this.fit = BoxFit.cover,
    this.fallback,
  });

  final String url;
  final BoxFit fit;
  final Widget? fallback;

  @override
  State<EventImage> createState() => _EventImageState();
}

class _EventImageState extends State<EventImage> {
  Uint8List? _dataBytes;
  bool _isDataUrl = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _decodeCurrentUrl();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant EventImage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);

    if (oldWidget.url != widget.url) {
      _decodeCurrentUrl();
    }
  }

  void _decodeCurrentUrl() {
    _isDataUrl = widget.url.toLowerCase().startsWith('data:');
    _dataBytes = null;

    if (!_isDataUrl) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      final commaIndex = widget.url.indexOf(',');
      if (commaIndex < 0) {
        throw const FormatException('Invalid data URL.');
      }

      final metadata = widget.url.substring(0, commaIndex);
      if (!metadata.toLowerCase().contains(';base64')) {
        throw const FormatException('Expected a base64 data URL.');
      }

      final encoded = widget.url.substring(commaIndex + 1);
      _dataBytes = base64Decode(encoded);
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('EventImage: unable to decode embedded image: $error');
      _dataBytes = null;
    }
  }

  Widget _fallback() {
    return widget.fallback ?? eventGradientFallback();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isDataUrl) {
      final bytes = _dataBytes;
      if (bytes == null) {
        return _fallback();
      }

      return Image.memory(
        bytes,
        fit: widget.fit,
        gaplessPlayback: true,
        errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) => _fallback(),
      );
    }

    final normalizedUrl = widget.url.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (normalizedUrl.startsWith('https://') ||
        normalizedUrl.startsWith('http://')) {
      return CachedNetworkImage(
        imageUrl: widget.url.trim(),
        fit: widget.fit,
        placeholder: (context, url) => const ColoredBox(
          color: HC.mint,
          child: Center(
            child: Icon(
              Icons.image_outlined,
              color: HC.primary,
              size: 30,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        errorWidget: (context, url, error) => _fallback(),
      );
    }

    return _fallback();
  }
}

/// Provides a green gradient image placeholder without requiring an asset.
Widget eventGradientFallback({double iconSize = 34}) {
  return Container(
    decoration: const BoxDecoration(gradient: HC.heroGradient),
    alignment: Alignment.center,
    child: Icon(
      Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
      color: Colors.white,
      size: iconSize,
    ),
  );
}

const List<String> _monthShort = <String>[
  'Jan',
  'Feb',
  'Mar',
  'Apr',
  'May',
  'Jun',
  'Jul',
  'Aug',
  'Sep',
  'Oct',
  'Nov',
  'Dec',
];

const List<String> _monthFull = <String>[
  'January',
  'February',
  'March',
  'April',
  'May',
  'June',
  'July',
  'August',
  'September',
  'October',
  'November',
  'December',
];

const List<String> _weekdayFull = <String>[
  'Monday',
  'Tuesday',
  'Wednesday',
  'Thursday',
  'Friday',
  'Saturday',
  'Sunday',
];

/// Returns a three-letter uppercase month, such as OCT.
String monthShortUpper(int month) {
  if (month < 1 || month > _monthShort.length) {
    return '';
  }

  return _monthShort[month - 1].toUpperCase();
}

/// Formats a date as "Oct 22, 2026".
String formatDateShort(DateTime date) {
  final month = _monthShort[date.month - 1];
  return '$month ${date.day}, ${date.year}';
}

/// Formats a date as "Thursday, October 22, 2026".
String formatDateFull(DateTime date) {
  final weekday = _weekdayFull[date.weekday - 1];
  final month = _monthFull[date.month - 1];
  return '$weekday, $month ${date.day}, ${date.year}';
}

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:cached_network_image/cached_network_image.dart';

/// Displays an organization logo with reliable fallbacks for every source type.
class OrgLogoAvatar extends StatefulWidget {
  final String logoAsset;
  final double size;
  final double radius;

  const OrgLogoAvatar({
    super.key,
    required this.logoAsset,
    required this.size,
    this.radius = 14,
  });

  @override
  State<OrgLogoAvatar> createState() => _OrgLogoAvatarState();
}

/// Holds decoded image data so data URIs are not decoded on every rebuild.
class _OrgLogoAvatarState extends State<OrgLogoAvatar> {
  Uint8List? _dataBytes;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _decodeDataUri();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant OrgLogoAvatar oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);

    if (oldWidget.logoAsset != widget.logoAsset) {
      _decodeDataUri();
    }
  }

  void _decodeDataUri() {
    _dataBytes = null;

    final source = widget.logoAsset;
    if (!source.startsWith('data:')) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      final commaIndex = source.indexOf(',');
      if (commaIndex < 0) {
        throw const FormatException('Invalid data URI.');
      }

      final metadata = source.substring(0, commaIndex).toLowerCase();
      if (!metadata.contains(';base64')) {
        throw const FormatException('Expected a base64 data URI.');
      }

      final encodedData = source.substring(commaIndex + 1);
      _dataBytes = Uint8List.fromList(base64.decode(encodedData));
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Unable to decode organization logo: $error');
      _dataBytes = null;
    }
  }

  Widget _fallback() {
    return SizedBox(
      width: widget.size,
      height: widget.size,
      child: Center(
        child: Icon(
          Icons.groups_rounded,
          size: widget.size * 0.48,
          color: HC.primary,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _preferredAssetPath(String path) {
    return path.replaceFirst(
      RegExp(r'\.(jpe?g)$', caseSensitive: false),
      '.png',
    );
  }

  Widget _localAssetImage() {
    final originalPath = widget.logoAsset;
    final preferredPath = _preferredAssetPath(originalPath);

    return Image.asset(
      preferredPath,
      width: widget.size,
      height: widget.size,
      fit: BoxFit.contain,
      errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) {
        if (preferredPath == originalPath) {
          return _fallback();
        }

        return Image.asset(
          originalPath,
          width: widget.size,
          height: widget.size,
          fit: BoxFit.contain,
          errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) => _fallback(),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _logoContent() {
    final source = widget.logoAsset.trim();

    if (source.isEmpty) {
      return _fallback();
    }

    if (source.startsWith('data:')) {
      final bytes = _dataBytes;

      if (bytes == null) {
        return _fallback();
      }

      return Image.memory(
        bytes,
        width: widget.size,
        height: widget.size,
        fit: BoxFit.contain,
        errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) => _fallback(),
      );
    }

    if (source.startsWith('http://') || source.startsWith('https://')) {
      return CachedNetworkImage(
        imageUrl: source,
        width: widget.size,
        height: widget.size,
        fit: BoxFit.contain,
        placeholder: (context, url) => _fallback(),
        errorWidget: (context, url, error) => _fallback(),
      );
    }

    return _localAssetImage();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      width: widget.size,
      height: widget.size,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: HC.mint,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(widget.radius),
        border: Border.all(color: HC.line),
      ),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
          (widget.radius - 1).clamp(0, widget.radius).toDouble(),
        ),
        child: Center(child: _logoContent()),
      ),
    );
  }
}


===== FILE: lib\screens\Student_Role\home\home_recommendations.dart =====

import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' as supabase;

import '../../../core/app_state.dart';

/// Calculates organization recommendations using the current student's data.
class OrgRecommender {
  OrgRecommender._();

  static String? _currentUserId() {
    return supabase.Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
  }

  static void _addIfValid(Set<String> destination, String? id) {
    if (id != null && id.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      destination.add(id);
    }
  }

  /// Returns organizations the student has joined through any supported
  /// membership source.
  static Set<String> joinedOrgIds() {
    final state = AppState.instance;
    final currentStudent = state.currentStudent;
    final userId = _currentUserId();

    final joinedIds = <String>{};

    if (currentStudent != null) {
      for (final id in currentStudent.joinedOrgIds) {
        _addIfValid(joinedIds, id);
      }
    }

    if (userId != null && userId.isNotEmpty) {
      for (final application in state.applications) {
        if (application.userId != userId) {
          continue;
        }

        final isApproved = application.status == ApplicationStatus.approved ||
            application.status == ApplicationStatus.accepted;

        if (isApproved) {
          _addIfValid(joinedIds, application.orgId);
        }
      }
    }

    if (currentStudent != null && currentStudent.id.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      for (final member in state.members) {
        if (member.profileId == currentStudent.id) {
          _addIfValid(joinedIds, member.orgId);
        }
      }
    }

    return joinedIds;
  }

  /// Returns organizations for which the authenticated student has applied.
  static Set<String> appliedOrgIds() {
    final userId = _currentUserId();

    if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty) {
      return <String>{};
    }

    final appliedIds = <String>{};

    for (final application in AppState.instance.applications) {
      if (application.userId == userId) {
        _addIfValid(appliedIds, application.orgId);
      }
    }

    return appliedIds;
  }

  static String _normalizedCategory(String value) {
    return value.trim().toLowerCase();
  }

  static int _memberCount(
    Map<String, int> memberCounts,
    String orgId,
  ) {
    final count = memberCounts[orgId] ?? 0;
    return count > 0 ? count : 0;
  }

  /// Ranks organizations by joined-category relevance, application status,
  /// member count, and name. The result is deterministic for the same input.
  static List<Organization> recommend({
    Map<String, int> memberCounts = const <String, int>{},
    int limit = 10,
  }) {
    if (limit <= 0) {
      return <Organization>[];
    }

    final state = AppState.instance;
    final joinedIds = joinedOrgIds();
    final appliedIds = appliedOrgIds();

    final joinedCategories = <String>{};

    for (final organization in state.organizations) {
      if (joinedIds.contains(organization.id)) {
        final category = _normalizedCategory(organization.category);

        if (category.isNotEmpty) {
          joinedCategories.add(category);
        }
      }
    }

    final candidates = state.organizations.where((organization) {
      return organization.id.trim().isNotEmpty &&
          !joinedIds.contains(organization.id);
    }).toList();

    int score(Organization organization) {
      var result = 0;
      final category = _normalizedCategory(organization.category);

      if (category.isNotEmpty && joinedCategories.contains(category)) {
        result += 3;
      }

      if (appliedIds.contains(organization.id)) {
        result -= 5;
      }

      return result;
    }

    candidates.sort((a, b) {
      final scoreComparison = score(b).compareTo(score(a));

      if (scoreComparison != 0) {
        return scoreComparison;
      }

      final memberComparison = _memberCount(
        memberCounts,
        b.id,
      ).compareTo(
        _memberCount(memberCounts, a.id),
      );

      if (memberComparison != 0) {
        return memberComparison;
      }

      final nameComparison = a.name.toLowerCase().compareTo(
            b.name.toLowerCase(),
          );

      if (nameComparison != 0) {
        return nameComparison;
      }

      return a.id.compareTo(b.id);
    });

    return candidates.take(limit).toList();
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart' hide Notification;

import '../../../core/app_state.dart';

import 'home_data.dart';
import 'home_org_logo.dart';
import 'home_recommendations.dart';
import 'home_saved_orgs.dart';
import 'home_tokens.dart';

/// Displays horizontally scrolling organization recommendations on the
/// student Home screen.
class HomeRecommendedSection extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback onViewAll;

  const HomeRecommendedSection({
    super.key,
    required this.onViewAll,
  });

  @override
  State<HomeRecommendedSection> createState() => _HomeRecommendedSectionState();
}

/// Manages recommendation counts and saved-organization updates.
class _HomeRecommendedSectionState extends State<HomeRecommendedSection> {
  Map<String, int> _counts = <String, int>{};
  String? _lastCountOrgKey;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    SavedOrgs.instance.addListener(_onSavedOrgsChanged);
    AppState.instance.addListener(_onAppStateChanged);

    SavedOrgs.instance.load();

    final initialKey = _organizationIdsKey();
    _lastCountOrgKey = initialKey;
    _fetchMemberCounts(initialKey);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    SavedOrgs.instance.removeListener(_onSavedOrgsChanged);
    AppState.instance.removeListener(_onAppStateChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _organizationIdsKey() {
    final ids = AppState.instance.organizations
        .map((organization) => organization.id)
        .toList()
      ..sort();

    return ids.join('\u001F');
  }

  void _onSavedOrgsChanged() {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }

    setState(() {});
  }

  void _onAppStateChanged() {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }

    setState(() {});
  }

  void _scheduleCountRefreshIfNeeded() {
    final currentKey = _organizationIdsKey();

    if (currentKey == _lastCountOrgKey) {
      return;
    }

    // Set the key before the asynchronous request to avoid rebuild loops.
    _lastCountOrgKey = currentKey;

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      _fetchMemberCounts(currentKey);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _fetchMemberCounts(String requestedKey) async {
    try {
      final counts = await HomeData.fetchOrgMemberCounts();

      if (!mounted || requestedKey != _organizationIdsKey()) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _counts = counts;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Unable to refresh organization member counts: $error');
    }
  }

  void _openOrganization(
    BuildContext context,
    String orgId, {
    int initialTab = 0,
  }) {
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => OrgDetailScreen(
          orgId: orgId,
          initialTab: initialTab,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    _scheduleCountRefreshIfNeeded();

    final organizations = OrgRecommender.recommend(
      memberCounts: _counts,
    );

    if (organizations.isEmpty) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final layout = HomeLayout.of(context);
    final cardWidth = layout.cardWidth(min: 190, max: 240);
    final appliedIds = OrgRecommender.appliedOrgIds();

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: layout.hPad),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 38,
                height: 38,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: HC.mint,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: const Icon(
                  Icons.groups_rounded,
                  size: 22,
                  color: HC.primary,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  'Recommended for You',
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: HC.ink,
                    fontSize: 17,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: widget.onViewAll,
                style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                  minimumSize: const Size(44, 44),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                  foregroundColor: HC.primary,
                  tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.padded,
                ),
                child: const Text(
                  'View All â†’',
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        SingleChildScrollView(
          scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
          physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: layout.hPad),
          child: IntrinsicHeight(
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                for (var index = 0; index < organizations.length; index++) ...[
                  if (index > 0) const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: cardWidth,
                    child: _RecommendedOrgCard(
                      organization: organizations[index],
                      memberCount: _counts[organizations[index].id] ?? 0,
                      isSaved: SavedOrgs.instance.isSaved(
                        organizations[index].id,
                      ),
                      isApplied: appliedIds.contains(
                        organizations[index].id,
                      ),
                      onSave: () {
                        SavedOrgs.instance.toggle(organizations[index].id);
                      },
                      onTap: () {
                        _openOrganization(
                          context,
                          organizations[index].id,
                        );
                      },
                      onAction: () {
                        final isApplied =
                            appliedIds.contains(organizations[index].id);

                        _openOrganization(
                          context,
                          organizations[index].id,
                          initialTab: isApplied ? 0 : 2,
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 32),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// A recommendation card with save, organization navigation, and join actions.
class _RecommendedOrgCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final Organization organization;
  final int memberCount;
  final bool isSaved;
  final bool isApplied;
  final VoidCallback onSave;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final VoidCallback onAction;

  const _RecommendedOrgCard({
    required this.organization,
    required this.memberCount,
    required this.isSaved,
    required this.isApplied,
    required this.onSave,
    required this.onTap,
    required this.onAction,
  });

  String _subtitle() {
    final category = organization.category.trim();
    final description = organization.shortDesc.trim();

    if (category.isNotEmpty && memberCount > 0) {
      return '$category â€¢ $memberCount members';
    }

    if (category.isNotEmpty) {
      return category;
    }

    if (memberCount > 0) {
      return '$memberCount members';
    }

    if (description.isNotEmpty) {
      return description;
    }

    return 'Discover this organization';
  }

  List<String> _tags() {
    final tags = <String>[];

    final category = organization.category.trim();
    final acronym = organization.acronym.trim();

    if (category.isNotEmpty) {
      tags.add(category);
    }

    if (acronym.isNotEmpty && acronym.toLowerCase() != category.toLowerCase()) {
      tags.add(acronym);
    }

    return tags.take(2).toList();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tags = _tags();

    return Material(
      color: Colors.white,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        child: Ink(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.white,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            border: Border.all(color: HC.line),
            boxShadow: [
              BoxShadow(
                color: HC.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.07),
                blurRadius: 14,
                offset: const Offset(0, 5),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    OrgLogoAvatar(
                      logoAsset: organization.logoAsset,
                      size: 52,
                      radius: 16,
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    Semantics(
                      button: true,
                      label: 'Save ${organization.name}',
                      child: IconButton(
                        onPressed: onSave,
                        tooltip: isSaved
                            ? 'Remove ${organization.name} from saved'
                            : 'Save ${organization.name}',
                        constraints: const BoxConstraints(
                          minWidth: 44,
                          minHeight: 44,
                        ),
                        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        icon: Icon(
                          isSaved
                              ? Icons.favorite_rounded
                              : Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
                          color: isSaved ? HC.danger : HC.muted,
                          size: 23,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Text(
                  organization.name,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: HC.ink,
                    fontSize: 15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    height: 1.25,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Text(
                  _subtitle(),
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: HC.muted,
                    fontSize: 12,
                    height: 1.3,
                  ),
                ),
                if (tags.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 6,
                    runSpacing: 6,
                    children: [
                      for (final tag in tags) _HomeTagPill(label: tag),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                SizedBox(
                  height: 44,
                  child: FilledButton(
                    onPressed: onAction,
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: isApplied ? HC.mint : HC.primary,
                      foregroundColor: isApplied ? HC.dark : Colors.white,
                      elevation: 0,
                      minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(44),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      isApplied ? 'Applied' : 'Join',
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        fontSize: 14,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Small mint category or acronym tag used inside recommendation cards.
class _HomeTagPill extends StatelessWidget {
  final String label;

  const _HomeTagPill({
    required this.label,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 175),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: 9,
        vertical: 5,
      ),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: HC.mint,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      ),
      child: Text(
        label,
        maxLines: 1,
        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        style: const TextStyle(
          color: HC.dark,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          fontSize: 11,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}


===== FILE: lib\screens\Student_Role\home\home_saved_orgs.dart =====

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' as supabase;

/// Stores the current user's saved organization IDs across app launches.
class SavedOrgs extends ChangeNotifier {
  SavedOrgs._();

  static final SavedOrgs instance = SavedOrgs._();

  final Set<String> _saved = <String>{};

  String? _storageKey;
  bool _loaded = false;
  int _loadGeneration = 0;

  String _currentStorageKey() {
    final userId = supabase.Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;

    if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty) {
      return 'home_saved_orgs_guest';
    }

    return 'home_saved_orgs_$userId';
  }

  /// Loads saved organizations for the currently authenticated user.
  ///
  /// A user change invalidates the previous in-memory set. Storage failures
  /// are handled without propagating exceptions to the UI.
  Future<void> load() async {
    final key = _currentStorageKey();

    if (_loaded && _storageKey == key) {
      return;
    }

    final generation = ++_loadGeneration;

    if (_storageKey != key) {
      _saved.clear();
      _storageKey = key;
      _loaded = false;
    }

    try {
      final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final savedIds = preferences.getStringList(key) ?? const <String>[];

      if (generation != _loadGeneration || key != _currentStorageKey()) {
        return;
      }

      _saved
        ..clear()
        ..addAll(
          savedIds.where((id) => id.trim().isNotEmpty),
        );

      _loaded = true;
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Unable to load saved organizations: $error');

      if (generation != _loadGeneration || key != _currentStorageKey()) {
        return;
      }

      _saved.clear();
      _loaded = true;
    }

    if (generation == _loadGeneration && key == _currentStorageKey()) {
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  /// Returns whether an organization is saved for the current in-memory user.
  bool isSaved(String orgId) {
    return _saved.contains(orgId);
  }

  /// Updates the in-memory set immediately, notifies listeners, then persists.
  Future<void> toggle(String orgId) async {
    if (orgId.trim().isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    final key = _currentStorageKey();

    if (_storageKey != key) {
      _loadGeneration++;
      _saved.clear();
      _storageKey = key;
      _loaded = false;
    }

    if (!_saved.add(orgId)) {
      _saved.remove(orgId);
    }

    notifyListeners();

    final snapshot = _saved.toList()..sort();

    try {
      final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await preferences.setStringList(key, snapshot);
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Unable to persist saved organizations: $error');
    }
  }
}


===== FILE: lib\screens\Student_Role\home\home_search_page.dart =====

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart' hide Notification;

import '../../../core/app_state.dart';
import '../../organizations/org_profile_screen.dart';
import 'event_details_sheet.dart';
import 'home_data.dart';
import 'home_event_utils.dart';
import 'home_org_logo.dart';
import 'home_tokens.dart';

/// Provides full-screen search for organizations and upcoming campus events.
class HomeSearchPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool openFiltersOnStart;

  const HomeSearchPage({
    super.key,
    this.openFiltersOnStart = false,
  });

  @override
  State<HomeSearchPage> createState() => _HomeSearchPageState();
}

/// Manages debounced searching, scope selection, and category filtering.
class _HomeSearchPageState extends State<HomeSearchPage> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  final FocusNode _searchFocusNode = FocusNode();

  Timer? _debounce;

  String _query = '';
  String? _selectedCategory;
  _SearchScope _scope = _SearchScope.all;

  bool _initialFilterOpened = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    if (widget.openFiltersOnStart) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (!mounted || _initialFilterOpened) {
          return;
        }

        _initialFilterOpened = true;
        _openCategoryFilter();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _searchController.dispose();
    _searchFocusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onQueryChanged(String value) {
    _debounce?.cancel();

    // Rebuild immediately so the clear button follows the text field.
    setState(() {});

    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 200), () {
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _query = value.trim().toLowerCase();
      });
    });
  }

  void _submitQuery(String value) {
    _debounce?.cancel();

    setState(() {
      _query = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    });

    _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
  }

  void _clearQuery() {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _searchController.clear();

    setState(() {
      _query = '';
    });
  }

  List<String> _categories() {
    final distinctCategories = <String, String>{};

    for (final organization in AppState.instance.organizations) {
      final category = organization.category.trim();

      if (category.isEmpty) {
        continue;
      }

      distinctCategories.putIfAbsent(
        category.toLowerCase(),
        () => category,
      );
    }

    final result = distinctCategories.values.toList();

    result.sort(
      (a, b) => a.toLowerCase().compareTo(b.toLowerCase()),
    );

    return result;
  }

  String? _categoryForEvent(
    Event event,
    Map<String, Organization> organizationsById,
  ) {
    final orgId = event.orgId;

    if (orgId == null || orgId.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }

    return organizationsById[orgId]?.category.trim();
  }

  bool _matchesQuery(String haystack) {
    final terms =
        _query.split(RegExp(r'\s+')).where((term) => term.isNotEmpty).toList();

    if (terms.isEmpty) {
      return true;
    }

    final normalizedHaystack = haystack.toLowerCase();

    return terms.every(normalizedHaystack.contains);
  }

  bool _matchesCategory(String? category) {
    final selectedCategory = _selectedCategory;

    if (selectedCategory == null) {
      return true;
    }

    return category != null &&
        category.trim().toLowerCase() == selectedCategory.trim().toLowerCase();
  }

  List<Organization> _matchingOrganizations(
    List<Organization> organizations,
  ) {
    final results = organizations.where((organization) {
      if (!_matchesCategory(organization.category)) {
        return false;
      }

      final haystack = [
        organization.name,
        organization.acronym,
        organization.category,
        organization.shortDesc,
        organization.about,
      ].join(' ');

      return _matchesQuery(haystack);
    }).toList();

    results.sort((a, b) {
      final nameA = a.name.toLowerCase();
      final nameB = b.name.toLowerCase();

      int rank(String name) {
        if (_query.isEmpty || name.startsWith(_query)) {
          return 0;
        }

        if (name.contains(_query)) {
          return 1;
        }

        return 2;
      }

      final rankComparison = rank(nameA).compareTo(rank(nameB));

      if (rankComparison != 0) {
        return rankComparison;
      }

      final nameComparison = nameA.compareTo(nameB);

      if (nameComparison != 0) {
        return nameComparison;
      }

      return a.id.compareTo(b.id);
    });

    return results;
  }

  List<Event> _matchingEvents(
    List<Event> events,
    Map<String, Organization> organizationsById,
  ) {
    return events.where((event) {
      final category = _categoryForEvent(
        event,
        organizationsById,
      );

      if (!_matchesCategory(category)) {
        return false;
      }

      final haystack = [
        event.title,
        event.orgName,
        event.description,
        event.venue,
        category ?? '',
      ].join(' ');

      return _matchesQuery(haystack);
    }).toList();
  }

  Future<void> _openCategoryFilter() async {
    final categories = _categories();

    final result = await showModalBottomSheet<_CategoryFilterResult>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.white,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
          top: Radius.circular(24),
        ),
      ),
      builder: (sheetContext) {
        String? draftCategory = _selectedCategory;

        return HomeLayout.capText(
          sheetContext,
          StatefulBuilder(
            builder: (context, setModalState) {
              final bottomInset = MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom;

              return Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                  HomeLayout.of(context).hPad,
                  22,
                  HomeLayout.of(context).hPad,
                  20 + bottomInset,
                ),
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          const Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              'Filter by category',
                              maxLines: 2,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: HC.ink,
                                fontSize: 20,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          IconButton(
                            tooltip: 'Close filters',
                            constraints: const BoxConstraints(
                              minWidth: 44,
                              minHeight: 44,
                            ),
                            onPressed: () {
                              Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop();
                            },
                            icon: const Icon(
                              Icons.close_rounded,
                              color: HC.muted,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Wrap(
                        spacing: 8,
                        runSpacing: 8,
                        children: [
                          _buildCategoryChoiceChip(
                            label: 'All categories',
                            selected: draftCategory == null,
                            onSelected: () {
                              setModalState(() {
                                draftCategory = null;
                              });
                            },
                          ),
                          for (final category in categories)
                            _buildCategoryChoiceChip(
                              label: category,
                              selected: draftCategory?.toLowerCase() ==
                                  category.toLowerCase(),
                              onSelected: () {
                                setModalState(() {
                                  draftCategory = category;
                                });
                              },
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 26),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          TextButton(
                            onPressed: () {
                              setModalState(() {
                                draftCategory = null;
                              });
                            },
                            style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                              minimumSize: const Size(70, 44),
                              foregroundColor: HC.primary,
                            ),
                            child: const Text('Reset'),
                          ),
                          const Spacer(),
                          FilledButton(
                            onPressed: () {
                              Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop(
                                _CategoryFilterResult(
                                  applied: true,
                                  category: draftCategory,
                                ),
                              );
                            },
                            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                              minimumSize: const Size(100, 44),
                              backgroundColor: HC.primary,
                              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              ),
                            ),
                            child: const Text(
                              'Apply',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        );
      },
    );

    if (!mounted || result == null || !result.applied) {
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _selectedCategory = result.category;
    });
  }

  Widget _buildCategoryChoiceChip({
    required String label,
    required bool selected,
    required VoidCallback onSelected,
  }) {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 40,
      child: ChoiceChip(
        label: Text(
          label,
          maxLines: 1,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        ),
        selected: selected,
        onSelected: (_) => onSelected(),
        materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.padded,
        visualDensity: VisualDensity.standard,
        labelPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7),
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        selectedColor: HC.mint,
        side: BorderSide(
          color: selected ? HC.primary : HC.line,
        ),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        labelStyle: TextStyle(
          color: selected ? HC.dark : HC.ink,
          fontWeight: selected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
          fontSize: 13,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTopBar(BuildContext context) {
    final layout = HomeLayout.of(context);

    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
        layout.hPad,
        8,
        layout.hPad,
        8,
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          SizedBox(
            width: 44,
            height: 44,
            child: IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Back',
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.maybePop(context);
              },
              padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
              icon: const Icon(
                Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded,
                color: HC.ink,
                size: 21,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
          Expanded(
            child: Container(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 48),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),

  Widget _buildResults(
    BuildContext context,
    List<Organization> organizations,
    List<Event> events,
  ) {
    final layout = HomeLayout.of(context);
    final rows = <_SearchRow>[];

    if (_scope != _SearchScope.events) {
      rows.add(
        _SearchRow(
          type: _SearchRowType.organizationHeader,
          title: 'Organizations (${organizations.length})',
        ),
      );

      for (final organization in organizations) {
        rows.add(
          _SearchRow(
            type: _SearchRowType.organization,
            organization: organization,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    if (_scope != _SearchScope.organizations) {
      rows.add(
        _SearchRow(
          type: _SearchRowType.eventHeader,
          title: 'Events (${events.length})',
        ),
      );

      for (final event in events) {
        rows.add(
          _SearchRow(
            type: _SearchRowType.event,
            event: event,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return ListView.builder(
      keyboardDismissBehavior: ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 24),
      itemCount: rows.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final row = rows[index];

        switch (row.type) {
          case _SearchRowType.organizationHeader:
          case _SearchRowType.eventHeader:
            return _ResultsSectionHeader(
              title: row.title ?? '',
              horizontalPadding: layout.hPad,
            );

          case _SearchRowType.organization:
            final organization = row.organization!;

            return _OrganizationResultTile(
              organization: organization,
              horizontalPadding: layout.hPad,
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(context).push(
                  MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                    builder: (_) => OrgDetailScreen(
                      orgId: organization.id,
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
            );

          case _SearchRowType.event:
            final event = row.event!;

            return _EventResultTile(
              event: event,
              horizontalPadding: layout.hPad,
              onTap: () {
                showEventDetailsSheet(
                  context,
                  event: event,
                );
              },
            );
        }
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildResultsBody(BuildContext context) {
    final appState = AppState.instance;
    final categories = _categories();

    if (_query.isEmpty && _selectedCategory == null) {
      return _buildIdleContent(context, categories);
    }

    final organizationsById = <String, Organization>{
      for (final organization in appState.organizations)
        organization.id: organization,
    };

    final allEvents = HomeData.upcomingEvents(maxAgeDays: 365);

    final matchingOrganizations =
        _matchingOrganizations(appState.organizations);

    final matchingEvents = _matchingEvents(
      allEvents,
      organizationsById,
    );

    final visibleOrganizations = _scope == _SearchScope.events
        ? <Organization>[]
        : matchingOrganizations;

    final visibleEvents =
        _scope == _SearchScope.organizations ? <Event>[] : matchingEvents;

    if (visibleOrganizations.isEmpty && visibleEvents.isEmpty) {
      return _buildNoResults(context);
    }

    return _buildResults(
      context,
      visibleOrganizations,
      visibleEvents,
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: HC.bg,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: HomeLayout.capText(
          context,
          Column(
            children: [
              _buildTopBar(context),
              _buildScopeRow(context),
              Expanded(
                child: AnimatedBuilder(
                  animation: AppState.instance,
                  builder: (context, _) {
                    return _buildResultsBody(context);
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

===== FILE: lib\screens\Student_Role\home\home_tokens.dart =====

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// Colors shared by the new Home widgets.
abstract class HC {
  static const primary = Color(0xFF0F8A61);
  static const bright = Color(0xFF1A9E6B);
  static const dark = Color(0xFF064E3B);
  static const bg = Color(0xFFF1FAF6);
  static const mint = Color(0xFFE4F7EF);
  static const ink = Color(0xFF173B30);
  static const muted = Color(0xFF6B8178);
  static const line = Color(0xFFCBE8DC);
  static const danger = Color(0xFFDC2626);

  static const heroGradient = LinearGradient(
    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
    colors: [dark, Color(0xFF0B6B4D), bright],
  );
}

/// Responsive helper: build it once per widget with HomeLayout.of(context).
class HomeLayout {
  final double width;
  const HomeLayout._(this.width);

  factory HomeLayout.of(BuildContext context) =>
      HomeLayout._(MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width);

  bool get isNarrow => width < 360;
  bool get isTablet => width >= 600;

  /// Page content never gets wider than this (keeps tablets tidy).
  double get contentWidth => width > 640 ? 640 : width;

  /// Side padding that grows slightly with screen width.
  double get hPad => isNarrow ? 14 : (isTablet ? 24 : 18);

  /// Width of horizontally scrolling cards (about 1.15 cards visible).
  double cardWidth({double min = 220, double max = 300}) {
    final w = (contentWidth - hPad * 2) * 0.82;
    return w < min ? min : (w > max ? max : w);
  }

  /// Caps system font scaling so large-text users don't break layouts.
  static Widget capText(BuildContext context, Widget child) {
    final mq = MediaQuery.of(context);
    return MediaQuery(
      data: mq.copyWith(
        textScaler: mq.textScaler.clamp(
          minScaleFactor: 0.9,
          maxScaleFactor: 1.15,
        ),
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart' hide Notification;

import '../../../core/analytics_service.dart';

/// New student Home tab. Navigation is handed in by the dashboard shell, so
/// this file never touches the shell's private screens.
class NewHomeTab extends StatefulWidget {
  final void Function(int index)
      onSwitchTab; // 0 Home, 1 Orgs, 2 Events, 3 Profile
  final VoidCallback onOpenApplications;
  final VoidCallback onOpenJoinedOrgs;
  final VoidCallback onOpenNotifications;

  const NewHomeTab({
    super.key,
    required this.onSwitchTab,
    required this.onOpenApplications,
    required this.onOpenJoinedOrgs,
    required this.onOpenNotifications,
  });

  @override
  State<NewHomeTab> createState() => _NewHomeTabState();
}

class _NewHomeTabState extends State<NewHomeTab> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    AppState.instance.fetchEvents();
    AnalyticsService.instance
        .logUsage('open_student_dashboard', route: 'student/home');
  }

  void _openSearch({bool openFilters = false}) {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => HomeSearchPage(openFiltersOnStart: openFilters),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    try {
      await Future.wait<void>([
        AppState.instance.fetchEvents(),
        AppState.instance.fetchOrganizations(),
        AppState.instance.fetchApplications(),
        AppState.instance.fetchNotifications(),
      ]);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Home refresh failed: $e');
    }
  }

  ImageProvider? _avatar() {
    final url = AppState.instance.currentStudent?.avatarUrl ?? '';
    if (url.isEmpty) return null;
    if (url.startsWith('data:')) {
      try {
        return MemoryImage(base64Decode(url.substring(url.indexOf(',') + 1)));
      } catch (_) {
        return null;
      }
    }
    return NetworkImage(url);
  }

  String _greeting() {
    final h = DateTime.now().hour;
    final part =
        h < 12 ? 'Good morning' : (h < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening');
    final name = (AppState.instance.currentStudent?.name ?? '').trim();
    if (name.isEmpty) return '$part! ðŸ‘‹';
    return '$part, ${name.split(RegExp(r'\s+')).first}! ðŸ‘‹';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return HomeLayout.capText(
      context,
      AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: AppState.instance,
        builder: (context, _) {
          final l = HomeLayout.of(context);
          return RefreshIndicator(
            color: HC.primary,
            onRefresh: _refresh,
            child: ListView(
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(
                  parent: BouncingScrollPhysics()),
              padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
              children: [
                _Hero(
                  layout: l,
                  greeting: _greeting(),
                  avatar: _avatar(),
                  hasUnread: HomeData.unreadNotificationCount() > 0,
                  onBell: widget.onOpenNotifications,
                  onAvatar: () => widget.onSwitchTab(3),
                  onSearch: () => _openSearch(),
                  onFilter: () => _openSearch(openFilters: true),
                ),
                _Centered(
                  layout: l,
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(l.hPad, 18, l.hPad, 0),

                      applicationBadge: HomeData.inProgressApplicationCount(),

                      onEvents: () => widget.onSwitchTab(2),
                      onApplications: widget.onOpenApplications,
                      onJoined: widget.onOpenJoinedOrgs,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                // ðŸ‘‰ ADD THIS SECTION FOR UPCOMING EVENTS:
                _Centered(
                  layout: l,
                  child: HomeEventsSection(

                      context,

class _QA {
  final IconData icon;
  final List<String> lines;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final int badge;
  const _QA(this.icon, this.lines, this.onTap, {this.badge = 0});
}

class _QuickActions extends StatelessWidget {
  final int applicationBadge;
  final VoidCallback onDiscover;
  final VoidCallback onEvents;
  final VoidCallback onApplications;
  final VoidCallback onJoined;

  const _QuickActions({
    required this.applicationBadge,
    required this.onDiscover,
    required this.onEvents,
    required this.onApplications,
    required this.onJoined,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, c) {
      const gap = 8.0;
      // 4 across only when each card would be at least 80px wide.
      final fourAcross = (c.maxWidth - gap * 3) / 4 >= 80;

      final items = <_QA>[
        _QA(Icons.explore_rounded, const ['Discover', 'Organizations'],
            onDiscover),
        _QA(Icons.event_note_rounded, const ['Upcoming', 'Events'], onEvents),
        _QA(Icons.assignment_rounded, const ['My', 'Applications'],
            onApplications,
            badge: applicationBadge),
        _QA(Icons.groups_rounded, const ['Joined', 'Orgs'], onJoined),
      ];

      Widget card(_QA a) => _QuickCard(a: a, roomy: !fourAcross);

      if (fourAcross) {
        return Row(
          children: [
            for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) ...[
              if (i > 0) const SizedBox(width: gap),
              Expanded(child: card(items[i])),
            ],
          ],
        );
      }
      return Column(
        children: [
          Row(children: [
            Expanded(child: card(items[0])),
            const SizedBox(width: gap),
            Expanded(child: card(items[1])),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: gap),
          Row(children: [
            Expanded(child: card(items[2])),
            const SizedBox(width: gap),
            Expanded(child: card(items[3])),
          ]),
        ],
      );
    });
  }
}

class _QuickCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final _QA a;
  final bool roomy;
  const _QuickCard({required this.a, required this.roomy});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final iconBox = roomy ? 42.0 : 36.0;
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(color: HC.line),
        boxShadow: const [
          BoxShadow(
              color: Color(0x120F8A61), blurRadius: 12, offset: Offset(0, 4)),
        ],
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
          onTap: a.onTap,
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.all(roomy ? 14 : 10),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      width: iconBox,
                      height: iconBox,
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                          color: HC.mint, shape: BoxShape.circle),
                      child: Icon(a.icon,
                          color: HC.primary, size: roomy ? 22 : 19),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    if (a.badge > 0) _Badge(count: a.badge),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          for (final line in a.lines)
                            FittedBox(
                              fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                              alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                              child: Text(
                                line,
                                maxLines: 1,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: HC.ink,
                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                  height: 1.2,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (roomy)
                      const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
                          size: 16, color: HC.primary),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart' hide Notification;

import '../../../core/app_state.dart';
import 'home_event_utils.dart';
import 'home_tokens.dart';

/// Shows horizontally scrollable cards for upcoming campus events.
class UpcomingEventsRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const UpcomingEventsRow({
    super.key,
    required this.events,
    required this.interestCounts,
    required this.onOpen,
  });

  final List<Event> events;
  final Map<String, int> interestCounts;
  final void Function(Event) onOpen;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final displayedEvents = events.take(10).toList(growable: false);

    if (displayedEvents.isEmpty) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final layout = HomeLayout.of(context);
    final cardWidth = layout.cardWidth(min: 200, max: 250);

    return SingleChildScrollView(
      scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
      physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: layout.hPad),
      child: IntrinsicHeight(
        child: Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            for (var index = 0; index < displayedEvents.length; index++) ...[
              if (index > 0) const SizedBox(width: 12),
              _UpcomingEventCard(
                event: displayedEvents[index],
                width: cardWidth,
                interestedCount: interestCounts[displayedEvents[index].id] ?? 0,
                onTap: () => onOpen(displayedEvents[index]),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Renders a single upcoming event card with its date and interest count.
class _UpcomingEventCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _UpcomingEventCard({
    required this.event,
    required this.width,
    required this.interestedCount,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final Event event;
  final double width;
  final int interestedCount;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  Widget _buildImage() {
    return AspectRatio(
      aspectRatio: 16 / 10,
      child: Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: <Widget>[
          EventImage(
            url: eventCoverImage(event) ?? '',
            fit: BoxFit.cover,
            fallback: eventGradientFallback(),
          ),
          Positioned(
            top: 10,
            left: 10,
            child: Container(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 48),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: 8,
                vertical: 6,
              ),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
                boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: HC.dark.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                    blurRadius: 8,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Text(
                    monthShortUpper(event.date.month),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: HC.primary,
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      letterSpacing: 0.5,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 1),
                  Text(
                    '${event.date.day}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: HC.ink,
                      fontSize: 21,
                      height: 1,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildVenue() {
    final venue = event.venue.trim();

    if (venue.isEmpty) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return Row(
      children: <Widget>[
        const Icon(
          Icons.location_on_outlined,
          size: 15,
          color: HC.muted,
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 5),
        Expanded(
          child: Text(
            venue,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: HC.muted,
              fontSize: 11,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTime() {
    final time = event.timeLabel.trim();
    final label = time.isNotEmpty ? time : formatDateShort(event.date);

    return Row(
      children: <Widget>[
        const Icon(
          Icons.schedule_rounded,
          size: 15,
          color: HC.muted,
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 5),
        Expanded(
          child: Text(
            label,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: HC.muted,
              fontSize: 11,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInterestPill() {
    if (interestedCount <= 0) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return Align(
      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: 9,
          vertical: 6,
        ),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: HC.mint,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            const Icon(
              Icons.people_alt_outlined,
              size: 14,
              color: HC.primary,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 5),
            Flexible(
              child: Text(
                '$interestedCount interested',
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: HC.dark,
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final orgName = event.orgName.trim();

    return SizedBox(
      width: width,
      child: Semantics(
        button: true,
        label: 'Event: ${event.title}, ${formatDateShort(event.date)}',
        child: Material(
          color: Colors.transparent,
          child: InkWell(
            onTap: onTap,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
            child: Ink(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(17),
                border: Border.all(color: HC.line),
                boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: const Color(0x120F8A61),
                    blurRadius: 14,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 5),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: <Widget>[
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(
                      top: Radius.circular(16),
                    ),
                    child: _buildImage(),
                  ),
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 12, 12, 13),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text(
                          orgName.isEmpty
                              ? 'CAMPUS ORGANIZATION'
                              : orgName.toUpperCase(),
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: HC.primary,
                            fontSize: 9,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            letterSpacing: 0.55,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 6),
                        Text(
                          event.title,
                          maxLines: 2,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: HC.ink,
                            fontSize: 14,
                            height: 1.25,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 9),
                        _buildVenue(),
                        if (event.venue.trim().isNotEmpty)
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                        _buildTime(),
                        if (interestedCount > 0) ...<Widget>[
                          const SizedBox(height: 10),
                          _buildInterestPill(),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
